domainName: Toyota / Lexus Specific Platform Faults (Vios, Innova, Hilux, Fortuner, HiAce, Wigo)
title: Toyota 1NR-FE / 2NR-FE Vios/Avanza Timing Chain Tensioner Rattle
phContext: Toyota Vios/Yaris/Avanza (2016–2024); overdue 5W-30 oil changes
symptoms: 2-second cold-start rattle, P0016 if stretched
diagnosticSteps: 1. Check oil level/sludge and oil filter OEM spec. 2. Scope CKP vs. CMP phase alignment. 3. Replace hydraulic tensioner & timing chain kit if >1 tooth off.

domainName: Toyota / Lexus Specific Platform Faults (Vios, Innova, Hilux, Fortuner, HiAce, Wigo)
title: Toyota VSC/TRAC + MIL Lit Simultaneously (Secondary Flag)
phContext: All Toyota/Lexus CAN models (Vios, Hilux, Fortuner, Innova)
symptoms: Check Engine + Traction + ABS/VSC lights all on together
diagnosticSteps: 1. Read Engine ECM first! C1201 in ABS means 'Engine ECM has an active DTC'. 2. Fix primary engine fault (e.g., O2, MAF, coil, SCV). 3. Clear both ECM and ABS.

domainName: Toyota / Lexus Specific Platform Faults (Vios, Innova, Hilux, Fortuner, HiAce, Wigo)
title: Toyota Rough Idling History Flag — Dirty Throttle / Weak Mount
phContext: Toyota Vios, Wigo, Avanza, Innova Gas; heavy EDSA idling
symptoms: Stored P1605 in freeze frame, slight shudder at D-stop
diagnosticSteps: 1. Clean electronic throttle body carbon ring. 2. Check right-side engine mount & spark plugs. 3. Clear P1605 and run idle relearn.

domainName: Toyota / Lexus Specific Platform Faults (Vios, Innova, Hilux, Fortuner, HiAce, Wigo)
title: Toyota Charcoal Canister Pump Module Vent Stuck (Late Vios/Altis)
phContext: Toyota Vios/Altis/Corolla Cross; dust/water in rear canister pump
symptoms: MIL on after overnight park, EVAP leak code
diagnosticSteps: 1. Inspect rear EVAP canister near fuel tank for mud/water. 2. Run Techstream EVAP Key-Off Pump active test. 3. Replace pump module.

domainName: Toyota / Lexus Specific Platform Faults (Vios, Innova, Hilux, Fortuner, HiAce, Wigo)
title: Toyota Vios / Wigo CVT Shudder at 20–40 km/h — Degraded TC/FE Fluid
phContext: Toyota Vios (2014+), Wigo (2023+ D-CVT); >50,000 km unserviced CVTF
symptoms: Juddering takeoff in traffic, RPM dips
diagnosticSteps: 1. Drain CVTF (check if dark brown/burnt) and replace strainer + 2x drain-and-fill with genuine Toyota CVTF-FE/TC. 2. Reset CVT oil degradation counter.

domainName: Toyota / Lexus Specific Platform Faults (Vios, Innova, Hilux, Fortuner, HiAce, Wigo)
title: Toyota 6-Speed AT (AC60E) Lock-Up Control Solenoid SLU Stuck
phContext: Toyota Hilux/Fortuner/Innova 2.4/2.8 (2016+); heat-aged ATF WS
symptoms: Stalls when coming to a stop in Drive, or harsh 3-4 shift
diagnosticSteps: 1. Check ATF WS level at exact 35– 45°C overflow check-plug temp! 2. Command SLU solenoid via Techstream. 3. Replace SLU solenoid and flush ATF WS.

domainName: Toyota / Lexus Specific Platform Faults (Vios, Innova, Hilux, Fortuner, HiAce, Wigo)
title: Toyota 4AT/6AT Input Speed Sensor NT Open — Internal Harness
phContext: Toyota Innova/Vios/Avanza AT; heat-brittle internal wire
symptoms: Harsh shifting, no lockup, O/D OFF flashing
diagnosticSteps: 1. Monitor NT Input RPM PID (reads 0 in Drive). 2. Measure sensor resistance at external transmission plug. 3. Drop pan and replace NT sensor.

domainName: Toyota / Lexus Specific Platform Faults (Vios, Innova, Hilux, Fortuner, HiAce, Wigo)
title: Toyota Hilux / Fortuner 1KD/2KD Timing Belt Light ('T-BELT') On
phContext: Toyota Hilux/Fortuner/HiAce 1KD/2KD at 150,000 km intervals
symptoms: Amber 'T-BELT' light on cluster despite timing belt already changed
diagnosticSteps: 1. Perform cluster ODO/Trip button reset sequence (hold Trip button key-off → turn key ON 5 sec → release & press 5 sec → set '15' for 150,000 km!). 2. Verify light clears.

domainName: Toyota / Lexus Specific Platform Faults (Vios, Innova, Hilux, Fortuner, HiAce, Wigo)
title: Toyota 1GD/2GD VNT Turbo Actuator Calibration / Carbon Bind
phContext: Toyota Hilux/Fortuner/Innova/HiAc e 2.4/2.8 (2016+); city soot
symptoms: Limp mode on expressway, P0046/P1251
diagnosticSteps: 1. Unclip VNT actuator linkage and feel vane arm movement (must glide effortlessly). 2. Scope VNT motor PWM & position sensor. 3. Clean turbo VNT ring.

domainName: Toyota / Lexus Specific Platform Faults (Vios, Innova, Hilux, Fortuner, HiAce, Wigo)
title: Toyota 2GD/1GD DPF Soot Full — 5th Injector Coked Shut
phContext: Toyota Hilux/Fortuner/HiAce Euro-4; city traffic preventing regen
symptoms: DPF light blinking, limp mode, manual DPF button unresponsive
diagnosticSteps: 1. Remove 5th fuel injector on exhaust manifold/downpipe and clear carbon plug! 2. Check Diff Pressure hoses. 3. Perform Techstream PM Forced Regeneration.

domainName: Toyota / Lexus Specific Platform Faults (Vios, Innova, Hilux, Fortuner, HiAce, Wigo)
title: Toyota Innova / Fortuner Diesel Fuel Filter Light Flashing
phContext: Toyota 1KD/2KD/2GD; clogged spin-on/cartridge element
symptoms: Red/amber fuel filter sediment icon blinking on cluster
diagnosticSteps: 1. Replace fuel filter element + drain water separator bowl. 2. Reset fuel filter switch by unplugging top differential vacuum/float switch, turning key ON, reconnecting (per OEM procedure).

domainName: Toyota / Lexus Specific Platform Faults (Vios, Innova, Hilux, Fortuner, HiAce, Wigo)
title: Toyota Spiral Cable (Clock Spring) Broken — Horn + Airbag Light
phContext: Toyota Vios, Innova, Hilux, Fortuner, Wigo (very high failure rate)
symptoms: SRS light on + steering audio/horn dead
diagnosticSteps: 1. Read D-Squib resistance PID (reads >4–10 ohms). 2. Replace genuine Toyota spiral cable (center exactly 2.5 turns!). 3. Clear SRS DTC.

domainName: Toyota / Lexus Specific Platform Faults (Vios, Innova, Hilux, Fortuner, HiAce, Wigo)
title: Toyota Wigo (1KR-FE / WA-VE) Rough Idle — 3-Cylinder Mounts & Coils
phContext: Toyota Wigo Gen 1/2/3; worn rubber engine mounts + carbon throttle
symptoms: Heavy cabin vibration at idle with A/C on
diagnosticSteps: 1. Inspect rear torque-rod and right hydraulic mount. 2. Clean throttle body and check all 3 ignition coil boots for arcing. 3. Verify idle RPM ~750–800 RPM.

domainName: Toyota / Lexus Specific Platform Faults (Vios, Innova, Hilux, Fortuner, HiAce, Wigo)
title: Toyota Avanza / Rush (2NR-VE) Rear-Wheel-Drive Prop Shaft Clunk
phContext: Toyota Avanza/Rush; dry rear U-joint or loose companion flange
symptoms: Metallic clunk shifting P -> D -> R
diagnosticSteps: 1. Check driveshaft U-joints for play and center bearing rubber tear. 2. Grease slip yoke splines. 3. Replace worn U-joint.

domainName: Toyota / Lexus Specific Platform Faults (Vios, Innova, Hilux, Fortuner, HiAce, Wigo)
title: Toyota 1NZ-FE / 2NR-FE Ignition Coil Driver — Heat Fatigue
phContext: High-mileage Vios taxis (200k+ km); coil #1/#4 above exhaust side
symptoms: Sudden 3-cylinder limp, MIL flashing
diagnosticSteps: 1. Swap coil to adjacent cylinder to confirm fault moves. 2. Check 4-pin coil plug (12V, IGT, IGF, GND) — note Toyota IGF confirmation wire kills all fuel if broken! 3. Replace OEM Denso coil.

domainName: Toyota / Lexus Specific Platform Faults (Vios, Innova, Hilux, Fortuner, HiAce, Wigo)
title: Toyota Igniter Circuit No. 1 (IGF Signal Missing) — Stalls Immediately
phContext: Toyota 1NZ/1TR/2TR/1NR; broken IGF wire or bad coil feedback
symptoms: Engine starts, fires 2 seconds, then ECM cuts fuel injectors!
diagnosticSteps: 1. Scope IGF wire across all 4 coils (5V pull-up pulled to 0V on every spark!). 2. Unplug coils one by one to find which coil is pulling IGF permanently low. 3. Replace faulty coil.

domainName: Toyota / Lexus Specific Platform Faults (Vios, Innova, Hilux, Fortuner, HiAce, Wigo)
title: Toyota Vios / Yaris / Wigo EPS Power Relay Welded/Open
phContext: Toyota EPS column ECU; heavy parking maneuvers in heat
symptoms: EPS light on, steering heavy until key cycled
diagnosticSteps: 1. Check 50A EPS fuse in engine bay. 2. Measure 12V IG1 & B+ at EPS ECU. 3. Replace EPS ECU or repair internal relay solder joint.

domainName: Toyota / Lexus Specific Platform Faults (Vios, Innova, Hilux, Fortuner, HiAce, Wigo)
title: Toyota HiAce (2KD / 1GD) Alternator Vacuum Pump Hose Burst
phContext: Toyota HiAce Commuter/GL; oil-soaked rubber hose behind alternator
symptoms: Low oil pressure light + hard brake pedal + oil puddle under van
diagnosticSteps: 1. Immediately shut down! Inspect short rubber oil feed hose at rear of alternator vacuum pump. 2. Replace with genuine high-temp braided hose and refill oil.

domainName: Toyota / Lexus Specific Platform Faults (Vios, Innova, Hilux, Fortuner, HiAce, Wigo)
title: Toyota Fortuner / Hilux Power Window Auto-Up Fails After Battery
phContext: Toyota 4-door models; lost pinch-protection calibration
symptoms: Driver cannot control passenger windows OR auto-up stops working
diagnosticSteps: 1. At EACH door switch individually, roll window down halfway, then hold UP past closed for 3 seconds! 2. Driver master switch regains control once all doors are initialized.

domainName: Toyota / Lexus Specific Platform Faults (Vios, Innova, Hilux, Fortuner, HiAce, Wigo)
title: Toyota Immobilizer Communication Error — Aftermarket Key / Swap
phContext: Toyota Vios/Innova/Fortuner; replacement ECU or unprogrammed key
symptoms: Cranks 2 sec and dies, Security light keeps blinking
diagnosticSteps: 1. Check if transponder key is recognized in Immobilizer ECU live data. 2. If ECU swapped, bridge OBD Pins 4 & 13 for 35 minutes (key ON, engine OFF) to re-sync ID code! 3. Clear B2799.

domainName: Toyota / Lexus Specific Platform Faults (Vios, Innova, Hilux, Fortuner, HiAce, Wigo)
title: Toyota Vios / Altis Manifold Cat Cracked / Fouled
phContext: High-mileage 1NZ-FE / 1ZR-FE; short-trip taxi/city service
symptoms: MIL on, failed emission test
diagnosticSteps: 1. Check for exhaust manifold hairline crack near B1S1 O2 sensor. 2. Compare A/F B1S1 vs. O2 B1S2 waveforms. 3. Replace manifold-cat.

domainName: Toyota / Lexus Specific Platform Faults (Vios, Innova, Hilux, Fortuner, HiAce, Wigo)
title: Toyota Innova (1TR-FE Gas) Fuel Pump Relay Melt in Engine Box
phContext: Toyota Innova Gas; aged fuel pump drawing >10A melting relay socket
symptoms: Stalls hot in traffic, won't prime until cooled
diagnosticSteps: 1. Pull C/OPN (Fuel Pump) relay and inspect blades for heat discoloration. 2. Measure pump current draw (>9A = replace in-tank pump). 3. Clean/tighten relay socket.

domainName: Toyota / Lexus Specific Platform Faults (Vios, Innova, Hilux, Fortuner, HiAce, Wigo)
title: Toyota 1TR-FE / 1NZ-FE Idle Speed Control — Dirty Electronic Throttle
phContext: Toyota Innova/Vios/Avanza; carbon buildup around butterfly
symptoms: Engine stalls when turning steering wheel or engaging A/C at idle
diagnosticSteps: 1. Clean throttle plate edges with throttle cleaner and soft brush. 2. Disconnect battery or reset ECM learned values via Techstream. 3. Warm up fully to relearn idle.

domainName: Toyota / Lexus Specific Platform Faults (Vios, Innova, Hilux, Fortuner, HiAce, Wigo)
title: Toyota Hilux / Fortuner Clutch Pedal Squeak — Plastic Clevis Bushing
phContext: Manual Hilux/Fortuner/Innova; dry plastic clutch pivot bushing
symptoms: Annoying squeak/click inside cabin every time clutch is pressed
diagnosticSteps: 1. Look under dash at clutch pedal clevis pin and return spring. 2. Lubricate with silicone/lithium grease and replace worn nylon bushing. 3. Check firewall flex.

domainName: Toyota / Lexus Specific Platform Faults (Vios, Innova, Hilux, Fortuner, HiAce, Wigo)
title: Toyota Front Speed Sensor LH Open/Short — Rubbed Against Tire
phContext: Lifted Hilux/Fortuner with oversized tires; torn sensor clip
symptoms: ABS + VSC + 4LO blinking
diagnosticSteps: 1. Inspect FL ABS harness clipped to upper control arm/strut. 2. Repair chafed wire and secure away from tire sidewall. 3. Clear codes.

domainName: Toyota / Lexus Specific Platform Faults (Vios, Innova, Hilux, Fortuner, HiAce, Wigo)
title: Toyota Corolla Cross / Zenix HEV — 12V Battery Dead in Trunk/Hood
phContext: Toyota hybrids parked 2+ weeks without driving
symptoms: Car completely dark, doors won't unlock with smart key
diagnosticSteps: 1. Use physical key blade to open driver door, open hood, and use underhood fuse-box jump terminal (+) + bare strut bolt (-)! 2. Load-test 12V battery. 3. Enter READY mode.

domainName: Toyota / Lexus Specific Platform Faults (Vios, Innova, Hilux, Fortuner, HiAce, Wigo)
title: Toyota Avanza / Veloz (2022+ DNGA) Electronic Parking Brake Stuck
phContext: Toyota Veloz / Raize; weak 12V battery or wet rear caliper
symptoms: EPB warning on dash, rear wheels locked
diagnosticSteps: 1. Check 12V battery voltage (>12.0V needed for EPB motors). 2. Inspect rear caliper 2-pin EPB plugs for floodwater/mud. 3. Cycle EPB switch with brake pedal pressed.

domainName: Toyota / Lexus Specific Platform Faults (Vios, Innova, Hilux, Fortuner, HiAce, Wigo)
title: Toyota 2KD/1KD MAF Sensor Contamination — Oiled Air Filter
phContext: Hilux/Fortuner owners installing aftermarket washable air filters
symptoms: Sluggish boost, black smoke, P0101
diagnosticSteps: 1. Remove aftermarket oiled filter and install genuine Toyota dry paper element. 2. Spray MAF hot-wire with MAF cleaner. 3. Reset ECM trims.

domainName: Toyota / Lexus Specific Platform Faults (Vios, Innova, Hilux, Fortuner, HiAce, Wigo)
title: Toyota HiAce Super Grandia Power Sliding Door Cable Snap
phContext: High-mileage HiAce GL/Super Grandia; frayed steel pull cable
symptoms: Power sliding door binds halfway and reverses
diagnosticSteps: 1. Turn Power Door OFF switch on dash to operate manually safely. 2. Inspect lower/center roller track for broken steel cable strands. 3. Replace sliding door motor/cable kit.

domainName: Toyota / Lexus Specific Platform Faults (Vios, Innova, Hilux, Fortuner, HiAce, Wigo)
title: Toyota ECM Internal Fault — Water Dripping from Windshield Cowl
phContext: Toyota Vios/Innova/Hilux with ECM behind glovebox / under cowl
symptoms: Random no-start, multiple phantom codes
diagnosticSteps: 1. Check windshield lower cowl seal for water dripping onto ECM harness! 2. Open ECM cover to inspect PCB for green corrosion. 3. Dry/repair & seal cowl.

domainName: Toyota / Lexus Specific Platform Faults (Vios, Innova, Hilux, Fortuner, HiAce, Wigo)
title: Toyota Raize / Wigo (Daihatsu DNGA) 3-Cylinder Belt Chirp
phContext: Toyota Raize 1.2/1.0T, Wigo 2023+; loose serpentine belt tension
symptoms: High-pitched chirp at cold start with A/C on
diagnosticSteps: 1. Inspect manual-tensioner alternator/water pump belt deflection. 2. Check water pump pulley alignment. 3. Replace glazed belt.

domainName: Toyota / Lexus Specific Platform Faults (Vios, Innova, Hilux, Fortuner, HiAce, Wigo)
title: Toyota 1KD/2KD Suction Control Valve (SCV) — Short vs. Long Type
phContext: Toyota Hilux/Fortuner/Innova 2005–2015; sticking Denso SCV
symptoms: Stalls on deceleration or limp mode under overtaking load
diagnosticSteps: 1. Check rail pressure PID at idle (must be steady ~30–35 MPa). 2. Replace with genuine Denso updated long-type SCV (if applicable). 3. Perform Techstream Supply Pump Initialization!

domainName: Toyota / Lexus Specific Platform Faults (Vios, Innova, Hilux, Fortuner, HiAce, Wigo)
title: Toyota Fortuner / Hilux Rear Differential Breather Plugged — Seal Leak
phContext: 4x4/4x2 Toyotas crossing deep puddles; rusted check-valve breather
symptoms: Gear oil weeping from rear pinion seal or axle ends
diagnosticSteps: 1. Spin/clean metal breather cap on top of rear axle housing (must rattle freely!). 2. Extend breather line if fording floods. 3. Replace pinion/axle seal.

domainName: Toyota / Lexus Specific Platform Faults (Vios, Innova, Hilux, Fortuner, HiAce, Wigo)
title: Toyota Vios / Innova Speedometer Dead — ABS-to-Cluster Signal
phContext: Toyota without transmission VSS (uses ABS wheel speeds via CAN/SP1)
symptoms: Speedo at 0, EPS heavy, P0500 in ECM
diagnosticSteps: 1. Scan ABS module for wheel speed sensor C-codes! 2. Check SP1 speed output wire from ABS/Skid Control ECU to Combination Meter & ECM. 3. Fix ABS sensor.

domainName: Toyota / Lexus Specific Platform Faults (Vios, Innova, Hilux, Fortuner, HiAce, Wigo)
title: Toyota Vios Gen 3 (1NR-FE) A/C Magnetic Clutch vs. ECV Valve
phContext: Toyota Vios 2014–2022; clutchless variable-displacement compressor
symptoms: A/C warm at idle, cools only above 2500 RPM
diagnosticSteps: 1. Confirm compressor has no external clutch plate (ECV controlled). 2. Check ECV PWM current PID and manifold pressures. 3. Replace ECV solenoid valve on compressor.

domainName: Toyota / Lexus Specific Platform Faults (Vios, Innova, Hilux, Fortuner, HiAce, Wigo)
title: Toyota Solar Sensor Circuit (Passenger Side) — Normal Indoor Flag
phContext: All Toyota Auto-A/C vehicles scanned inside shaded workshop
symptoms: B1421 / B1424 stored in A/C Amplifier
diagnosticSteps: 1. Shine bright flashlight onto dashboard solar sensor near windshield and rescan (if B1421 clears, sensor is 100% normal!). 2. Only repair wiring if fault stays active in direct sunlight.

domainName: Toyota / Lexus Specific Platform Faults (Vios, Innova, Hilux, Fortuner, HiAce, Wigo)
title: Toyota Hilux / Fortuner Steering Rack Knock — Plastic Rack Guide
phContext: High-mileage Hilux/Fortuner on rough provincial roads
symptoms: Clunk felt in steering wheel over gravel/lubak
diagnosticSteps: 1. Check intermediate steering shaft U-joint first. 2. Inspect steering rack guide spring & cap behind rack housing (upgrade plastic guide to updated bronze/metal guide). 3. Torque to spec.

domainName: Toyota / Lexus Specific Platform Faults (Vios, Innova, Hilux, Fortuner, HiAce, Wigo)
title: Toyota 1NR-FE / 2NR-FE Camshaft Position Sensor — Oil Seepage
phContext: Vios/Avanza; hardened sensor O-ring leaking oil into plug
symptoms: Long cranking, P0340/P0345
diagnosticSteps: 1. Unplug CMP sensor on cylinder head and check for engine oil inside pins. 2. Measure 5V/GND/Signal. 3. Replace sensor & O-ring.

domainName: Toyota / Lexus Specific Platform Faults (Vios, Innova, Hilux, Fortuner, HiAce, Wigo)
title: Toyota Innova / Fortuner Rear Blower Motor Squeak — Dry Bushings
phContext: MPVs/SUVs with rear ceiling/side A/C blower running 100% in PH heat
symptoms: High-pitched cricket chirp from rear passenger side
diagnosticSteps: 1. Access rear blower motor behind right/left cargo trim panel. 2. Clean dust/hair from squirrel-cage wheel and replace worn motor. 3. Check rear A/C filter.

domainName: Toyota / Lexus Specific Platform Faults (Vios, Innova, Hilux, Fortuner, HiAce, Wigo)
title: Toyota Open in Center Differential Lock Circuit (4WD)
phContext: Full-time 4WD Land Cruiser / Prado / Hilux; seized actuator
symptoms: Center diff light blinking, VSC off
diagnosticSteps: 1. Inspect transfer case actuator plug for mud/water. 2. Test actuator motor and position switches. 3. Clean contacts.

domainName: Toyota / Lexus Specific Platform Faults (Vios, Innova, Hilux, Fortuner, HiAce, Wigo)
title: Toyota Zenix / Corolla Cross HEV — Rear Seat HV Filter Clogged
phContext: Toyota HEVs carrying pets/passengers in dusty Metro Manila
symptoms: HV battery cooling fan louder than normal, reduced EV assist
diagnosticSteps: 1. Pop off plastic intake grille under 2nd-row seat cushion. 2. Wash/replace foam mesh filter and vacuum blower blades. 3. Monitor HV battery temp (<40°C).

domainName: Toyota / Lexus Specific Platform Faults (Vios, Innova, Hilux, Fortuner, HiAce, Wigo)
title: Toyota Throttle Actuator Control Motor Current Range — ETCS Fuse
phContext: Toyota Vios, Innova, Hilux, Fortuner; blown 10A ETCS fuse!
symptoms: Engine idles rough at 1100 RPM, zero gas pedal response!
diagnosticSteps: 1. Check 10A ETCS fuse in engine bay fuse box FIRST! (Classic Toyota P2118 cause). 2. If fuse is good, check throttle motor resistance (1–4 ohms) and ECM driver. 3. Replace fuse/ETC.

domainName: Toyota / Lexus Specific Platform Faults (Vios, Innova, Hilux, Fortuner, HiAce, Wigo)
title: Toyota Wigo / Raize Rear Hatch Rattle — Loose Striker / Bumpers
phContext: Hatchbacks on rough city roads
symptoms: Loud knocking from trunk over every bump
diagnosticSteps: 1. Adjust rubber screw-in bump stops on hatch corners outward 1–2 turns. 2. Wrap electrical tape around latch striker temporarily to confirm noise stops. 3. Align striker.

domainName: Toyota / Lexus Specific Platform Faults (Vios, Innova, Hilux, Fortuner, HiAce, Wigo)
title: Toyota 1KD/2KD EGR Flow — Carbon-Blocked Intake Manifold
phContext: Toyota Hilux/Fortuner/HiAce 2005–2015; thick tar-like intake soot
symptoms: Sluggish below 2000 RPM, black smoke, MIL on
diagnosticSteps: 1. Remove intake manifold elbow, throttle body, and EGR cooler/valve. 2. Scrape/ultrasonic-clean 1 cm thick wet carbon sludge blocking intake runners! 3. Reinstall with new gaskets.

domainName: Toyota / Lexus Specific Platform Faults (Vios, Innova, Hilux, Fortuner, HiAce, Wigo)
title: Toyota Vios / Yaris Headlight Moisture — Missing Rear Rubber Cap
phContext: Cars after DIY LED bulb install where rubber dust boot wasn't seated
symptoms: Heavy fogging inside headlight lens after rain
diagnosticSteps: 1. Remove headlight, blow dry with warm (not hot!) air, and inspect rear bulb rubber boot & vent tubes. 2. Reseat boot tightly around LED heatsink. 3. Check seal.

domainName: Toyota / Lexus Specific Platform Faults (Vios, Innova, Hilux, Fortuner, HiAce, Wigo)
title: Toyota Wireless Door Lock Tuner Fault — Dead Battery / Interference
phContext: Toyota Vios/Innova/Fortuner; keyless remote stops working
symptoms: Remote doesn't lock/unlock, spare remote also fails
diagnosticSteps: 1. Check if aftermarket dashcam/charger is jamming 314/433 MHz RF! 2. Inspect Door Control Receiver in rear C-pillar for water/5V power. 3. Re-register remotes.

domainName: Toyota / Lexus Specific Platform Faults (Vios, Innova, Hilux, Fortuner, HiAce, Wigo)
title: Toyota Hilux / Fortuner Front Wheel Bearing Play — Loose Axle Nut
phContext: 2WD/4WD Hilux/Fortuner; hub bearing wear from flood/oversized tires
symptoms: Humming noise turning left/right, brake pedal knock
diagnosticSteps: 1. Jack front wheel and rock at 12-and-6 o'clock for bearing play. 2. Press out and replace sealed hub bearing unit (don't reuse damaged ABS encoder seal!). 3. Torque axle nut to 235+ N·m.

domainName: Toyota / Lexus Specific Platform Faults (Vios, Innova, Hilux, Fortuner, HiAce, Wigo)
title: Toyota 1NR-FE / 2NR-FE Intake Manifold Gasket Shrinkage
phContext: Toyota Vios/Avanza >80,000 km; hardened orange/black intake O-rings
symptoms: Rough cold idle, LTFT +18%, clears when engine bay heats up
diagnosticSteps: 1. Smoke-test intake manifold runners cold! 2. Spray water/carb cleaner along intake-to-head seam while watching STFT drop. 3. Replace intake manifold gaskets.

domainName: Toyota / Lexus Specific Platform Faults (Vios, Innova, Hilux, Fortuner, HiAce, Wigo)
title: Toyota HiAce Commuter Sliding Window Latch Broken — Rattles
phContext: UV Express HiAce; worn side sliding glass latches
symptoms: Glass slides open on braking, loud rattle
diagnosticSteps: 1. Replace broken plastic window latch and clean aluminum window channel. 2. Check rear hatch struts.

domainName: Toyota / Lexus Specific Platform Faults (Vios, Innova, Hilux, Fortuner, HiAce, Wigo)
title: Toyota System Voltage — Loose Fusible Link Block on Battery (+)
phContext: Toyota Hilux/Fortuner/Innova; cracked 120A/140A clear-top fusible link
symptoms: Intermittent total blackout or no-charge
diagnosticSteps: 1. Inspect clear-top multi-fuse block bolted directly to positive battery clamp for hairline solder/strip cracks. 2. Torque M6/M8 terminal nuts. 3. Replace fusible link block.

domainName: Mitsubishi Specific Platform Faults (Xpander, Montero Sport, Strada, Mirage, L300)
title: Mitsubishi Mirage (3A92) MAP/Throttle Carbon — Stalls at Idle
phContext: Mitsubishi Mirage / Mirage G4; heavy city idling carbon
symptoms: Stumbles/stalls turning A/C on at stoplight, rough 3-cyl shake
diagnosticSteps: 1. Clean throttle body bore and MAP sensor port on intake manifold. 2. Inspect 3-cylinder motor mounts (right hydraulic mount collapses early). 3. Perform idle relearn.

domainName: Mitsubishi Specific Platform Faults (Xpander, Montero Sport, Strada, Mirage, L300)
title: Mitsubishi Mirage / Lancer Jatco CVT7 Low Secondary Pressure
phContext: Mirage CVT >60,000 km with unserviced J4 CVTF & paper filter
symptoms: High-pitched whine, sluggish launch, P0868
diagnosticSteps: 1. Check CVTF level hot in Neutral/Park per OEM dipstick! 2. Drop pan, clean strainer, and replace external paper cartridge oil cooler filter! 3. Refill genuine Mitsubishi CVTF-J4.

domainName: Mitsubishi Specific Platform Faults (Xpander, Montero Sport, Strada, Mirage, L300)
title: Mitsubishi Montero / Strada (4D56 / 4N15) SCV Hunting Idle
phContext: Montero Sport / Strada; worn Denso Suction Control Valve
symptoms: RPM surges up and down at idle, stalls coming to a stop
diagnosticSteps: 1. Monitor Fuel Rail Pressure PID (fluctuates +/- 5 MPa at idle). 2. Replace SCV on HP pump and perform 'Small Injection Quantity Learning' via MUT-III / scan tool. 3. Replace fuel filter.

domainName: Mitsubishi Specific Platform Faults (Xpander, Montero Sport, Strada, Mirage, L300)
title: Mitsubishi Montero / Strada 4D56 VGT Overboost — Soot-Stuck Vanes
phContext: 2011–2015 Montero/Strada VGT; short city trips locking turbo vanes
symptoms: Sudden limp mode at 90–100 km/h highway overtake, clears on restart
diagnosticSteps: 1. Disconnect VGT actuator vacuum/electronic rod and move vane lever by hand (stiff/sticky = soot!). 2. Check VGT vacuum solenoid filter/hoses. 3. Decarbonize VGT nozzle ring.

domainName: Mitsubishi Specific Platform Faults (Xpander, Montero Sport, Strada, Mirage, L300)
title: Mitsubishi Xpander Fuel Pump Recall / Vapor Lock Hot Stall
phContext: 2018–2021 Mitsubishi Xpander (4A91); swollen low-pressure impeller
symptoms: Engine cranks no start or stalls in hot Metro Manila traffic
diagnosticSteps: 1. Check if fuel pump recall campaign was completed! 2. Test fuel pressure hot (spec 320–350 kPa) and pump amp draw. 3. Replace updated fuel pump assembly.

domainName: Mitsubishi Specific Platform Faults (Xpander, Montero Sport, Strada, Mirage, L300)
title: Mitsubishi Xpander Front Shock Absorber Oil Leak — Early Failure
phContext: Xpander loaded with 7 passengers on rough roads
symptoms: Clunking over speed bumps, oily front strut shaft
diagnosticSteps: 1. Inspect front strut shafts and bump stops for wet oil. 2. Replace front struts + upper strut mounts/bearings in pairs. 3. Check stabilizer links.

domainName: Mitsubishi Specific Platform Faults (Xpander, Montero Sport, Strada, Mirage, L300)
title: Mitsubishi Montero Sport (2016+) Electronic Parking Brake Stuck
phContext: Montero Sport GLS/GT; flood mud or low battery jamming rear EPB
symptoms: EPB warning light on dash, rear brakes drag
diagnosticSteps: 1. Check 12V battery voltage (>12.2V). 2. Inspect rear axle-mounted EPB actuator cables/connectors for mud/water. 3. Run EPB calibration via scan tool.

domainName: Mitsubishi Specific Platform Faults (Xpander, Montero Sport, Strada, Mirage, L300)
title: Mitsubishi ETACS (BCM) Missing CAN Message — Loose Junction Plug
phContext: Mitsubishi Xpander, Montero, Mirage, Strada
symptoms: Wipers/lights/locks glitch, U1102/U1100 stored
diagnosticSteps: 1. Inspect ETACS ECU plugged into cabin fuse box at driver knee for loose connectors or water drips from windshield/cowl. 2. Reseat all plugs and check grounds. 3. Clear U-codes.

domainName: Mitsubishi Specific Platform Faults (Xpander, Montero Sport, Strada, Mirage, L300)
title: Mitsubishi L300 Euro-4 (4N14) DPF / EGR Soot Limp Mode
phContext: Commercial L300 Euro-4 delivery vans idling in city traffic
symptoms: DPF light flashing, max 2500 RPM limp mode
diagnosticSteps: 1. Check DPF Diff Pressure & Soot Mass PIDs. 2. Clean EGR valve and intake throttle butterfly (often caked shut!). 3. Perform forced DPF regen after oil check.

domainName: Mitsubishi Specific Platform Faults (Xpander, Montero Sport, Strada, Mirage, L300)
title: Mitsubishi Montero / Strada Rear Differential Clunk — Spline/Mount
phContext: Montero Sport / Strada; dry driveshaft slip yoke or torn diff mount
symptoms: Clunk felt from rear 1 second after stopping or releasing brake
diagnosticSteps: 1. Grease rear driveshaft slip yoke splines with moly grease! 2. Inspect rear differential mounting bushings and U-joints. 3. Torque flange bolts.

domainName: Mitsubishi Specific Platform Faults (Xpander, Montero Sport, Strada, Mirage, L300)
title: Mitsubishi 4N15 EGR Valve & Cooler Clogged — Carbon + Oil
phContext: 2016+ Montero Sport / Strada 2.4 MIVEC Diesel
symptoms: Sluggish takeoff, MIL on, P0401
diagnosticSteps: 1. Remove electronic EGR valve and intake manifold elbow to clean wet EGR soot. 2. Check EGR cooler bypass flap. 3. Run EGR position learn.

domainName: Mitsubishi Specific Platform Faults (Xpander, Montero Sport, Strada, Mirage, L300)
title: Mitsubishi Mirage G4 Rear Wheel Bearing Roar (Early 40k km)
phContext: Mirage G4 / Hatchback hitting potholes or flooded streets
symptoms: Loud humming from rear at 50+ km/h
diagnosticSteps: 1. Lift rear wheels and spin by hand while holding trailing arm to feel roughness. 2. Press/replace rear hub bearing assembly (check ABS magnetic seal orientation!).

domainName: Mitsubishi Specific Platform Faults (Xpander, Montero Sport, Strada, Mirage, L300)
title: Mitsubishi Xpander / Montero Keyless Fob 'Key Not Found' — RF Interference
phContext: Push-start Mitsubishi; phone or dashcam near center console
symptoms: Must hold key fob against Start button or slot to start
diagnosticSteps: 1. Replace CR2032 fob battery (>3.0V). 2. Move phone/metallic tint/dashcam away from console slot. 3. Inspect KOS-ECU antenna connectors.

domainName: Mitsubishi Specific Platform Faults (Xpander, Montero Sport, Strada, Mirage, L300)
title: Mitsubishi 4D56 MAF Sensor Plausibility — Split Intercooler Hose
phContext: Montero Sport / Strada 4D56; split lower rubber turbo hose
symptoms: Black smoke, P1235/P0299, limp mode
diagnosticSteps: 1. Inspect flexible rubber boost hose between turbo/intercooler and intake manifold for oil-soaked splits! 2. Replace hose with silicone/OEM upgrade. 3. Clean MAF.

domainName: Mitsubishi Specific Platform Faults (Xpander, Montero Sport, Strada, Mirage, L300)
title: Mitsubishi Adventure / L300 (4D56 Non-CRDi) Timing Belt & Balance Belt
phContext: Older mechanical 4D56 vans/AUVs; snapped balance shaft belt
symptoms: Sudden loud bang or engine locks up if balance belt tangles timing belt!
diagnosticSteps: 1. Replace BOTH timing belt AND balance shaft belt + tensioners every 80,000 km! 2. Inspect crankshaft front oil seal for leaks onto belt.

domainName: Mitsubishi Specific Platform Faults (Xpander, Montero Sport, Strada, Mirage, L300)
title: Mitsubishi SRS Clock Spring / Steering Angle Fault
phContext: Montero Sport, Strada, Xpander; broken clock spring
symptoms: Airbag light + horn/audio buttons dead
diagnosticSteps: 1. Disconnect battery 10 min; check D-Squib resistance PID. 2. Replace clock spring (align SAS straight ahead!). 3. Clear SRS & calibrate SAS.

domainName: Mitsubishi Specific Platform Faults (Xpander, Montero Sport, Strada, Mirage, L300)
title: Mitsubishi Montero (4D56) Black Smoke & Knock — Uncoded/Worn Injectors
phContext: High-mileage 2009–2015 Montero Sport
symptoms: Heavy black smoke under load, rattling acceleration
diagnosticSteps: 1. Check injector compensation codes in ECM against physical injector IDs. 2. Perform return leak-off test. 3. Rebuild/replace injectors and code.

domainName: Mitsubishi Specific Platform Faults (Xpander, Montero Sport, Strada, Mirage, L300)
title: Mitsubishi Xpander 4AT (U440E) Shift Solenoid / ATF Overdue
phContext: Xpander 4-speed AT >60,000 km; dark burnt ATF
symptoms: Harsh 1-2 shift, delayed Reverse
diagnosticSteps: 1. Drain-and-fill genuine Mitsubishi ATF-PA / SP-III (never generic Dexron if spec'd PA) and replace strainer. 2. Check shifter cable bushing.

domainName: Mitsubishi Specific Platform Faults (Xpander, Montero Sport, Strada, Mirage, L300)
title: Mitsubishi 4N15 / 4D56 Fuel Rail Pressure Sensor High — Open Ground
phContext: Montero/Strada; brittle 3-pin connector on common rail
symptoms: Cranks no start or immediate limp mode
diagnosticSteps: 1. Check 5V, GND, and signal at FRP plug. 2. Inspect harness bend near fuel rail end. 3. Replace pigtail/sensor.

domainName: Mitsubishi Specific Platform Faults (Xpander, Montero Sport, Strada, Mirage, L300)
title: Mitsubishi Strada / Triton Leaf Spring Bushings Squeak & Clunk
phContext: Work pickups carrying heavy loads on rough roads
symptoms: Squeaking/popping from rear bed over bumps
diagnosticSteps: 1. Inspect rear leaf spring shackle polyurethane/rubber bushings and center pin. 2. Replace worn bushings and torque U-bolts.

domainName: Mitsubishi Specific Platform Faults (Xpander, Montero Sport, Strada, Mirage, L300)
title: Mitsubishi Xpander (4A91) Misfire — Water in Spark Plug Wells
phContext: Xpander after engine bay pressure-washing; water trapped under coil boots
symptoms: Rough shaking, flashing MIL right after car wash
diagnosticSteps: 1. Remove all 4 ignition coils, blow compressed air down spark plug wells to dry water! 2. Inspect coil boots for carbon tracking. 3. Replace damaged boots/plugs.

domainName: Mitsubishi Specific Platform Faults (Xpander, Montero Sport, Strada, Mirage, L300)
title: Mitsubishi Mirage Clutch Cable / Release Bearing Noise (Manual)
phContext: Manual Mirage G4 / Hatchback in heavy city traffic
symptoms: Whirring noise when clutch pedal is released, stops when pressed
diagnosticSteps: 1. Inspect clutch cable adjustment (Mirage manual uses cable, not hydraulic!). 2. Replace noisy throwout/input bearing with clutch kit.

domainName: Mitsubishi Specific Platform Faults (Xpander, Montero Sport, Strada, Mirage, L300)
title: Mitsubishi ABS Torque Request Denied — Engine MIL Active
phContext: Montero Sport, Xpander, Strada; secondary ABS flag
symptoms: ASC/TCL Off warning + Check Engine Light
diagnosticSteps: 1. Scan Engine ECM for primary DTC (e.g., P0087, P0401, P0300). 2. Fix engine fault first. 3. Clear ABS C121C.

domainName: Mitsubishi Specific Platform Faults (Xpander, Montero Sport, Strada, Mirage, L300)
title: Mitsubishi Montero Sport Steering Column Clunk — Intermediate Shaft
phContext: 2009–2022 Montero Sport / Strada; dry sliding spline in steering shaft
symptoms: Light rattle/knock in steering wheel over small bumps
diagnosticSteps: 1. Disconnect lower steering intermediate shaft spline, pack with thick lithium/moly grease, and cycle in/out. 2. Check U-joints for play.

domainName: Mitsubishi Specific Platform Faults (Xpander, Montero Sport, Strada, Mirage, L300)
title: Mitsubishi Engine Control Relay Fault — Corroded Engine Fuse Box
phContext: Mirage, Xpander, Montero; relay socket heat/moisture
symptoms: Cranks no start, no MIL at KOEO
diagnosticSteps: 1. Swap Engine Control / ECI Main Relay in engine bay box. 2. Inspect relay socket blades for spread/corrosion. 3. Check IG1 feed.

domainName: Mitsubishi Specific Platform Faults (Xpander, Montero Sport, Strada, Mirage, L300)
title: Mitsubishi L300 / Adventure Radiator Fan Shroud & Aux Fan Dead
phContext: Under-seat engine vans; mud-packed under-floor A/C condenser fan
symptoms: Overheats in traffic with A/C on
diagnosticSteps: 1. Check under-floor A/C condenser fan motor and 30A fuse. 2. Flush mud from condenser & radiator fins. 3. Test viscous fan clutch.

domainName: Mitsubishi Specific Platform Faults (Xpander, Montero Sport, Strada, Mirage, L300)
title: Mitsubishi Mirage / Xpander Cat Efficiency Low — O2/Oil
phContext: High-mileage Grab/delivery Mirage G4 & Xpander
symptoms: MIL on, failed emission
diagnosticSteps: 1. Check upstream/downstream O2 waveforms. 2. Inspect for exhaust flex-pipe leak before cat. 3. Replace fouled catalyst.

domainName: Mitsubishi Specific Platform Faults (Xpander, Montero Sport, Strada, Mirage, L300)
title: Mitsubishi Montero 4N15 Timing Chain Tensioner Rattle
phContext: 2016+ Montero/Strada 2.4L >120,000 km; extended chain tensioner
symptoms: Metallic rattle at cold start
diagnosticSteps: 1. Inspect timing chain tensioner extension and oil level. 2. Replace chain, guides, and tensioner if rattling persists warm.

domainName: Mitsubishi Specific Platform Faults (Xpander, Montero Sport, Strada, Mirage, L300)
title: Mitsubishi Mirage / Xpander A/C Compressor Clutch Gap Too Wide
phContext: City cars >70,000 km; A/C cuts out after 20 min in heat
symptoms: Blows cold then warm in traffic, clutch fails to engage hot
diagnosticSteps: 1. Measure A/C clutch hub air gap (spec 0.35–0.65 mm; >0.8 mm = slips hot!). 2. Remove thin shim washer or replace clutch.

domainName: Mitsubishi Specific Platform Faults (Xpander, Montero Sport, Strada, Mirage, L300)
title: Mitsubishi ETACS Coding Lost / Mismatch After Battery Drain
phContext: Mirage, Xpander, Montero; corrupted variant coding
symptoms: Wipers/lights/keyless act strange
diagnosticSteps: 1. Check ETACS variant coding via MUT-III/scan tool (country, auto-light, keyless options). 2. Restore factory coding. 3. Clear codes.

domainName: Mitsubishi Specific Platform Faults (Xpander, Montero Sport, Strada, Mirage, L300)
title: Mitsubishi IAT Sensor High — Integrated in MAF Unplugged
phContext: All Mitsubishi EFI/CRDi; loose 5-pin MAF/IAT plug
symptoms: MIL on, IAT reads -40°C
diagnosticSteps: 1. Reseat MAF/IAT connector until tab clicks. 2. Check pin tension. 3. Clear code.

domainName: Mitsubishi Specific Platform Faults (Xpander, Montero Sport, Strada, Mirage, L300)
title: Mitsubishi Strada / Montero Brake Booster Vacuum Leak — Check Valve
phContext: Diesel 4D56/4N15; cracked rubber hose to alternator vacuum pump
symptoms: Hard brake pedal, hissing under hood
diagnosticSteps: 1. Inspect vacuum hose from alternator pump to brake booster and check valve direction. 2. Test vacuum (-75 kPa). 3. Replace cracked hose.

domainName: Mitsubishi Specific Platform Faults (Xpander, Montero Sport, Strada, Mirage, L300)
title: Mitsubishi Xpander Tailgate Latch Microswitch Water Ingress
phContext: Xpander exposed to monsoon rain; hatch button dead
symptoms: Tailgate won't open from outside push button
diagnosticSteps: 1. Remove tailgate inner panel, unplug rubber-booted release switch, and dry/replace corroded microswitch. 2. Test latch actuator.

domainName: Mitsubishi Specific Platform Faults (Xpander, Montero Sport, Strada, Mirage, L300)
title: Mitsubishi 4D56 Boost Pressure Control — Split Vacuum Solenoid Hose
phContext: Montero/Strada 4D56; brittle small rubber vacuum lines on turbo solenoid
symptoms: Sluggish acceleration, limp mode
diagnosticSteps: 1. Inspect all 4mm rubber vacuum hoses at VGT solenoid on right inner fender for hairline splits/popped ends! 2. Replace with silicone vacuum hose.

domainName: Mitsubishi Specific Platform Faults (Xpander, Montero Sport, Strada, Mirage, L300)
title: Mitsubishi Mirage G4 Power Steering Heavy — EPS Column Fuse/Module
phContext: Mirage Hatchback/G4; low 12V or EPS ECU fault
symptoms: EPS light on, heavy steering
diagnosticSteps: 1. Check 50A/60A EPS fuse on battery (+) terminal block. 2. Scan EPS for torque sensor/motor DTCs. 3. Load-test 12V battery.

domainName: Mitsubishi Specific Platform Faults (Xpander, Montero Sport, Strada, Mirage, L300)
title: Mitsubishi Inhibitor (Range) Switch Water Ingress
phContext: Xpander 4AT, Montero 5AT/8AT, Mirage CVT; splash on side switch
symptoms: No-crank in Park, blank gear display
diagnosticSteps: 1. Check PRNDL PIDs while shifting. 2. Clean/replace inhibitor switch on side of transmission. 3. Align Neutral mark.

domainName: Mitsubishi Specific Platform Faults (Xpander, Montero Sport, Strada, Mirage, L300)
title: Mitsubishi Montero Sport 8-Speed AT (Aisin) ATF Temp Check Error
phContext: 2016+ Montero 8AT; overfilled/underfilled ATF at wrong temp
symptoms: Harsh downshifts, flare on 3-4
diagnosticSteps: 1. Check ATF level strictly at 40°C fluid temp with engine idling in Park via overflow plug! 2. Use genuine Mitsubishi ATF-MA1 / Aisin AW-1.

domainName: Mitsubishi Specific Platform Faults (Xpander, Montero Sport, Strada, Mirage, L300)
title: Mitsubishi Speed Signal Fault — ABS Sensor / Cluster
phContext: Xpander, Mirage, Montero; missing wheel speed input
symptoms: Speedo drops to 0, ABS light on
diagnosticSteps: 1. Scan ABS for wheel speed C-codes. 2. Fix faulty sensor. 3. Clear ECM P0500.

domainName: Mitsubishi Specific Platform Faults (Xpander, Montero Sport, Strada, Mirage, L300)
title: Mitsubishi L300 / Adventure Leaf Spring Center Bolt Sheared
phContext: Overloaded commercial units hitting potholes
symptoms: Rear axle shifted crooked, steering wheel off-center
diagnosticSteps: 1. Inspect leaf spring U-bolts and center locating pin sitting in axle perch. 2. Replace sheared center bolt and torque U-bolts.

domainName: Mitsubishi Specific Platform Faults (Xpander, Montero Sport, Strada, Mirage, L300)
title: Mitsubishi Xpander / Mirage Lean Trim — Weak Fuel Pump / Vacuum
phContext: High-mileage 4A91 / 3A92; clogged fuel filter or cracked PCV hose
symptoms: Hesitation, LTFT > +15%
diagnosticSteps: 1. Check fuel pressure (320–350 kPa) and smoke-test intake. 2. Replace in-tank fuel filter. 3. Clean MAF/MAP.

domainName: Mitsubishi Specific Platform Faults (Xpander, Montero Sport, Strada, Mirage, L300)
title: Mitsubishi Montero Sport Front Lower Control Arm Camber Bolts Seized
phContext: Montero/Strada >5 years; rusted alignment eccentric bolts
symptoms: Cannot adjust front camber/caster at alignment shop
diagnosticSteps: 1. Rusted cam bolts seize inside steel sleeve of control arm bushing! 2. Cut old bolts carefully, replace lower arm bushings + new greased cam bolts. 3. Align.

domainName: Mitsubishi Specific Platform Faults (Xpander, Montero Sport, Strada, Mirage, L300)
title: Mitsubishi 4D56 / 4G63 Crankshaft Position Sensor Blade Melt
phContext: Older Mitsubishi timing-belt engines; CKP sensor behind crank pulley
symptoms: Stalls hot, no spark/fuel
diagnosticSteps: 1. Inspect CKP sensor behind crank sprocket for rubbing against damaged timing reluctor blade! 2. Scope CKP Hall signal. 3. Replace sensor.

domainName: Mitsubishi Specific Platform Faults (Xpander, Montero Sport, Strada, Mirage, L300)
title: Mitsubishi Xpander / Mirage Horn Dead — Spiral Cable Ribbon
phContext: High-mileage city units; worn clock spring horn trace
symptoms: Horn doesn't work straight ahead, works when turned
diagnosticSteps: 1. Jump horn relay to confirm horn & fuse work. 2. Check continuity through clock spring. 3. Replace spiral cable.

domainName: Mitsubishi Specific Platform Faults (Xpander, Montero Sport, Strada, Mirage, L300)
title: Mitsubishi TCM-to-ECM Torque Reduction Comm Fault
phContext: Montero, Strada, Xpander; CAN timeout or TCM fault
symptoms: Limp mode, AT light flashing
diagnosticSteps: 1. Scan TCM for primary transmission DTCs. 2. Check CAN-H/L resistance (60 ohms). 3. Clear codes.

domainName: Mitsubishi Specific Platform Faults (Xpander, Montero Sport, Strada, Mirage, L300)
title: Mitsubishi 4N15 DPF Pressure Sensor Hose Split (2016+ Euro-4)
phContext: Montero/Strada Euro-4; heat-cracked rubber sensor pipe
symptoms: DPF warning light, limp mode
diagnosticSteps: 1. Inspect short silicone/rubber hoses connecting DPF metal pipes to pressure sensor on firewall. 2. Replace cracked hoses and reset DPF.

domainName: Ford & Mazda Specific Platform Faults (Ranger, Everest, Territory, EcoSport, Mazda)
title: Ford DPS6 (Fiesta / EcoSport) Transmission Friction Element Stuck
phContext: Ford Fiesta/EcoSport PowerShift; rusted clutch fork in PH humidity
symptoms: Violent shuddering, no Reverse, 'Transmission Malfunction'
diagnosticSteps: 1. Check battery voltage (>12.4V!). 2. Swap clutch actuator motors A & B to test motor vs. internal fork bind. 3. Pull transmission, clean/replace dual clutch & forks, run TCM adaptive learn.

domainName: Ford & Mazda Specific Platform Faults (Ranger, Everest, Territory, EcoSport, Mazda)
title: Ford Fiesta / EcoSport DPS6 TCM Internal Failure (Recall/Heat)
phContext: 2011–2019 Fiesta/EcoSport; overheated TCM mounted on front of gearbox
symptoms: No-crank, gear indicator missing 'PRNDS', no comm with TCM
diagnosticSteps: 1. Check TCM 12V/GND at main plug under airbox. 2. If powers/grounds are solid under load and CAN is 60 ohms, TCM internal driver/wire-bonds failed! 3. Replace & program TCM.

domainName: Ford & Mazda Specific Platform Faults (Ranger, Everest, Territory, EcoSport, Mazda)
title: Ford Ranger / Everest 2.2/3.2 EGR Cooler Leak — Coolant Loss
phContext: 2012–2019 Ranger/Everest (Puma 2.2/3.2); cracked internal EGR cooler
symptoms: Mystery coolant loss with no ground drip, white exhaust steam
diagnosticSteps: 1. Pressure-test cooling system cold while borescoping intake/exhaust side of EGR cooler for green/orange coolant! 2. Replace EGR cooler (prevents hydrolock!). 3. Flush coolant.

domainName: Ford & Mazda Specific Platform Faults (Ranger, Everest, Territory, EcoSport, Mazda)
title: Ford Ranger / Everest 2.2/3.2 Variable-Vane Oil Pump Failure
phContext: 2012–2019 Ranger/Everest; pump drained dry during slow oil change!
symptoms: Zero oil pressure after oil change >10 minutes! Engine knock risk
diagnosticSteps: 1. CRITICAL PH RULE: Complete Puma 2.2/3.2 oil changes within 10 minutes — never leave pan draining overnight (vane pump loses prime!). 2. If unprimed, pack pump or pressure-prime via oil gallery!

domainName: Ford & Mazda Specific Platform Faults (Ranger, Everest, Territory, EcoSport, Mazda)
title: Ford Ranger / Everest 2.0 Bi-Turbo Plastic Intake Manifold Crack
phContext: 2019+ Ranger/Everest 2.0 Bi-Turbo; warped/split composite manifold
symptoms: Hissing under boost, oil mist on side of block, limp mode
diagnosticSteps: 1. Pressure-test intake tract to 100 kPa and spray soapy water along plastic intake manifold seam! 2. Replace cracked manifold + gaskets. 3. Check intercooler hoses.

domainName: Ford & Mazda Specific Platform Faults (Ranger, Everest, Territory, EcoSport, Mazda)
title: Ford 10R80 (10-Speed AT) CDF Drum / Harsh 3-4-7 Shift
phContext: 2019+ Ranger/Everest 2.0 Bi-Turbo 10AT; shifted CDF sleeve or valve body
symptoms: Harsh clunk on 3-4 or 7-8, delayed engagement
diagnosticSteps: 1. Check ULV ATF level at 96–101°C operating temp! 2. Clear TCM adaptive tables and update PCM/TCM calibration. 3. Inspect valve body/CDF bushing if harshness persists.

domainName: Ford & Mazda Specific Platform Faults (Ranger, Everest, Territory, EcoSport, Mazda)
title: Ford Everest / Ranger (2007–2014) Instrument Cluster Cold Solder
phContext: Gen 1/2 Everest & Ranger; PATS immobilizer inside cluster
symptoms: Gauges drop dead while driving, rapid red padlock flash, no-crank
diagnosticSteps: 1. Tap top of cluster bezel while key ON (gauges jump = confirmed!). 2. Remove cluster, reflow all 32-pin connector solder joints + voltage regulator. 3. Clear U1900.

domainName: Ford & Mazda Specific Platform Faults (Ranger, Everest, Territory, EcoSport, Mazda)
title: Ford Key-In-Ignition Switch / PATS Transceiver Fault
phContext: Ford Ranger/EcoSport/Fiesta; worn transceiver ring or key
symptoms: Red padlock blinks fast, no crank
diagnosticSteps: 1. Read PATS Key Count and Transceiver Status PIDs in BCM/IPC. 2. Try spare key. 3. Check 4-pin PATS ring connector around ignition lock.

domainName: Ford & Mazda Specific Platform Faults (Ranger, Everest, Territory, EcoSport, Mazda)
title: Ford EcoSport / Fiesta Rear Hatch Won't Open — Broken Microswitch
phContext: EcoSport/Fiesta hatchbacks; waterlogged tailgate handle switch
symptoms: Tailgate handle button dead
diagnosticSteps: 1. Check if hatch unlocks with key fob button. 2. Remove rear handle trim and test 2-pin microswitch continuity. 3. Replace switch (check trunk hinge wires too).

domainName: Ford & Mazda Specific Platform Faults (Ranger, Everest, Territory, EcoSport, Mazda)
title: Ford Territory (1.5T EcoBoost / CVT) Belt/Shudder & Cooling
phContext: Ford Territory Gen 1/2; heavy traffic CVT heat & thermostat
symptoms: CVT shudder at low speed, fan runs loudly
diagnosticSteps: 1. Check CVT fluid condition & level (service every 40,000 km in PH traffic!). 2. Inspect electric cooling fan & thermostat housing for coolant seep. 3. Reset CVT adaptation.

domainName: Ford & Mazda Specific Platform Faults (Ranger, Everest, Territory, EcoSport, Mazda)
title: Ford EcoSport / Fiesta / Focus Plastic Thermostat Housing Leak
phContext: 1.5L/1.6L Ti-VCT & 1.0 EcoBoost; warped plastic water outlet
symptoms: Slow coolant loss, P0128, temp needle drops on highway
diagnosticSteps: 1. Inspect plastic thermostat/water outlet housing on driver side of cylinder head for pink/orange crust. 2. Replace housing + thermostat + O-ring. 3. Bleed thoroughly.

domainName: Ford & Mazda Specific Platform Faults (Ranger, Everest, Territory, EcoSport, Mazda)
title: Mazda 2 / 3 / CX-5 Skyactiv-G 'i-Stop' + Master Warning Blinking
phContext: Mazda Skyactiv; aging EFB battery (Q-85) below 70% SOH
symptoms: Amber i-Stop flashing + Battery Management System Inspection Required
diagnosticSteps: 1. Load-test Q-85 EFB battery (Mazda i-Stop triggers warning the moment SOH drops!). 2. Replace with Q-85 EFB battery and perform Mazda BMS Current Sensor Initialization. 3. Clear codes.

domainName: Ford & Mazda Specific Platform Faults (Ranger, Everest, Territory, EcoSport, Mazda)
title: Mazda 3 / CX-5 / CX-3 Power Folding Mirror Stuck — Plastic Gear/Motor
phContext: Mazda vehicles washed with pressure washer at mirror pivot
symptoms: Mirror motor runs nonstop or refuses to fold
diagnosticSteps: 1. Inspect mirror actuator gear & waterproof seal (Mazda TSB updated waterproof motor kit!). 2. Replace faulty mirror actuator. 3. Lubricate pivot.

domainName: Ford & Mazda Specific Platform Faults (Ranger, Everest, Territory, EcoSport, Mazda)
title: Mazda Skyactiv-G / Ford Ti-VCT Intake Cam Phaser / OCV
phContext: Mazda 2/3/CX-5, Ford Fiesta; sludge or weak OCV
symptoms: Rough idle, P0011/P0012
diagnosticSteps: 1. Check oil level and cleanliness. 2. Command OCV active test via scan tool. 3. Replace OCV solenoid.

domainName: Ford & Mazda Specific Platform Faults (Ranger, Everest, Territory, EcoSport, Mazda)
title: Ford Ranger / Everest Brake Vacuum Pump / Booster Hiss
phContext: Ranger/Everest 2.2/3.2; torn brake pedal boot or hose
symptoms: Hard brake pedal, hissing noise at feet
diagnosticSteps: 1. Check vacuum pump output (-75 kPa). 2. Listen at brake pedal pushrod inside cabin while pressing pedal. 3. Replace brake booster.

domainName: Ford & Mazda Specific Platform Faults (Ranger, Everest, Territory, EcoSport, Mazda)
title: Ford / Mazda Internal Control Module Non-Volatile RAM Error
phContext: Ford Ranger/Everest after dead battery cranking
symptoms: MIL on, P06B8 stored
diagnosticSteps: 1. Load-test battery and clear DTC. 2. If P06B8 returns immediately at every key cycle, update PCM firmware via IDS/FDRS or replace PCM.

domainName: Ford & Mazda Specific Platform Faults (Ranger, Everest, Territory, EcoSport, Mazda)
title: Ford Ranger / Mazda BT-50 Center Console A/C Blows Hot Only on Driver
phContext: Dual-zone climate Everest/Ranger/CX-5; stripped blend door actuator
symptoms: Passenger side ice cold, driver side blows hot outside air!
diagnosticSteps: 1. Scan HVAC module for Left Temperature Blend Door Actuator DTCs. 2. Remove driver-side lower dash panel to access white blend actuator (stripped plastic gear/shaft). 3. Replace & calibrate.

domainName: Ford & Mazda Specific Platform Faults (Ranger, Everest, Territory, EcoSport, Mazda)
title: Ford Everest / Ranger 2.0 Euro-4/5 DPF Cracked — Black Tailpipe
phContext: Ranger/Everest 2.0/2.2; soot inside tailpipe
symptoms: DPF light on, P2002, black soot wiping off tailpipe
diagnosticSteps: 1. Wipe inside of exhaust tailpipe with finger (clean = good DPF; black soot = cracked DPF substrate!). 2. Check diff pressure sensor hoses. 3. Replace DPF.

domainName: Ford & Mazda Specific Platform Faults (Ranger, Everest, Territory, EcoSport, Mazda)
title: Ford Fiesta / EcoSport Dual-Clutch Fork Dust Jam — High Traffic
phContext: DPS6 dry dual clutch in Metro Manila crawling traffic
symptoms: Judder on 1st-2nd upshift, squeaking clutch fork
diagnosticSteps: 1. Educate driver: avoid creeping at 3 km/h on brake; let gap open then roll cleanly! 2. Inspect clutch wear PIDs (A & B touch points). 3. Replace clutch kit & forks.

domainName: Ford & Mazda Specific Platform Faults (Ranger, Everest, Territory, EcoSport, Mazda)
title: Mazda Skyactiv-G / Ford Fiesta Exhaust Manifold Cat Fault
phContext: High-mileage Skyactiv / Ti-VCT; fouled catalyst or exhaust leak
symptoms: MIL on, normal performance
diagnosticSteps: 1. Check exhaust flex-pipe & manifold gasket for leaks. 2. Compare wideband B1S1 vs. B1S2 O2. 3. Replace catalyst.

domainName: Ford & Mazda Specific Platform Faults (Ranger, Everest, Territory, EcoSport, Mazda)
title: Ford Ranger / Everest 4x4 Transfer Case Motor Wire Chafed
phContext: Off-roaded Ranger/Everest; wire rubbing frame crossmember
symptoms: 4WD wrench light on, won't shift 4H/4L
diagnosticSteps: 1. Inspect 7-wire harness on transfer case shift motor. 2. Repair chafed wire and secure loom. 3. Clear TCCM codes.

domainName: Ford & Mazda Specific Platform Faults (Ranger, Everest, Territory, EcoSport, Mazda)
title: Ford Ranger / EcoSport Right Front Wheel Speed Sensor
phContext: Ranger/Everest hitting deep mud/puddles
symptoms: ABS + Hill Descent + Traction lights on
diagnosticSteps: 1. Unplug RF ABS sensor and check for mud/broken wire near upper control arm. 2. Verify hub bearing play. 3. Replace sensor.

domainName: Ford & Mazda Specific Platform Faults (Ranger, Everest, Territory, EcoSport, Mazda)
title: Mazda CX-5 / Mazda 3 Electronic Parking Brake (EPB) Stuck
phContext: 2016+ Mazda with rear caliper EPB; brake job done without Service Mode!
symptoms: EPB light flashing, rear caliper piston jammed/broken!
diagnosticSteps: 1. NEVER force-twist or C-clamp rear EPB caliper pistons without entering EPB Maintenance Mode first! 2. Put EPB in Maintenance Mode via pedal/switch sequence or scan tool. 3. Replace damaged motor.

domainName: Ford & Mazda Specific Platform Faults (Ranger, Everest, Territory, EcoSport, Mazda)
title: Ford BMS / Smart Charging Error — Aftermarket Dashcam on Constant
phContext: Ford Ranger/Everest; battery drain triggering BMS load-shedding
symptoms: 'System Off to Save Battery' on infotainment screen immediately at key-off
diagnosticSteps: 1. Check battery SOC & health (BMS shuts off radio/accessories if SOC <50%!). 2. Rewire dashcam to ACC/switched fuse with voltage cutoff. 3. Charge & reset BMS.

domainName: Ford & Mazda Specific Platform Faults (Ranger, Everest, Territory, EcoSport, Mazda)
title: Ford Territory / EcoSport Steering Column U-Joint Stiff Spot
phContext: Crossovers crossing flood puddles; rusted lower steering U-joint
symptoms: Steering binds every 180° turn
diagnosticSteps: 1. Inspect lower intermediate shaft U-joint above steering rack. 2. Replace seized shaft and verify steering angle sensor zero.

domainName: Ford & Mazda Specific Platform Faults (Ranger, Everest, Territory, EcoSport, Mazda)
title: Ford Ranger 2.2/3.2 HPFP IMV (Inlet Metering Valve) Failure
phContext: Ranger/Everest >100,000 km; dirty diesel wearing IMV
symptoms: Sudden stall under load, P0251 + P0087
diagnosticSteps: 1. Remove IMV from HP pump and inspect screen for metal glitter (glitter = HP pump failing!). 2. Replace IMV + fuel filter if clean. 3. Run pump learn.

domainName: Ford & Mazda Specific Platform Faults (Ranger, Everest, Territory, EcoSport, Mazda)
title: Mazda Skyactiv-D 2.2 Carbon-Clogged Exhaust Pressure Sensor & Intake
phContext: Mazda CX-5 / Mazda 6 2.2 Diesel; severe EGR soot + oil dilution
symptoms: DPF light, low oil pressure warning, sluggish turbo
diagnosticSteps: 1. Remove intake manifold & Exhaust Pressure Sensor #1 (often completely plugged solid with soot!). 2. Check oil pan pickup strainer & injector copper washers! 3. Decarbonize.

domainName: Ford & Mazda Specific Platform Faults (Ranger, Everest, Territory, EcoSport, Mazda)
title: Ford Cluster (IPC) Lost Comm — Loose Harness / Blown Fuse
phContext: Ford EcoSport/Ranger/Fiesta; dead cluster, no crank
symptoms: Blank gauges, PATS security blocks starter
diagnosticSteps: 1. Check IPC 10A/15A fuses in passenger BCM (under glovebox!). 2. Inspect cluster rear connector. 3. Reflow IPC solder if older Ranger/Everest.

domainName: Ford & Mazda Specific Platform Faults (Ranger, Everest, Territory, EcoSport, Mazda)
title: Ford Ranger / Everest Cooling Fan Clutch Roaring Nonstop
phContext: 2.2/3.2 Ranger; seized viscous fan clutch or broken wire (on electric-viscous)
symptoms: Loud airplane roar at all RPMs, power loss
diagnosticSteps: 1. Inspect electric-viscous fan clutch wiring pigtail at bottom of shroud (often cut by belt/debris!). 2. Test PWM command. 3. Replace seized fan clutch.

domainName: Ford & Mazda Specific Platform Faults (Ranger, Everest, Territory, EcoSport, Mazda)
title: Mazda 2 / 3 Infotainment Ghost Touch (Mazda Connect)
phContext: 2014–2019 Mazda 2/3/CX-5; delaminating touchscreen in PH heat
symptoms: Screen clicks buttons by itself while driving
diagnosticSteps: 1. Disable touch ribbon cable inside Mazda Connect CMU (commander knob on console still controls 100% of functions!) or replace digitizer glass. 2. Update CMU firmware.

domainName: Ford & Mazda Specific Platform Faults (Ranger, Everest, Territory, EcoSport, Mazda)
title: Ford Ranger 2.2/3.2 CKP Sensor — Metal Filings / Clutch Dust
phContext: Manual Ranger/Everest; worn DMF/clutch coating CKP tip
symptoms: Long cranking, intermittent stall
diagnosticSteps: 1. Pull CKP sensor from bellhousing and wipe iron dust off tip. 2. Check DMF play. 3. Scope CKP waveform.

domainName: Ford & Mazda Specific Platform Faults (Ranger, Everest, Territory, EcoSport, Mazda)
title: Ford Fiesta / EcoSport Coolant Degas Tank Cap Failing
phContext: Pressurized expansion tank; micro-cracks on underside of bottle
symptoms: Slow coolant loss, boiling sound after shutdown
diagnosticSteps: 1. Pressure-test system cold and inspect underside of white degas bottle for hairline cracks. 2. Replace bottle + pressure cap together.

domainName: Ford & Mazda Specific Platform Faults (Ranger, Everest, Territory, EcoSport, Mazda)
title: Ford BCM Humidity / Rain Sensor Fault — Windshield Tint
phContext: Ford Everest/Ranger; bubbles or tint blocking rain sensor gel pad
symptoms: Auto-wipers wipe dry glass or fail in rain
diagnosticSteps: 1. Inspect optical silicone gel pad between rain sensor and windshield behind mirror (air bubbles ruin optics!). 2. Replace gel pad cleanly.

domainName: Ford & Mazda Specific Platform Faults (Ranger, Everest, Territory, EcoSport, Mazda)
title: Mazda CX-5 / Mazda 3 Rear Differential Oil Milky (AWD)
phContext: AWD Mazdas crossing flooded roads; low rear diff breather
symptoms: Humming noise from rear above 50 km/h
diagnosticSteps: 1. Pull rear diff fill plug; milky gray oil = water ingress! 2. Drain & refill 80W-90 GL-5 twice. 3. Extend breather.

domainName: Ford & Mazda Specific Platform Faults (Ranger, Everest, Territory, EcoSport, Mazda)
title: Ford Ranger / Everest Starter Relay — Water in Engine Junction Box
phContext: Ranger/Everest washed with pressure washer; damp BJB
symptoms: No-crank, relay clicks
diagnosticSteps: 1. Open Battery Junction Box (BJB) and check starter relay & 30A fuse for moisture. 2. Check neutral/clutch switch PID. 3. Dry & test.

domainName: Ford & Mazda Specific Platform Faults (Ranger, Everest, Territory, EcoSport, Mazda)
title: Ford Territory Ambient Light / Sunroof Drain Leak
phContext: Territory panoramic sunroof; clogged front drains
symptoms: Water dripping onto A-pillar / BCM
diagnosticSteps: 1. Clear front sunroof drain tubes with compressed air/line. 2. Inspect BCM under dash for water stains.

domainName: Ford & Mazda Specific Platform Faults (Ranger, Everest, Territory, EcoSport, Mazda)
title: Ford EcoSport / Fiesta Upstream O2 Heater — Exhaust Splash
phContext: Low-clearance Ford sedans/crossovers hitting puddles
symptoms: MIL on, P0135
diagnosticSteps: 1. Inspect B1S1 connector under car for water. 2. Test heater resistance (4– 12 ohms). 3. Replace sensor.

domainName: Ford & Mazda Specific Platform Faults (Ranger, Everest, Territory, EcoSport, Mazda)
title: Ford Ranger 6R80 Transmission Leadframe / Output Speed Sensor
phContext: 2012–2018 Ranger/Everest 3.2/2.2 6AT; molded leadframe OSS fault
symptoms: Sudden downshift to 1st gear at highway speed!! Wrench light
diagnosticSteps: 1. Scan TCM for P0720/P0722 Output Speed Sensor! 2. Drop pan and replace molded transmission leadframe (mechatronic harness) + bulkhead sleeve O-rings. 3. Refill Mercon LV.

domainName: Ford & Mazda Specific Platform Faults (Ranger, Everest, Territory, EcoSport, Mazda)
title: Mazda 3 / CX-5 Transmission Whine — Pinhole in ATF Cooler/Pan
phContext: Lowered/city Mazdas scraping speed bumps; dented pan starving pickup
symptoms: Whining transmission noise, slipping
diagnosticSteps: 1. Inspect transmission pan bottom for dents pressing against internal filter pickup! 2. Replace dented pan, filter, and Mazda FZ ATF.

domainName: Ford & Mazda Specific Platform Faults (Ranger, Everest, Territory, EcoSport, Mazda)
title: Ford EcoSport EVAP Tank Pressure Sensor Stuck
phContext: EcoSport; clogged vent or skewed FTP sensor
symptoms: MIL on, hard start after refuel
diagnosticSteps: 1. Check FTP PID with gas cap off (must read 0.0). 2. Inspect purge valve & canister vent. 3. Replace FTP.

domainName: Ford & Mazda Specific Platform Faults (Ranger, Everest, Territory, EcoSport, Mazda)
title: Ford Everest Power Liftgate Strut Failure — Broken Internal Wire
phContext: 2016+ Everest Titanium+; power spindle motor wire flex fatigue
symptoms: Liftgate beeps, refuses to open powered
diagnosticSteps: 1. Inspect rubber flex boot at top of power liftgate spindle strut for snapped motor/Hall sensor wire. 2. Replace power strut pair. 3. Re-initialize height.

domainName: Ford & Mazda Specific Platform Faults (Ranger, Everest, Territory, EcoSport, Mazda)
title: Ford Vision System Camera (IPMA) Fault — Rear/Front Camera
phContext: Ranger/Everest/Territory; blurry/blue reverse camera
symptoms: Rear camera flickers or shows 'Camera Unavailable'
diagnosticSteps: 1. Inspect tailgate handle camera connector and tailgate-to-chassis flex loom for broken coax wire! 2. Replace camera module and run LIN/camera calibration.

domainName: Ford & Mazda Specific Platform Faults (Ranger, Everest, Territory, EcoSport, Mazda)
title: Mazda Skyactiv-G High-Pressure Fuel Pump Ticking vs. Injector Knock
phContext: Normal GDI loud ticking noise mistaken by owner for engine knock
symptoms: Rapid metallic ticking at idle with hood open
diagnosticSteps: 1. Use mechanic's stethoscope on cam-driven HPFP vs. cylinder block to confirm normal GDI pump/injector pulse vs. rod knock! 2. Verify zero misfires/codes.

domainName: Ford & Mazda Specific Platform Faults (Ranger, Everest, Territory, EcoSport, Mazda)
title: Ford Ranger 2.2/3.2 Turbo Actuator Gear Stripped (Hella REA)
phContext: 2012–2019 Ranger/Everest electronic VGT actuator; worn worm gear
symptoms: Limp mode, wrench light, no boost control
diagnosticSteps: 1. Remove black plastic cover on Hella turbo actuator to inspect worn plastic worm gear or broken solder bridges! 2. Replace actuator/gear kit and check vane smoothness.

domainName: Ford & Mazda Specific Platform Faults (Ranger, Everest, Territory, EcoSport, Mazda)
title: Ford / Mazda Wheel Lug Nut Swollen Chrome Caps!
phContext: Ford EcoSport/Fiesta/Ranger/E verest factory 2-piece lug nuts
symptoms: 19mm/21mm socket won't fit over swollen lug nuts during flat tire!
diagnosticSteps: 1. Replace factory 2-piece capped lug nuts (moisture swells steel core under chrome cap!) with solid 1-piece forged steel lug nuts before roadside emergency.

domainName: Isuzu, Nissan & Suzuki Specific Platform Faults (D-Max, mu-X, Navara, Urvan, Ertiga)
title: Isuzu D-Max / mu-X (4JJ1 / RZ4E) EGR Valve Soot Seizure
phContext: 2014–2024 Isuzu D-Max / mu-X; heavy city idling soot
symptoms: MIL on, sluggish low-end, limp mode
diagnosticSteps: 1. Remove DC-motor EGR valve & cooler elbow; clean heavy wet carbon. 2. Actuate EGR via scan tool to verify smooth 0–100% feedback. 3. Reset EGR learn.

domainName: Isuzu, Nissan & Suzuki Specific Platform Faults (D-Max, mu-X, Navara, Urvan, Ertiga)
title: Isuzu 4JJ1 / 4JK1 Suction Control Valve & Dual-Filter Clog
phContext: Isuzu D-Max / mu-X / Traviz; clogged frame-rail water separator
symptoms: Stalls under overtaking load, P0087
diagnosticSteps: 1. Replace BOTH primary chassis water-separator element AND engine-bay spin-on fuel filter! 2. Inspect SCV on Denso HP pump. 3. Reset pump learn.

domainName: Isuzu, Nissan & Suzuki Specific Platform Faults (D-Max, mu-X, Navara, Urvan, Ertiga)
title: Isuzu D-Max / mu-X Upper Control Arm Ball Joint & Bushing Squeak
phContext: Isuzu IFS pickups/SUVs on dusty/muddy provincial roads
symptoms: Loud rubber squeak over every bump
diagnosticSteps: 1. Inspect upper control arm bushings & ball joint boots. 2. Lubricate/replace torn bushings and torque bolts at curb ride height (never hanging on lift!).

domainName: Isuzu, Nissan & Suzuki Specific Platform Faults (D-Max, mu-X, Navara, Urvan, Ertiga)
title: Isuzu 4JJ1 EDU (Injector Driver Unit) Fender Harness Rub
phContext: Isuzu D-Max / mu-X; engine harness rubbing left inner fender/AC line
symptoms: Rough running, cylinders 1–4/2–3 misfire, stalls over bumps
diagnosticSteps: 1. Inspect thick engine harness where it passes near left strut tower/brake booster for chafed insulation! 2. Check EDU 12V/GND under load. 3. Repair wire.

domainName: Isuzu, Nissan & Suzuki Specific Platform Faults (D-Max, mu-X, Navara, Urvan, Ertiga)
title: Isuzu Traviz / Crosswind (4JA1) Mechanical Injection Pump Leak
phContext: Isuzu Crosswind / older Traviz; hardened Viton top-cover O-ring
symptoms: Diesel dripping down block, hard morning start
diagnosticSteps: 1. Inspect Bosch VE-style mechanical pump top cover & throttle shaft O-ring for wet diesel. 2. Replace O-ring kit and bleed fuel lines.

domainName: Isuzu, Nissan & Suzuki Specific Platform Faults (D-Max, mu-X, Navara, Urvan, Ertiga)
title: Nissan Navara / Urvan / Almera IPDM & Ground Corrosion
phContext: Nissan Navara (D40/D23), Urvan (NV350), Almera; green fender ground
symptoms: No-crank, cooling fan stays on, U1000 across all modules
diagnosticSteps: 1. Remove IPDM (Engine Bay Intelligent Power Distribution Module) and inspect underside connectors for water! 2. Clean 3x chassis ground bolts near battery & ECM. 3. Clear U1000.

domainName: Isuzu, Nissan & Suzuki Specific Platform Faults (D-Max, mu-X, Navara, Urvan, Ertiga)
title: Nissan Navara (D23 NP300) Turbo Intercooler Plastic Pipe Split
phContext: 2015+ Nissan Navara YS23; cracked plastic/rubber hot-side boost hose
symptoms: Loud whoosh under throttle, black smoke, P0299
diagnosticSteps: 1. Inspect lower hot-side turbo outlet pipe & O-ring seal for oil film and splits. 2. Upgrade to reinforced silicone/aluminum pipe kit. 3. Clear DTCs.

domainName: Isuzu, Nissan & Suzuki Specific Platform Faults (D-Max, mu-X, Navara, Urvan, Ertiga)
title: Nissan Urvan NV350 (YD25) A/C Blower & Condenser Fan Failure
phContext: High-mileage UV Express / shuttle NV350; rear/front blower brushes
symptoms: Rear A/C dies in traffic, engine temp climbs
diagnosticSteps: 1. Check dual A/C condenser fan motors behind grille. 2. Inspect rear blower resistor and motor brushes. 3. Flush rear evaporator.

domainName: Isuzu, Nissan & Suzuki Specific Platform Faults (D-Max, mu-X, Navara, Urvan, Ertiga)
title: Nissan Almera (N17/N18) & Sylphy CVT Overheat / Low Pressure
phContext: Nissan Almera 1.5/1.0T CVT; neglected 40,000 km NS-2/NS-3 CVTF
symptoms: Whining noise, loss of power after 1 hr in traffic
diagnosticSteps: 1. Check CVT Oil Deterioration Counter via Consult/scan tool! 2. Replace external CVT cartridge filter + pan strainer and flush with genuine NS-3. 3. Reset counter.

domainName: Isuzu, Nissan & Suzuki Specific Platform Faults (D-Max, mu-X, Navara, Urvan, Ertiga)
title: Nissan Almera 1.0T / Navara MAF Sensor Skew — Dust / Blow-by
phContext: Nissan turbo engines; oily MAF element
symptoms: Sluggish throttle, MIL on
diagnosticSteps: 1. Clean MAF sensor with dedicated MAF cleaner. 2. Inspect airbox seal and boost hoses for leaks. 3. Perform Nissan Idle Air Volume Learn.

domainName: Isuzu, Nissan & Suzuki Specific Platform Faults (D-Max, mu-X, Navara, Urvan, Ertiga)
title: Nissan Navara / Terra Rear 5-Link Coil Spring Sagging Under Load
phContext: NP300 Navara carrying heavy cargo in bed
symptoms: Rear hits bump stops, headlights blind oncoming cars
diagnosticSteps: 1. Check rear bump stops and shock absorbers for oil leak. 2. Advise payload limits or install helper airbags/heavy-duty coils.

domainName: Isuzu, Nissan & Suzuki Specific Platform Faults (D-Max, mu-X, Navara, Urvan, Ertiga)
title: Nissan Kicks e-POWER 12V Battery Drain / 'I-Key System Error'
phContext: Nissan Kicks e-POWER; weak 12V battery in trunk/hood
symptoms: Won't enter READY mode, warning cascades
diagnosticSteps: 1. Load-test 12V aux battery (even though HV battery is full!). 2. Check DC-DC charging voltage (14.1V in READY). 3. Replace weak 12V battery.

domainName: Isuzu, Nissan & Suzuki Specific Platform Faults (D-Max, mu-X, Navara, Urvan, Ertiga)
title: Nissan YD25 / QR25 Cam & Crank Sensor Phase — Stretched Chain
phContext: Nissan Navara D40, Urvan NV350, X-Trail; overdue oil changes
symptoms: Long cranking, stalling, timing chain rattle
diagnosticSteps: 1. Scope CKP and CMP simultaneously (must align per OEM waveform!). 2. Note: On Nissan, ALWAYS replace CKP and CMP as a matched OEM pair if faulty, or inspect chain tensioner.

domainName: Isuzu, Nissan & Suzuki Specific Platform Faults (D-Max, mu-X, Navara, Urvan, Ertiga)
title: Suzuki Ertiga / XL7 (K15B) A/C Compressor Clutch & Fan Weak
phContext: Suzuki Ertiga/XL7 MPVs; cooling fan motor brushes worn at 60k km
symptoms: A/C warm at traffic lights, temp gauge creeps up
diagnosticSteps: 1. Test radiator fan RPM and amperage draw (worn brushes stop fan intermittently — tap fan shroud to test!). 2. Replace fan motor. 3. Check A/C clutch gap.

domainName: Isuzu, Nissan & Suzuki Specific Platform Faults (D-Max, mu-X, Navara, Urvan, Ertiga)
title: Suzuki Ertiga / Swift / Dzire Manifold Cat Fouled — Short Trips
phContext: Suzuki K12M/K15B; fouled close-coupled catalytic converter
symptoms: MIL on, normal driving
diagnosticSteps: 1. Check upstream/downstream O2 switching. 2. Inspect spark plugs & air filter. 3. Replace manifold cat if O2s confirm depleted.

domainName: Isuzu, Nissan & Suzuki Specific Platform Faults (D-Max, mu-X, Navara, Urvan, Ertiga)
title: Suzuki S-Presso / Celerio / Dzire AGS (AMT) Actuator Fault
phContext: Suzuki Auto Gear Shift (AGS) units; worn clutch or low hydraulic fluid
symptoms: Gear warning light on, stuck in Neutral or 1st
diagnosticSteps: 1. Check AGS hydraulic reservoir level (top up OEM Tutela/Suzuki fluid). 2. Scan AGS TCU for clutch stroke / pump pressure DTCs. 3. Perform Clutch Kiss-Point & Gear Learn.

domainName: Isuzu, Nissan & Suzuki Specific Platform Faults (D-Max, mu-X, Navara, Urvan, Ertiga)
title: Suzuki Jimny (JB74) Steering Shimmy at 70– 80 km/h ('Death Wobble')
phContext: 2019+ Suzuki Jimny with lifted suspension or unbalanced mud tires
symptoms: Violent steering wheel shake after hitting bump at 75 km/h
diagnosticSteps: 1. Check kingpin bearing preload (water enters lower kingpin bearings!) and Panhard rod bushings! 2. Balance wheels via lug-centric adapter (Jimny center bore!). 3. Check tire pressure (26–29 psi).

domainName: Isuzu, Nissan & Suzuki Specific Platform Faults (D-Max, mu-X, Navara, Urvan, Ertiga)
title: Suzuki Ertiga / S-Presso Rear Hatch / Fuel Lid Cable Stuck
phContext: Budget Suzuki hatches/MPVs; rusted fuel-door release cable
symptoms: Fuel door won't pop open at gas station
diagnosticSteps: 1. Spray penetrating lube on fuel-door spring hinge and cable end. 2. Check driver-floor release lever bracket.

domainName: Isuzu, Nissan & Suzuki Specific Platform Faults (D-Max, mu-X, Navara, Urvan, Ertiga)
title: Suzuki K10B / K12M / K15B Lean Trim — Dirty Injectors / PCV
phContext: Suzuki S-Presso, Celerio, Ertiga; E10 fuel gum
symptoms: Rough idle, hesitation, P0171
diagnosticSteps: 1. Clean throttle body and ultrasonic-clean injectors. 2. Check intake manifold O-rings for vacuum leak. 3. Check fuel pressure (300 kPa).

domainName: Isuzu, Nissan & Suzuki Specific Platform Faults (D-Max, mu-X, Navara, Urvan, Ertiga)
title: Isuzu mu-X / D-Max (2021+) Bump-Steer / Tire Scrubbing — Alignment
phContext: 2021+ D-Max / mu-X; outer front tire shoulder wearing fast
symptoms: Premature outer tire wear in 15,000 km
diagnosticSteps: 1. Check front toe-in and camber specs (factory alignment often drifts after settling). 2. Inspect lower control arm bushings. 3. Perform precision 4-wheel alignment.

domainName: Isuzu, Nissan & Suzuki Specific Platform Faults (D-Max, mu-X, Navara, Urvan, Ertiga)
title: Isuzu RZ4E (1.9L Blue Power) EGR Valve Stepper Jam
phContext: Isuzu D-Max / mu-X 1.9L RZ4E; soot binding EGR shaft
symptoms: MIL on, limp mode
diagnosticSteps: 1. Remove EGR valve, clean carbon, and verify smooth spring return. 2. Perform EGR position learn via Isuzu IDSS / scan tool.

domainName: Isuzu, Nissan & Suzuki Specific Platform Faults (D-Max, mu-X, Navara, Urvan, Ertiga)
title: Nissan Navara / Terra 7-Speed AT (RE7R01A) Valve Body / TCM
phContext: 2015+ Navara/Terra 7AT; internal TCM turbine speed sensor fault
symptoms: Stuck in 4th gear limp mode, P0715/P0720
diagnosticSteps: 1. Scan TCM for speed sensor codes (integrated onto internal valve-body TCM!). 2. Check ATF Matic-S level/condition. 3. Replace internal TCM/valve body.

domainName: Isuzu, Nissan & Suzuki Specific Platform Faults (D-Max, mu-X, Navara, Urvan, Ertiga)
title: Nissan Almera 1.0T (HRA0) Turbo Wastegate Rattle & Coolant Leak
phContext: 2022+ Nissan Almera Turbo; plastic coolant fitting seepage
symptoms: Metallic rattle on decel, low coolant bottle
diagnosticSteps: 1. Pressure-test cooling system to check plastic thermostat/turbo coolant fittings. 2. Inspect electronic wastegate linkage play. 3. Check for ECU update.

domainName: Isuzu, Nissan & Suzuki Specific Platform Faults (D-Max, mu-X, Navara, Urvan, Ertiga)
title: Suzuki SHVS Mild Hybrid Belt Squeak & Tensioner Wear
phContext: Suzuki Ertiga/XL7 Hybrid; high belt tension for ISG cranking
symptoms: Chirp at idle or auto-restart
diagnosticSteps: 1. Inspect SHVS multi-rib belt and hydraulic/spring tensioner pulley. 2. Replace with exact OEM SHVS belt (standard belt slips!).

domainName: Isuzu, Nissan & Suzuki Specific Platform Faults (D-Max, mu-X, Navara, Urvan, Ertiga)
title: Nissan ABS Pressure Sensor / Brake Switch Fault
phContext: Nissan Navara, Almera, X-Trail; worn brake switch or ABS
symptoms: ABS + VDC + Slip lights on
diagnosticSteps: 1. Check Brake Light Switch 1 & 2 PIDs. 2. Read Master Cylinder Pressure PID at rest (0 bar). 3. Flush brake fluid.

domainName: Isuzu, Nissan & Suzuki Specific Platform Faults (D-Max, mu-X, Navara, Urvan, Ertiga)
title: Isuzu D-Max / mu-X A/C Evaporator Leak (Under-Dash Corrosion)
phContext: 5+ year old Isuzu SUVs/pickups; acidic cabin humidity
symptoms: A/C loses cold every 2 months, oily condensate drip
diagnosticSteps: 1. Sniff cabin vents with electronic refrigerant leak detector. 2. Inspect evaporator core under dash for green UV dye/oil stain. 3. Replace evaporator + expansion valve.

domainName: Isuzu, Nissan & Suzuki Specific Platform Faults (D-Max, mu-X, Navara, Urvan, Ertiga)
title: Isuzu 4JJ1/4JK1 ECM Water Intrusion — Engine Bay Mount
phContext: Isuzu D-Max/mu-X with ECM mounted on left inner fender
symptoms: No-start or erratic injector shutoff after pressure wash
diagnosticSteps: 1. Unplug ECM connectors on left fender and inspect for water/verdigris! 2. Dry pins, check ECM power/ground relays. 3. Reseal.

domainName: Isuzu, Nissan & Suzuki Specific Platform Faults (D-Max, mu-X, Navara, Urvan, Ertiga)
title: Suzuki S-Presso / Celerio Clutch Cable Snap (Manual)
phContext: High-mileage city delivery/ride-hailing Suzuki manuals
symptoms: Clutch pedal drops flat with a snap
diagnosticSteps: 1. Inspect clutch cable firewall grommet & pedal hook for frayed steel strands. 2. Replace clutch cable and lubricate pedal pivot.

domainName: Isuzu, Nissan & Suzuki Specific Platform Faults (D-Max, mu-X, Navara, Urvan, Ertiga)
title: Suzuki Ertiga / Swift ABS-Derived Speed Signal Lost
phContext: Suzuki; faulty front wheel speed sensor killing speedo
symptoms: Speedometer at 0, EPS heavy, ABS light on
diagnosticSteps: 1. Scan ABS module for wheel speed C-code. 2. Replace faulty ABS sensor/hub encoder. 3. Clear ECM P0500.

domainName: Isuzu, Nissan & Suzuki Specific Platform Faults (D-Max, mu-X, Navara, Urvan, Ertiga)
title: Nissan Navara / Urvan Fuel Filter Primer Diaphragm Air Leak
phContext: Navara D40/D23, Urvan; cracked rubber diaphragm on hand primer
symptoms: Needs pumping every morning to start
diagnosticSteps: 1. Inspect fuel filter head for wet diesel around hand-primer button. 2. Replace filter head primer assembly and bleed air.

domainName: Isuzu, Nissan & Suzuki Specific Platform Faults (D-Max, mu-X, Navara, Urvan, Ertiga)
title: Isuzu Crosswind / Hilander Alternator Vacuum Pump Oil Leak
phContext: 4JA1/4JB1 Isuzu engines; leaking rear vacuum pump O-ring
symptoms: Oil dripping down alternator onto lower hose
diagnosticSteps: 1. Inspect rubber oil return hose and O-ring at rear of alternator vacuum pump. 2. Replace Viton O-ring & high-temp hose before oil swells coolant hoses!

domainName: Isuzu, Nissan & Suzuki Specific Platform Faults (D-Max, mu-X, Navara, Urvan, Ertiga)

symptoms: Rattle from left/right front over bumps

diagnosticSteps: 1. Swap fan relay in IPDM/fuse box. 2. Check fan motor amperage draw.

symptoms: Loud squeal/grind at front of engine

symptoms: Loud 2-second metallic grind on first morning start only
diagnosticSteps: 1. Listen at top timing cover on cold start (stops as soon as oil pressure fills VTC!). 2. Use genuine 0W-20/5W-30 oil + OEM filter. 3. Replace VTC actuator gear if persistent.

domainName: Honda, Hyundai & Kia Specific Platform Faults (City, Civic, BR-V, Accent, Staria, Soluto)
