phContext: Honda CVT & 5AT; clogged 2nd/3rd clutch oil pressure switch
symptoms: Green 'D' light flashes on cluster, harsh shifts
diagnosticSteps: 1. Scan Honda TCM directly for pressure switch DTC (e.g., P0842/P0847). 2. Replace faulty 1-pin oil pressure switch on gearbox case. 3. Flush HCF-2 / DW-1 fluid.

domainName: Honda, Hyundai & Kia Specific Platform Faults (City, Civic, BR-V, Accent, Staria, Soluto)
title: Honda City / Civic / BR-V Rear Wheel Bearing Hum (Early Wear)
phContext: Honda FWD models hitting potholes/floods
symptoms: Roaring noise from rear at 60+ km/h
diagnosticSteps: 1. Spin rear hub by hand to feel roughness. 2. Replace sealed rear hub bearing assembly (note: ABS magnetic ring is built into hub!).

domainName: Honda, Hyundai & Kia Specific Platform Faults (City, Civic, BR-V, Accent, Staria, Soluto)
title: Honda Civic FC/FE Sticky Steering / EPS Rack Worm Gear Noise
phContext: 2016+ Honda Civic/CR-V/HR-V; dry worm gear grease in EPS rack
symptoms: Notchy/sticky steering feel on highway micro-corrections
diagnosticSteps: 1. Check for Honda EPS steering gearbox worm-gear grease/spring recall! 2. Inspect steering rack boots for water. 3. Re-grease or replace EPS rack.

domainName: Honda, Hyundai & Kia Specific Platform Faults (City, Civic, BR-V, Accent, Staria, Soluto)
title: Honda City / Brio / BR-V Cat Efficiency Low — Fouled O2/Cat
phContext: High-mileage Honda L12/L15; short trips + E10
symptoms: MIL on, normal driving
diagnosticSteps: 1. Compare B1S1 A/F vs. B1S2 O2 waveforms. 2. Check valve clearance (tight exhaust valves cause misfire/cat wear on Hondas!). 3. Replace cat.

domainName: Honda, Hyundai & Kia Specific Platform Faults (City, Civic, BR-V, Accent, Staria, Soluto)
title: Honda City / Jazz / Civic A/C Compressor Relay Stuck ON (Omron)
phContext: 2008–2018 Hondas; infamous Omron A/C clutch relay welding closed
symptoms: A/C fan/compressor runs with car OFF, killing battery overnight!
diagnosticSteps: 1. Pull A/C Compressor Clutch Relay in underhood box (if clutch/fan stops, replace relay with updated Mitsuba/Denso unit!). 2. Check coil air gap.

domainName: Honda, Hyundai & Kia Specific Platform Faults (City, Civic, BR-V, Accent, Staria, Soluto)
title: Hyundai / Kia MDPS Flexible Rubber Steering Coupler Shredded
phContext: Hyundai Accent/Elantra/Tucson, Kia Rio/Picanto/Soluto
symptoms: Loud clunk when rocking steering wheel left-right or hitting bumps
diagnosticSteps: 1. Listen under steering column motor housing. 2. Drop EPS motor (3 bolts) and replace crumbled black rubber star coupler with updated green/OEM coupler! 3. Calibrate SAS.

domainName: Honda, Hyundai & Kia Specific Platform Faults (City, Civic, BR-V, Accent, Staria, Soluto)
title: Hyundai Accent / Kia Rio (Gamma 1.4/1.6) CKP Sensor Hot Stall
phContext: Hyundai Accent/Elantra/Reina, Kia Rio/Soluto; classic CKP failure
symptoms: Stalls at traffic light hot, tach drops to 0, restarts after 15 min!
diagnosticSteps: 1. Watch Tachometer needle when cranking hot (0 RPM = dead CKP!). 2. Measure CKP resistance hot (~800– 1000 Ω cold, goes open hot!). 3. Replace with genuine Mobis CKP.

domainName: Honda, Hyundai & Kia Specific Platform Faults (City, Civic, BR-V, Accent, Staria, Soluto)
title: Hyundai Grand Starex / Accent CRDi Fuel Filter & Tank Sock
phContext: Starex CRDi (D4CB), Accent CRDi (D4FB); algae/wax clogging tank sock
symptoms: Stalls above 2500 RPM, restarts after key cycle
diagnosticSteps: 1. Pull in-tank fuel sender under floor/seat and clean black slimy mesh sock! 2. Replace spin-on fuel filter & check injector return flow. 3. Clear P0087.

domainName: Honda, Hyundai & Kia Specific Platform Faults (City, Civic, BR-V, Accent, Staria, Soluto)
title: Hyundai Accent / Kia Rio Clock Spring — Airbag + Horn + Buttons
phContext: Hyundai/Kia sedans >60,000 km; worn spiral ribbon
symptoms: SRS light on, horn/cruise/audio dead
diagnosticSteps: 1. Check Driver Airbag resistance PID. 2. Replace clock spring (align SAS straight!). 3. Clear SRS.

domainName: Honda, Hyundai & Kia Specific Platform Faults (City, Civic, BR-V, Accent, Staria, Soluto)
title: Hyundai / Kia 4AT/6AT Inhibitor Switch — Shift Lever Play/Splash
phContext: Accent, Tucson, Starex, Picanto, Soluto; corroded gear switch
symptoms: Gear indicator disappears, won't crank in P, harsh slam into D
diagnosticSteps: 1. Check TR switch PIDs while moving shifter. 2. Clean/replace inhibitor switch on top/side of transaxle. 3. Align Neutral pin.

domainName: Honda, Hyundai & Kia Specific Platform Faults (City, Civic, BR-V, Accent, Staria, Soluto)
title: Hyundai Staria / Tucson Smart Tailgate / Sliding Door Beep Fault
phContext: Power sliding/tailgate models; pinch strip or battery low
symptoms: Door beeps 3x and reverses
diagnosticSteps: 1. Clean sliding door brass contacts and check rubber pinch-strip resistance. 2. Verify 12V battery >12.2V. 3. Re-initialize door travel.

domainName: Honda, Hyundai & Kia Specific Platform Faults (City, Civic, BR-V, Accent, Staria, Soluto)
title: Hyundai / Kia Knock Sensor Fault — Brittle Harness Under Intake
phContext: Gamma 1.4/1.6 / Kappa 1.2 engines; heat-baked knock wire
symptoms: MIL on, sluggish acceleration
diagnosticSteps: 1. Inspect 2-pin knock sensor wire under intake manifold. 2. Replace sensor and torque strictly to 20 N·m (over-torque cracks piezo!).

domainName: Honda, Hyundai & Kia Specific Platform Faults (City, Civic, BR-V, Accent, Staria, Soluto)
title: Honda BR-V / Mobilio / Brio Front Lower Arm Bushings Torn
phContext: Honda compact MPVs/hatches on rough PH streets
symptoms: Clunking on braking, vague steering
diagnosticSteps: 1. Pry front lower control arm rear compliance bushing to inspect rubber tears. 2. Replace bushings in pairs + align.

domainName: Honda, Hyundai & Kia Specific Platform Faults (City, Civic, BR-V, Accent, Staria, Soluto)
title: Honda Civic / CR-V 1.5T Fuel Dilution / Oil Level Rising

symptoms: Oil smells strongly of gas, level above upper dot on dipstick
diagnosticSteps: 1. Change 0W-20 oil every 5,000 km in heavy city traffic! 2. Inspect HPFP & injectors for leak-down. 3. Advise longer highway runs.

domainName: Honda, Hyundai & Kia Specific Platform Faults (City, Civic, BR-V, Accent, Staria, Soluto)
title: Hyundai / Kia EVAP Purge Solenoid Stuck — Hard Start After Gas
phContext: Accent, Reina, Soluto, Picanto; sticking purge valve
symptoms: Cranks long right after refueling
diagnosticSteps: 1. Pinch purge hose at intake to check for manifold vacuum leak at idle. 2. Replace purge solenoid.

domainName: Honda, Hyundai & Kia Specific Platform Faults (City, Civic, BR-V, Accent, Staria, Soluto)

symptoms: Turbo whine/failure, rear sag
diagnosticSteps: 1. Whenever replacing Starex turbo, ALWAYS replace the steel turbo oil feed line (carbon clogs it)! 2. Inspect rear shocks/springs.

domainName: Honda, Hyundai & Kia Specific Platform Faults (City, Civic, BR-V, Accent, Staria, Soluto)

phContext: 2009–2020 Honda City/Jazz/CR-V; worn 12V DC latch motor
symptoms: Door refuses to lock with remote, buzzes inside door
diagnosticSteps: 1. Verify 12V polarity-reversing pulse at door latch plug. 2. Replace internal FC-280 DC motor or complete door latch assembly.

domainName: Honda, Hyundai & Kia Specific Platform Faults (City, Civic, BR-V, Accent, Staria, Soluto)
title: Hyundai / Kia Steering Angle Sensor (SAS) Needs Calibration
phContext: Any Hyundai/Kia after battery swap or alignment
symptoms: ESC light on solid
diagnosticSteps: 1. Center steering wheel straight ahead. 2. Run SAS Zero-Point Calibration via scan tool. 3. Clear C1260.

domainName: Honda, Hyundai & Kia Specific Platform Faults (City, Civic, BR-V, Accent, Staria, Soluto)

diagnosticSteps: 1. Pressure-test system cold and inspect radiator hoses + plastic bypass joints. 2. Replace weeping O-ring/pipe.

symptoms: Cylinder misfire, flashing MIL
diagnosticSteps: 1. Pull coils, blow dry plug wells, and inspect rubber boots for white flashover lines. 2. Replace faulty coil & spark plugs.

domainName: Honda, Hyundai & Kia Specific Platform Faults (City, Civic, BR-V, Accent, Staria, Soluto)

symptoms: Blower works on Speed 4 only
diagnosticSteps: 1. Replace clogged cabin air filter FIRST! 2. Replace blower resistor behind glovebox. 3. Check blower motor amp draw.

symptoms: Distinct sewing-machine ticking at idle, slight power loss
diagnosticSteps: 1. Note: Honda L15/R18 uses manual screw-and-locknut tappets (no hydraulic lifters!). 2. Adjust intake/exhaust valve clearances dead-cold to OEM spec!

domainName: Honda, Hyundai & Kia Specific Platform Faults (City, Civic, BR-V, Accent, Staria, Soluto)

symptoms: ESC/ABS light on, brake lights dead or stay on, stuck in Park
diagnosticSteps: 1. Check Brake Switch 1 & 2 PIDs. 2. Replace 4-pin brake light switch above pedal.

diagnosticSteps: 1. Spin alternator pulley with belt off (must freewheel one direction!). 2. Replace seized OAP pulley & belt.

diagnosticSteps: 1. Check A/F sensor heater and lambda PID. 2. Replace with genuine Denso/NTK wideband sensor (generic O2 fails on Honda!).

diagnosticSteps: 1. Check IVT fluid level/condition and update TCM calibration to latest OEM TSB. 2. Inspect pressure solenoid.

diagnosticSteps: 1. Remove EGR valve + cooler and clean carbon. 2. Actuate EGR via scan tool to verify smooth travel.

symptoms: Stuck in 4th gear limp mode
diagnosticSteps: 1. Ohm-test solenoid B from external 6AT round connector. 2. Drop front valve body cover and replace internal harness/solenoid.

symptoms: Fuel bars jump from 1/2 to Empty then back
diagnosticSteps: 1. Pull fuel pump module under center console/rear seat and clean sender resistor card (or replace sender).

title: Hyundai / Kia SRS Internal Fault — Water / Low Voltage
phContext: Flooded cabin Accent/Rio/Tucson; SRS ECU under center console
symptoms: Airbag light solid, B1620
diagnosticSteps: 1. Inspect SRS ECU under console for water/corrosion. 2. Verify 12V/ground. 3. Replace SRS module.

domainName: Honda, Hyundai & Kia Specific Platform Faults (City, Civic, BR-V, Accent, Staria, Soluto)
title: Honda CR-V / Accord Dual-Zone A/C — Passenger Warm, Driver Cold
phContext: Low R134a refrigerant charge (only cools half of evaporator!)
symptoms: One side cold, other side lukewarm
diagnosticSteps: 1. Check A/C gauges FIRST before tearing dash apart for blend doors! Low Freon cools only the inlet half of the evaporator! 2. Leak-test, vacuum, and recharge.

domainName: Honda, Hyundai & Kia Specific Platform Faults (City, Civic, BR-V, Accent, Staria, Soluto)
title: Hyundai / Kia Alternator Field High — Bad Smart Regulator
phContext: Accent, Reina, Soluto; overcharging or battery light on
symptoms: Battery light on, voltage 15V+ or 12.2V
diagnosticSteps: 1. Inspect 3-pin alternator LIN/FR plug for broken wire. 2. Replace alternator voltage regulator.

domainName: Honda, Hyundai & Kia Specific Platform Faults (City, Civic, BR-V, Accent, Staria, Soluto)
title: Honda City / Civic Radiator Fan Shroud Motor Failure (2 Fans)
phContext: Dual-fan Hondas; one fan dead (A/C or Main) causing traffic overheat
symptoms: Temp climbs ONLY in traffic with A/C on
diagnosticSteps: 1. Verify BOTH radiator and condenser fans spin at high speed when A/C turns on! 2. Tap dead motor to confirm worn brushes. 3. Replace motor.

domainName: Honda, Hyundai & Kia Specific Platform Faults (City, Civic, BR-V, Accent, Staria, Soluto)
title: Hyundai Staria / Palisade Shift-by-Wire Button Stuck/Error
phContext: Push-button shifter models; spilled coffee on console buttons
symptoms: Shifter refuses to select D/R, 'Check Shift Control'
diagnosticSteps: 1. Clean sticky buttons carefully; scan SBW actuator for CAN/switch fault. 2. Check 12V battery health.

symptoms: Black smoke, poor mileage, LTFT -15%
diagnosticSteps: 1. Clean MAF and check fuel pressure leak-down. 2. Flow-test injectors.

domainName: Honda, Hyundai & Kia Specific Platform Faults (City, Civic, BR-V, Accent, Staria, Soluto)

symptoms: Sliding door refuses to stay shut
diagnosticSteps: 1. Clean lower track debris and pinch sensor strip. 2. Lubricate rear latch cinch motor and reset door limit.

diagnosticSteps: 1. Reseat large ECM connectors and clean engine-to-chassis grounds. 2. Measure CAN 60 ohms.

phContext: Pothole-driven Hondas; worn rear upper shock rubber bushings
symptoms: Dull thud from trunk over bumps
diagnosticSteps: 1. Inspect rear shock upper rubber mounts inside wheel arch/trunk. 2. Replace rear shocks & rubber bushings in pairs.

symptoms: MIL on, blue smoke puff on takeoff
diagnosticSteps: 1. Check oil consumption and spark plug fouling first! 2. Fix oil burning/PCV before replacing catalyst.

diagnosticSteps: 1. Check cluster graphic for open door/hood/trunk. 2. Inspect trunk latch microswitch or hood pin.

symptoms: Temp gauge stays low on highway, poor MPG
diagnosticSteps: 1. Monitor ECT PID (hovers at 65°C). 2. Replace with genuine Honda 78–82°C thermostat & bleed air.

domainName: Honda, Hyundai & Kia Specific Platform Faults (City, Civic, BR-V, Accent, Staria, Soluto)
title: Hyundai / Kia Fuel Pump Relay / Fuse Melt — Aging In-Tank Pump
phContext: High-mileage Accent/Starex Gas; pump drawing >12A
symptoms: Stalls hot, melted fuel pump relay
diagnosticSteps: 1. Measure fuel pump amp draw (replace pump if >9A). 2. Replace melted relay/socket.

domainName: Emerging Chinese & EV/PHEV Brands in PH (BYD, Geely, MG, Chery, GAC, Changan)
title: BYD Sealion 6 DM-i / Atto 3 — 12V LFP Aux Battery Sleep Cutout
phContext: BYD NEVs; internal BMS inside small 12V LFP aux battery trips off

domainName: Oscilloscope Waveform & Sensor Signal Diagnostics
title: Hall-Effect CKP Square Wave — Intermittent Dropout to 0V/5V
phContext: Hyundai Accent, Vios 1NR-FE, Xpander; thermal Hall IC breakdown
symptoms: Sudden bucking/stall hot, no-start until cooled
diagnosticSteps: 1. Scope CKP signal pin (0–5V or 0– 12V crisp square wave) while heating sensor gently with heat gun! 2. Watch for missing teeth or flatlined 5V/0V dropout. 3. Replace Hall CKP.

domainName: Oscilloscope Waveform & Sensor Signal Diagnostics
title: CKP vs. CMP Known-Good Phase Overlay — Stretched Chain
phContext: Toyota, Nissan, Honda, Ford; 1–2 tooth mechanical timing drift
symptoms: Long crank, P0016, sluggish torque
diagnosticSteps: 1. Capture Ch1 (CKP 60-2 / 36-2) and Ch2 (CMP) simultaneously at hot idle. 2. Align missing-tooth gap against OEM reference edge (shift >6–10° = stretched chain/skipped tooth!). 3. Inspect chain.

domainName: Oscilloscope Waveform & Sensor Signal Diagnostics
title: Coil-on-Plug Primary Current Ramp — Shorted Winding Turns
phContext: Any COP gasoline car; coil passes ohm test yet misfires under load
symptoms: Misfire under hard acceleration only, P0301
diagnosticSteps: 1. Clamp low-amp current probe around coil 12V feed wire (or ground). 2. Normal ramp rises smoothly linearly to 6–9A over 2–3 ms; steep vertical spike = shorted internal turns! 3. Replace coil.

domainName: Oscilloscope Waveform & Sensor Signal Diagnostics
title: Secondary Ignition Capacitive Probe — Shorted Burn Time (<0.6 ms)
phContext: COP or waste-spark ignition; fouled spark plug or cracked boot
symptoms: Single cylinder shudder under load
diagnosticSteps: 1. Place secondary capacitive pickup on coil top: normal spark line is 1.0–1.5 ms at ~1–2 kV! 2. High firing kV + short burn (<0.5 ms) = wide plug gap/lean; low firing kV + short burn = fouled/cracked boot!

domainName: Oscilloscope Waveform & Sensor Signal Diagnostics
title: EFI Injector Current & Pintle Bump — Mechanically Stuck Pintle
phContext: Gasoline/LPG injectors; coil ohms good (12 Ω), yet cylinder dead
symptoms: Injector clicks weakly or not at all, no fuel spray
diagnosticSteps: 1. Scope Ch1 (Voltage) and Ch2 (Current): healthy injector shows a tiny downward 'pintle bump' notch on the current ramp & inductive spike (~60V)! 2. No pintle bump = mechanically seized pintle!

domainName: Oscilloscope Waveform & Sensor Signal Diagnostics
title: CRDi / GDI Peak-and-Hold Injector Waveform — Weak Boost Stage
phContext: Denso/Bosch/Siemens diesel & GDI; missing 80– 180V initial peak
symptoms: Hard start, cylinder misfire, P0200/P0203
diagnosticSteps: 1. Scope high-side + low-side injector wires differentially: look for initial high-voltage boost peak (60–180V, 10–20A) followed by lower hold PWM! 2. Missing peak = EDU/boost circuit fault.

domainName: Oscilloscope Waveform & Sensor Signal Diagnostics
title: High-Speed CAN Bus Scope — Asymmetric / Skewed Mirror Image
phContext: Any CAN vehicle with flaky comms or single-wire open
symptoms: Random module dropoffs, U-codes
diagnosticSteps: 1. Scope Ch1 (CAN-H) and Ch2 (CAN-L) simultaneously: healthy CAN is a perfect mirror image (2.5V -> 3.5V and 2.5V -> 1.5V)! 2. Flatlined 2.5V on one line = open wire or dead transceiver.

domainName: Oscilloscope Waveform & Sensor Signal Diagnostics
title: CAN Bus Ringing / Reflections — Unterminated Stub / Bad Splice
phContext: Vehicles with aftermarket GPS/telemetry T-tapped long wires
symptoms: Intermittent bus-off errors at high engine RPM
diagnosticSteps: 1. Zoom into CAN bit edges on scope (500 kbps = 2 µs bit width). 2. Overshoot/ringing spikes >4.5V indicate missing 120 Ω termination or long unterminated aftermarket splice! 3. Remove T-tap.

domainName: Oscilloscope Waveform & Sensor Signal Diagnostics
title: LIN Bus Waveform — Slave Pulling Bus Permanently Low (0V)
phContext: Smart alternator / wiper / BMS LIN network
symptoms: Alternator/wiper dead, LIN code
diagnosticSteps: 1. Scope LIN wire: healthy idle is ~10– 12V with crisp 0–12V data packets. 2. If stuck flat at 0V or 12V, unplug slaves one by one while watching scope until square packets reappear!

domainName: Oscilloscope Waveform & Sensor Signal Diagnostics
title: Alternator AC Ripple Scope — Blown Rectifier Diode Phase
phContext: Any vehicle with erratic ECU/TCM glitches & whining alternator
symptoms: Battery charges 13.8V yet sensors glitch & battery drains
diagnosticSteps: 1. Set scope to AC-coupled at battery (+) post, 200 mV/div, 2 ms/div at 2000 RPM. 2. Healthy 3-phase alternator shows small uniform ~50–100 mVpp ripples; huge 500 mV–1.5V sharp spikes = blown diode!

domainName: Oscilloscope Waveform & Sensor Signal Diagnostics
title: Relative Compression Waveform via Starter Current Clamp
phContext: Quick 30-second mechanical health check without pulling plugs!
symptoms: Uneven cranking rhythm ('chug-chug-skip-chug')
diagnosticSteps: 1. Disable fuel/ignition, clamp 600A DC current probe around battery (+) cable, crank 5 sec. 2. Healthy 4-cyl shows 4 equal current peaks (~180A each); one noticeably lower peak = low compression on that cylinder!

domainName: Oscilloscope Waveform & Sensor Signal Diagnostics
title: Hot-Wire MAF Sensor Response Test — Snap-Throttle Voltage Lag
phContext: Toyota/Nissan/Mitsubishi analog voltage MAF (0.8– 4.5V)
symptoms: Hesitation on sudden gas pedal stomp
diagnosticSteps: 1. Scope MAF signal wire at 500 ms/div and snap throttle wide open briefly! 2. Healthy MAF spikes instantaneously (<100 ms) from ~1.0V to >4.0V; sluggish rounded rise (<3.0V) = contaminated/dead MAF.

domainName: Oscilloscope Waveform & Sensor Signal Diagnostics
title: Dual-Track TPS / APP Scope — Micro-Glitch Dropout
phContext: ETC throttle/pedal sensors; DMM misses 5 ms wiper dropout
symptoms: Random limp mode over bumps or light cruise
diagnosticSteps: 1. Scope TPS1 and TPS2 simultaneously at 200 ms/div while slowly sweeping pedal 0–100% 5 times. 2. Look for razor-thin vertical glitch spikes dropping to 0V/5V! 3. Replace TPS/pedal.

domainName: Oscilloscope Waveform & Sensor Signal Diagnostics
title: Upstream Zirconia O2 Sensor Response Time (<100 ms Rule)
phContext: Gasoline cars; sluggish O2 causing poor MPG
symptoms: Lazy switching, P0133
diagnosticSteps: 1. Scope B1S1 at 2000 RPM warm, then induce brief lean/rich snap (unplug vacuum hose / spray propane). 2. Transition from 0.1V to 0.8V (and back) must take <100–150 ms; >300 ms = poisoned O2!

domainName: Oscilloscope Waveform & Sensor Signal Diagnostics
title: Active Hall vs. Passive VR ABS Wheel Speed Sensor Scope
phContext: Technicians replacing ABS sensor without knowing signal type
symptoms: ABS light on, DMM ohm test reads open on active Hall sensor!
diagnosticSteps: 1. Remember: 2-wire Active Hall/AMR sensors CANNOT be ohm-tested (reads open)! 2. Scope current/voltage across 100 Ω shunt or signal pin while spinning wheel: square 7/14 mA (0.7/1.4V) pulse = healthy!

domainName: Oscilloscope Waveform & Sensor Signal Diagnostics
title: In-Tank Fuel Pump Current Ramp — Worn Commutator Bars
phContext: Cars stalling after 30 min in traffic; fuel pump passes static pressure
symptoms: Intermittent stall hot
diagnosticSteps: 1. Clamp low-amp probe around fuel pump power wire (2 ms/div). 2. Count commutator humps (usually 8 bars per revolution): missing/dropped humps or dead spots = worn commutator! Replace pump.

domainName: Oscilloscope Waveform & Sensor Signal Diagnostics
title: CRDi SCV PWM Duty Cycle & Current Scope — Sticking Plunger
phContext: Denso HP3/HP4 pumps; erratic rail pressure
symptoms: Hunting idle, P0088/P0089
diagnosticSteps: 1. Scope SCV PWM voltage & current: ECM modulates duty cycle (~30–40% idle) cleanly. 2. If PWM duty stays steady while rail pressure swings wildly, mechanical SCV plunger is sticking!

domainName: Oscilloscope Waveform & Sensor Signal Diagnostics
title: VVT OCV Solenoid PWM Duty Cycle — Mechanical vs. Electrical
phContext: Toyota/Honda/Hyundai VVT; diagnosing stuck valve vs. bad ECM
symptoms: Rough idle, P0011/P0012
diagnosticSteps: 1. Scope OCV control pin while commanding 0–100% duty via scan tool (200–300 Hz crisp square wave). 2. Clean PWM with zero cam phase movement = clogged oil screen or seized cam phaser.

domainName: Oscilloscope Waveform & Sensor Signal Diagnostics
title: ETC Throttle Motor H-Bridge Scope — Dead Brush Spot
phContext: Drive-by-wire cars; intermittent limp mode
symptoms: Sudden limp mode, clears on key cycle
diagnosticSteps: 1. Scope BOTH throttle motor wires (M+ and M-) differentially while commanding throttle sweep. 2. Look for high-frequency brush sparking dropouts or open motor current!

domainName: Oscilloscope Waveform & Sensor Signal Diagnostics
title: Intake Manifold Vacuum Pulsation Transducer — Burnt Exhaust Valve
phContext: Engines with rough idle & normal spark/fuel
symptoms: Steady rhythmic miss at idle only
diagnosticSteps: 1. Connect pressure/vacuum pulse transducer to intake manifold at idle. 2. Uniform sine wave = good valve seal; deep downward vacuum drop or flat spike every 4th pulse = tight/burnt valve or head gasket!

domainName: Oscilloscope Waveform & Sensor Signal Diagnostics
title: Piezoelectric Knock Sensor Scope — Tap Test Verification
phContext: Testing knock sensor without guessing
symptoms: P0325 active, unsure if sensor or ECM wire
diagnosticSteps: 1. Scope knock sensor 2 wires at 50 mV/div and tap engine block near sensor lightly with brass hammer/wrench! 2. Healthy piezo outputs sharp 100–500 mV AC ringdown spikes!

domainName: Oscilloscope Waveform & Sensor Signal Diagnostics
title: Parasitic Draw Oscilloscope Watch — Module Waking Every 10 Min
phContext: Cars with mysterious intermittent overnight dead battery
symptoms: Draws 20 mA during 10-min shop test, still dead in morning!
diagnosticSteps: 1. Log voltage across 10 mΩ shunt or fuse mV drop on slow-roll scope (100 sec/div) overnight! 2. Catches telematics/BCM/GPS waking up for 2 minutes every hour!

domainName: Oscilloscope Waveform & Sensor Signal Diagnostics
title: Ground Bounce / Noise on Sensor Ground (SGND) During Starter/Fan
phContext: Cars with aftermarket HID/amp wired to ECM ground
symptoms: Phantom sensor codes when radiator fan or headlights turn on
diagnosticSteps: 1. Scope Sensor Ground (SGND) referenced to Battery (-) at 100 mV/div while cycling A/C fan & headlights! 2. Jumps >100 mV indicate shared/corroded ground path!

domainName: Oscilloscope Waveform & Sensor Signal Diagnostics
title: Toyota IGT vs. IGF Oscilloscope Handshake
phContext: Toyota/Denso ignition; verifying coil feedback
symptoms: Stalls after 2 sec (P1300)
diagnosticSteps: 1. Scope Ch1 (IGT1 5V trigger) and Ch2 (IGF common 5V feedback). 2. Every IGT pulse must produce an IGF pull-down ~0.5 ms later! Missing IGF pull-down identifies exact dead coil.

domainName: Oscilloscope Waveform & Sensor Signal Diagnostics
title: 5V VREF Power-Up Glitch Scope — Dying ECM Regulator
phContext: Intermittent stalls over bumps; 5V tests 5.00V static
symptoms: Random stall, no DTC stored
diagnosticSteps: 1. Trigger scope on falling edge <4.5V on 5V VREF rail while driving/wiggling harness! 2. Captures 10 ms 5V brownouts caused by chafed sensor wire or failing ECM regulator.

domainName: Oscilloscope Waveform & Sensor Signal Diagnostics
title: PWM Cooling Fan Control Signal Scope — Module vs. ECM
phContext: Ford/Mazda/Hyundai PWM cooling fans
symptoms: Fan dead or stuck 100%
diagnosticSteps: 1. Scope thin PWM wire at fan shroud (typically 100–200 Hz, 10–90% duty cycle). 2. Clean PWM present + heavy 12V/GND good = replace fan control module!

domainName: Oscilloscope Waveform & Sensor Signal Diagnostics
title: Smart Alternator DF/FR Monitor Duty Cycle Scope
phContext: Honda/Hyundai/Toyota; verifying alternator load feedback
symptoms: Charging erratic, MIL on
diagnosticSteps: 1. Scope FR/DF wire from alternator to ECM (square wave whose duty cycle rises with alternator field load). 2. Flatlined signal = faulty regulator or broken wire.

domainName: Oscilloscope Waveform & Sensor Signal Diagnostics
title: AT/CVT Input & Output Speed Sensor Waveform Comparison
phContext: Automatic/CVT cars with shifting flares
symptoms: Harsh shift, speed code
diagnosticSteps: 1. Scope Input (NT) and Output (NO) speed sensors simultaneously during gentle acceleration. 2. Look for missing pulses or amplitude drop when ATF hits 90°C.

domainName: Oscilloscope Waveform & Sensor Signal Diagnostics
title: Fuel Injector Dead-Time / Latency Check — Weak Driver
phContext: High-mileage taxis; sluggish throttle response
symptoms: Lean stumble on snap throttle
diagnosticSteps: 1. Compare injector pulse width on scan tool vs. actual optical/current opening duration on scope! 2. Check battery voltage compensation.

domainName: Oscilloscope Waveform & Sensor Signal Diagnostics
title: FRP Sensor Noise Spike — Loose Alternator Ground Shield
phContext: CRDi pickups with erratic rail pressure DTCs
symptoms: Sudden limp mode under acceleration
diagnosticSteps: 1. Scope FRP signal wire at 500 mV/div (should be smooth DC 1.0–4.2V). 2. High-frequency AC fuzz >200 mVpp indicates bad alternator diode or missing sensor ground shield!

domainName: Oscilloscope Waveform & Sensor Signal Diagnostics
title: Starter Voltage Drop Waveform — Cable vs. Solenoid vs. Battery
phContext: 4-channel cranking health test in 10 seconds
symptoms: Slow cranking hot
diagnosticSteps: 1. Ch1: Battery (+ to -); Ch2: Positive cable drop (Batt+ to Starter B+); Ch3: Negative cable drop (Batt- to Starter case). 2. Instant pinpoint of >0.3V cable vs. bad battery!

domainName: Oscilloscope Waveform & Sensor Signal Diagnostics
title: EV/HEV Resolver Sine/Cosine Waveform — Phase Imbalance
phContext: Toyota HEV, BYD, Nissan e-POWER; transaxle motor fault
symptoms: Jerky EV takeoff, P0A3F
diagnosticSteps: 1. Scope Exciter (10 kHz sine), Sin+, and Cos+ differentially (90° phase shift, clean amplitude envelope while spinning wheel). 2. Distorted envelope = damaged resolver rotor/winding.

domainName: Oscilloscope Waveform & Sensor Signal Diagnostics
title: A/C Variable Compressor ECV PWM Current Scope
phContext: Toyota Vios/Altis/Fortuner ECV compressors
symptoms: A/C warm at idle
diagnosticSteps: 1. Scope ECV current (0.2–0.8A PWM at ~400–500 Hz). 2. Full 0.8A command with equalized manifold pressures = mechanically stuck ECV valve!

domainName: Oscilloscope Waveform & Sensor Signal Diagnostics
title: EGR Stepper Motor 4-Phase Waveform — Open Coil
phContext: Nissan/Mitsubishi/Toyota 4-wire/6-wire stepper EGR
symptoms: MIL on, EGR stuck
diagnosticSteps: 1. Scope all 4 stepper drive pins at key-on/off initialization sweep (each must pull cleanly to 0V in sequence). 2. Dead phase = open coil or burned ECM driver.

domainName: Oscilloscope Waveform & Sensor Signal Diagnostics
title: ABS Tone Ring Runout Scope — Amplitude Modulation
phContext: Cars with false ABS activation at <15 km/h
symptoms: Pedal buzzes before every stop on dry road
diagnosticSteps: 1. Scope passive VR ABS sensor while spinning wheel at steady speed. 2. 'Hourglass' waxing-and-waning amplitude wave = bent tone ring or loose wheel bearing!

domainName: Oscilloscope Waveform & Sensor Signal Diagnostics
title: Ignition Coil Dwell Time Check — Overheating Coils
phContext: Aftermarket/swapped ECM or wrong coil type installed
symptoms: Coils burn out every few weeks
diagnosticSteps: 1. Scope primary coil trigger: normal dwell is 2.0–4.0 ms! 2. Dwell >6–8 ms saturates and melts coils; <1.5 ms causes weak spark misfire.

domainName: Oscilloscope Waveform & Sensor Signal Diagnostics
title: TPS1 + TPS2 Sum Check on Scope — Opposing Signals
phContext: Bosch/Denso/Delphi ETCs with inverted dual tracks
symptoms: Immediate limp mode
diagnosticSteps: 1. Set scope Math channel: Ch1 + Ch2! 2. For inverted tracks (0.8->4.2V and 4.2->0.8V), Ch1+Ch2 MUST stay flat at ~5.0V across full sweep; any dip = bad TPS.

domainName: Oscilloscope Waveform & Sensor Signal Diagnostics
title: K-Line (ISO 14230) 5-Baud / Fast Init Scope Check
phContext: Diagnosing 'No Comm' on 2000–2012 PH cars
symptoms: Scan tool fails to link
diagnosticSteps: 1. Scope DLC Pin 7 at scan attempt: VCI must pull 12V down to 0V cleanly (5 bps or 25 ms fast-init pulse), followed by ECU 0x55/0xCC reply! 2. Stuck at 0V = radio short; no reply = dead ECU.

domainName: Oscilloscope Waveform & Sensor Signal Diagnostics
title: Evaporator Core Pressure / Airflow Pulsation — Blown Head Gasket
phContext: Verifying subtle head gasket leak without tearing engine down
symptoms: Mysterious coolant loss, slight miss cold
diagnosticSteps: 1. Use cooling system pressure pulse transducer at radiator neck while running: rhythmic combustion-frequency spikes = head gasket breach!

domainName: Oscilloscope Waveform & Sensor Signal Diagnostics
title: Wideband O2 Heater PWM Waveform — Open vs. Short
phContext: Modern Toyota/Honda/Ford wideband A/F sensors
symptoms: MIL on, slow warmup
diagnosticSteps: 1. Scope heater low-side pin (ECM pulses 12V->0V PWM to control ceramic temp at ~750°C). 2. Verify 12V supply holds steady during ON pulse.

domainName: Oscilloscope Waveform & Sensor Signal Diagnostics
title: Blower Motor PWM Speed Controller Scope (Auto-A/C)
phContext: Vehicles with dead or full-speed-only automatic climate blower
symptoms: Blower stuck on Max or Off
diagnosticSteps: 1. Scope thin signal wire to blower power transistor/MOSFET module while changing fan speed 1–7. 2. Changing voltage/PWM with dead fan = failed MOSFET pack!

domainName: Oscilloscope Waveform & Sensor Signal Diagnostics
title: Diesel Glow Plug Current Clamp Check — Quick 4-Plug Test
phContext: Checking all 4 glow plugs in 15 seconds without pulling them!
symptoms: Hard cold start
diagnosticSteps: 1. Clamp DC amp probe around main glow busbar feed wire, turn key ON: 4 healthy plugs draw ~60–75A initially tapering to ~35A. 2. Only 45A initial = 1 dead plug; 30A = 2 dead!

domainName: Oscilloscope Waveform & Sensor Signal Diagnostics
title: USB / CAN / Ethernet DoIP Differential Pair Check
phContext: 2023+ DoIP vehicles failing VCI connection
symptoms: Scan tool sees VIN? No, fails DoIP handshake
diagnosticSteps: 1. Check DLC Pin 8 (Ethernet activation) 5V/12V and Pins 3/11, 12/13 differential continuity. 2. Verify VCI supports DoIP protocol.

domainName: Oscilloscope Waveform & Sensor Signal Diagnostics
title: Horn / Relay Contact Bounce Scope — Intermittent Honk
phContext: Horn honks weakly or stutters
symptoms: Intermittent horn operation
diagnosticSteps: 1. Scope horn (+) terminal while pressing horn: noisy chattering voltage = pitted relay contacts or loose ground.

domainName: Automotive Relay, Fuse, Grounding & Voltage-Drop Troubleshooting
title: Dynamic Voltage Drop Test — Why Ohmmeter Lies!
phContext: Wire has 1 single copper strand left intact (reads 0.2 Ω static, fails under load!)
symptoms: Fuel pump/starter/fan works unloaded, dies under load
diagnosticSteps: 1. NEVER trust an ohmmeter alone on high-current circuits! 2. Measure voltage across the wire/switch WHILE load is turned ON: >0.2V drop on ground or >0.5V on positive = bad wire/terminal!

domainName: Automotive Relay, Fuse, Grounding & Voltage-Drop Troubleshooting
title: Spread Female Relay/Fuse Terminals — Intermittent Fuel/Fan
phContext: Technician jammed thick test-light probe into mini-fuse/relay slot!
symptoms: Fuel pump or radiator fan cuts out over bumps, fuse isn't blown!
diagnosticSteps: 1. Perform 'pin-drag test' with spare male spade/fuse blade (must feel firm grip!). 2. Re-tension spread female terminal with pick or replace terminal. 3. Never jam fat probes into fuse slots.

domainName: Automotive Relay, Fuse, Grounding & Voltage-Drop Troubleshooting
title: Wrong Relay Pinout (4-Pin vs. 5-Pin / ISO vs. Micro) Swapped
phContext: Aftermarket relay bought at auto supply with swapped 85/86/30/87 pins!
symptoms: Fan runs backwards/nonstop or blows fuse immediately on install
diagnosticSteps: 1. Compare schematic diagram printed on relay side! (Some Japanese/Ford relays swap 30 & 86 positions!). 2. Always verify coil pins (60–120 Ω) vs. switch pins before plugging in.

domainName: Automotive Relay, Fuse, Grounding & Voltage-Drop Troubleshooting
title: Relay Without Flyback Diode/Resistor Spiking ECU Driver
phContext: Replacing OEM suppressed relay with cheap bare aftermarket relay
symptoms: New relay works for 1 week, then fries ECM transistor!
diagnosticSteps: 1. OEM ECU-controlled relays contain an internal flyback suppression diode or parallel resistor across 85–86! 2. Always install diode/resistor-protected relay on ECU-driven circuits.

domainName: Automotive Relay, Fuse, Grounding & Voltage-Drop Troubleshooting
title: Painted Chassis Ground Stud After Body/Fender Repaint
phContext: Cars returning from collision repair with erratic lights/ECM
symptoms: Dim headlights, wipers move slowly, random sensor faults
diagnosticSteps: 1. Locate ground lugs bolted to newly painted radiator support or inner fender. 2. Unbolt, wire-brush paint down to shiny bare steel, bolt tight, and coat top with dielectric grease!

domainName: Automotive Relay, Fuse, Grounding & Voltage-Drop Troubleshooting
title: Green Crust Inside Crimped Copper Lug — 'Invisible' Open
phContext: Battery/alternator/starter cables in humid/coastal PH areas
symptoms: Cable looks fine outside, drops 4V under cranking!
diagnosticSteps: 1. Slice back 1 cm of heat-shrink at battery/starter lug to check for green copper oxide powder! 2. Replace corroded lug with tinned copper lug + adhesive-lined heat shrink.

domainName: Automotive Relay, Fuse, Grounding & Voltage-Drop Troubleshooting
title: Scotch-Lock / Vampire T-Tap Corroding OEM Wire in Half
phContext: Cars with aftermarket alarms, GPS trackers, or fog lights
symptoms: OEM taillight, fuel pump, or CAN wire goes dead months later
diagnosticSteps: 1. Locate blue/red plastic clip-on T-taps (they nick copper strands and trap moisture!). 2. Remove T-taps, solder/crimp properly with marine adhesive heat-shrink.

domainName: Automotive Relay, Fuse, Grounding & Voltage-Drop Troubleshooting
title: Fusible Link Wire Stretched/Softened Inside Insulation
phContext: Older Japanese cars (Tamaraw, L300, older Civic/Corolla)
symptoms: Partial power loss, main wire feels mushy/stretchy like rubber
diagnosticSteps: 1. Tug gently on fusible link wires near battery (+): burned internal copper melts while outer hypalon insulation stays intact! 2. Replace with exact-gauge fusible link.

domainName: Automotive Relay, Fuse, Grounding & Voltage-Drop Troubleshooting
title: Shared Ground Point Causing Weird Cross-Feedback ('Disco Lights')
phContext: Taillights dim when brake pressed, turn signals flash brake/reverse lights!
symptoms: Rear lights blink like Christmas tree when braking + signaling
diagnosticSteps: 1. Classic bad rear taillight ground! Current from brake/signal seeks ground backward through neighboring bulb filaments! 2. Clean rear body ground bolt near trunk/tailgate.

domainName: Automotive Relay, Fuse, Grounding & Voltage-Drop Troubleshooting
title: Micro-2 / Micro-3 Fuse Blows Only When Hot — Undersized Aftermarket
phContext: Cheap P5 counterfeit fuses from marketplace melting instead of blowing
symptoms: Plastic fuse melts fuse box before filament pops!
diagnosticSteps: 1. Throw away unbranded cheap plastic fuses (wrong zinc alloy!). 2. Use genuine Littelfuse/Bussmann/OEM fuses and verify circuit amp draw.

domainName: Automotive Relay, Fuse, Grounding & Voltage-Drop Troubleshooting
title: Test Light Loading Down 5V Sensor / Airbag Circuit!
phContext: Technician using incandescent 12V test light on ECM/SRS pins!
symptoms: Blows ECM 5V driver or risks deploying airbag!
diagnosticSteps: 1. NEVER use an incandescent bulb test light on computer sensor, CAN, or yellow SRS wires! 2. Use high-impedance (>10 MΩ) DMM or oscilloscope for logic/sensors; save load test light for B+/relays/bulbs.

domainName: Automotive Relay, Fuse, Grounding & Voltage-Drop Troubleshooting
title: Backfeeding Fuse Tap Installed Backwards (Unprotected Side)
phContext: DIYer plugging Add-A-Circuit fuse tap upside down!
symptoms: Accessory draws 15A through original 10A fuse, blowing factory circuit
diagnosticSteps: 1. Probe fuse slot with key ON to find HOT (supply) vs. LOAD side! 2. Orient Add-A-Circuit leg so accessory current bypasses original fuse and uses its own top fuse.

domainName: Automotive Relay, Fuse, Grounding & Voltage-Drop Troubleshooting
title: Engine-to-Chassis Braided Ground Strap Snapped by Vibration
phContext: Manual cars/diesels; brittle braided copper strap breaks near mount
symptoms: Slow crank, erratic sensors, or clutch cable/shift cable heats up!
diagnosticSteps: 1. Inspect flat braided ground strap from cylinder head/bellhousing to firewall/frame. 2. Replace with heavy 4–6 AWG tinned ground strap.

domainName: Automotive Relay, Fuse, Grounding & Voltage-Drop Troubleshooting
title: Main Relay Contacts Pitted — Works When Tapped
phContext: Older Honda PGM-FI / Toyota EFI / Mitsubishi main relays
symptoms: Car stalls hot, restarts after tapping dashboard/fuse box
diagnosticSteps: 1. Open plastic relay cover and inspect solder joints on PCB (cracked rings!) and silver contact tips (black/pitted!). 2. Replace relay.

domainName: Automotive Relay, Fuse, Grounding & Voltage-Drop Troubleshooting
title: Water Wicked Up Wiring Harness by Capillary Action!
phContext: Flooded O2/ABS/trans sensor wicking water 1 meter UP into ECU plug!
symptoms: ECU pins corroded green despite ECU being mounted high on firewall!
diagnosticSteps: 1. Inspect ECU connector pins for moisture even if water never reached ECU height! (Stranded wire acts like a straw!). 2. Replace wicking sensor/harness & seal splices.

domainName: Automotive Relay, Fuse, Grounding & Voltage-Drop Troubleshooting
title: Blown 100A/120A Bolt-In Fuse — Cannot Pull Out Without Unbolting!
phContext: Toyota/Honda/Nissan/Mits ubishi main fuse boxes
symptoms: Technician breaks plastic fuse box trying to yank bolt-in fuse with pliers!
diagnosticSteps: 1. NEVER yank clear-top main fuses with pliers! 2. Remove fuse box lower cover/side clip and unbolt the two M5/M6 retaining bolts holding fuse legs!

domainName: Automotive Relay, Fuse, Grounding & Voltage-Drop Troubleshooting
title: Ignition Switch ACC Position Dead, IG1 Works — Burnt Contact
phContext: Cars with heavy audio/dashcam/chargers on ACC circuit
symptoms: Radio & 12V sockets dead, engine starts and runs fine
diagnosticSteps: 1. Check ACC 15A fuse first. 2. Measure voltage on ACC output wire at ignition switch under load. 3. Replace switch or add ACC relay.

domainName: Automotive Relay, Fuse, Grounding & Voltage-Drop Troubleshooting
title: High-Resistance Thermal Circuit Breaker Cycling (Power Seats/Windows)
phContext: Older vehicles with auto-resetting PTC/bimetal breakers
symptoms: Power window stops after 5 seconds, works again 30 seconds later
diagnosticSteps: 1. Dry window tracks / binding regulator draws >20A tripping thermal breaker! 2. Measure motor amperage and lubricate tracks/replace motor.

domainName: Automotive Relay, Fuse, Grounding & Voltage-Drop Troubleshooting
title: Aftermarket Relay Mounted Upside Down — Fills with Rainwater
phContext: Fog light / horn relays mounted behind grille with wires pointing UP!
symptoms: Relay rusts solid inside within 1 month
diagnosticSteps: 1. Always mount underhood relays with terminals pointing DOWN (and waterproof skirted relay socket) so rainwater drains out!

domainName: Automotive Relay, Fuse, Grounding & Voltage-Drop Troubleshooting
title: Battery Negative Clamp Loose on Tapered Post — Bottomed Out
phContext: Smaller JIS B19/B24 post vs. larger DIN clamp, or clamp installed too high
symptoms: Clamp tightens fully yet still spins on post
diagnosticSteps: 1. Seat clamp all the way down to base of tapered lead post! 2. Use proper JIS-to-DIN brass post adapters if needed.

domainName: Automotive Relay, Fuse, Grounding & Voltage-Drop Troubleshooting
title: Intermittent Short Only When Shifting / Engine Rocks — Torque Twist
phContext: Engine mount torn + harness clipped too tight near exhaust/bracket
symptoms: Blows fuse or stalls ONLY on hard takeoff or Reverse!
diagnosticSteps: 1. Power-brake gently (with helper) while watching engine harness clearance near manifold, A/C pulley, and firewall! 2. Repair chafed loom & replace torn mount.

domainName: Automotive Relay, Fuse, Grounding & Voltage-Drop Troubleshooting
title: Two-Wire Coolant/Oil Fan Switch Shorted — Fan Runs Key-Off
phContext: Older cars with radiator-mounted thermoswitch
symptoms: Fan runs nonstop until battery dies
diagnosticSteps: 1. Unplug 2-pin thermoswitch on radiator bottom tank: if fan stops, switch is stuck closed! 2. Replace switch.

domainName: Automotive Relay, Fuse, Grounding & Voltage-Drop Troubleshooting
title: Corroded Underbody Ground Bolt — Fuel Pump Runs Slowly
phContext: Sedans/SUVs with fuel pump ground bolted to rusty rear floorpan
symptoms: Fuel pressure drops at high RPM despite new pump!
diagnosticSteps: 1. Measure voltage drop from fuel pump (-) wire at tank plug to chassis (-) while pump runs (<0.2V). 2. Clean rusty rear ground bolt.

domainName: Automotive Relay, Fuse, Grounding & Voltage-Drop Troubleshooting
title: Blown Fuse Replaced With Foil / Higher Amp Fuse — Melted Harness!
phContext: Roadside 'band-aid' fix: 30A fuse put in 10A circuit
symptoms: Smoke from dashboard, melted 2-meter harness!
diagnosticSteps: 1. NEVER upsize a fuse! A fuse protects the WIRE gauge, not the device. 2. Trace and repair short circuit before installing exact OEM amperage fuse.

domainName: Automotive Relay, Fuse, Grounding & Voltage-Drop Troubleshooting
title: Alternator Exciter / Sense Fuse Blown — Overcharging 16V+
phContext: Toyota/Nissan/Mitsubishi ALT-S 7.5A fuse blown
symptoms: Battery boiling, headlights super bright, >16V charging
diagnosticSteps: 1. Check 7.5A/10A ALT-S (Sense) fuse in engine bay! (Open Sense wire tricks regulator into thinking battery is at 0V, commanding max output!). 2. Replace fuse & inspect wire.

domainName: Automotive Relay, Fuse, Grounding & Voltage-Drop Troubleshooting
title: Power Distribution Box (PDC) Internal Busbar Crack
phContext: SUVs/trucks with vibration-fatigued underhood fuse box PCB
symptoms: Random fuel pump or starter relay drops out until fuse box pressed
diagnosticSteps: 1. Press/flex engine bay fuse box gently while engine idles to see if it stumbles. 2. Open PDC and reflow cracked busbar solder or replace PDC.

domainName: Automotive Relay, Fuse, Grounding & Voltage-Drop Troubleshooting
title: Aftermarket LED Lightbar Wired Without Relay — Melts Dash Switch
phContext: Pickups/SUVs with 120W– 240W off-road LED bar wired straight to toggle
symptoms: Toggle switch melts and smokes inside cabin
diagnosticSteps: 1. Wire high-wattage LED bars through 40A relay + 12 AWG wire + 30A fuse at battery; use dash switch only for relay coil (0.15A)!

domainName: Automotive Relay, Fuse, Grounding & Voltage-Drop Troubleshooting
title: Spare Fuse Slot Mistaken for Active Slot — Missing Circuit
phContext: DIYer pulls fuse to check, puts it back in an empty spare slot!
symptoms: Radio, wipers, or A/C dead right after 'checking fuses'!
diagnosticSteps: 1. Check fuse box lid diagram carefully (match pin metal tabs inside slot: empty slots have only 1 metal terminal!). 2. Move fuse back to correct slot.

domainName: Automotive Relay, Fuse, Grounding & Voltage-Drop Troubleshooting
title: Diode Pack / Alternator Tri-Diode Short — Parasitic 2A Draw
phContext: Alternator with 1 shorted positive rectifier diode
symptoms: Battery dies overnight, alternator housing feels warm key-off!
diagnosticSteps: 1. Feel alternator housing after car sits overnight: if noticeably warm to touch, a shorted rectifier diode is draining 2– 4A! 2. Unplug alternator B+ to confirm draw drops. 3. Rebuild alternator.

domainName: Automotive Relay, Fuse, Grounding & Voltage-Drop Troubleshooting
title: Trailer / Bike-Rack Wiring Shorting Reverse & Brake Fuses
phContext: Pickups with corroded 7-pin trailer socket at rear hitch
symptoms: Blows STOP or BACKUP fuse every time shifting to Reverse
diagnosticSteps: 1. Inspect rear 7-pin trailer socket for mud/rust bridging pins! 2. Unplug trailer sub-harness and replace socket.

domainName: Automotive Relay, Fuse, Grounding & Voltage-Drop Troubleshooting
title: Door Jamb Rubber Boot Wire Break — Speaker + Lock + Window
phContext: High-mileage taxis/cars; driver door opened 10,000+ times
symptoms: Driver speaker crackles, window works only with door half-open
diagnosticSteps: 1. Pull back rubber accordion boot between A-pillar and driver door. 2. Tug gently on each wire (broken copper inside intact PVC snaps!). 3. Splice flexible silicone wire.

domainName: Automotive Relay, Fuse, Grounding & Voltage-Drop Troubleshooting
title: Dual-Battery / Inverter Grounded Through Chassis Paint — Arcing
phContext: Camper/overland pickups with 1500W inverter in truck bed
symptoms: Inverter shuts off on high load, sparks at bed bolts
diagnosticSteps: 1. Run dedicated heavy negative cable from auxiliary battery/inverter directly to frame rail (not painted truck bed!). 2. Torque & seal.

domainName: Automotive Relay, Fuse, Grounding & Voltage-Drop Troubleshooting
title: Horn Button Grounding Through Loose Steering Column U-Joint
phContext: Older mechanical-column cars without dedicated column ground jumper
symptoms: Horn stops working intermittently
diagnosticSteps: 1. Check small brass ground spring/jumper across steering column rag-joint/U-joint. 2. Restore ground path.

domainName: Automotive Relay, Fuse, Grounding & Voltage-Drop Troubleshooting
title: Cooling Fan Wired Backwards (Pushing Instead of Pulling!)
phContext: Aftermarket replacement fan motor wired with reversed polarity
symptoms: Overheats at highway speed & traffic! Fan blows air FORWARD out grille
diagnosticSteps: 1. Hold tissue paper in front of grille with fan ON: air MUST suck INWARD through grille toward engine! 2. Swap 2-pin motor wires if blowing forward.

domainName: Automotive Relay, Fuse, Grounding & Voltage-Drop Troubleshooting
title: Blower Motor Resistor Overheating — Bad Blower Ground
phContext: Cars where blower resistor burns out every 3 months
symptoms: Blower slows down, plastic resistor plug melts
diagnosticSteps: 1. Measure blower motor amp draw (worn bushings draw 18–25A instead of 10–12A!). 2. Replace dragging blower motor AND melted resistor plug.

domainName: Automotive Relay, Fuse, Grounding & Voltage-Drop Troubleshooting
title: Headlight Ground Wire Shared With Turn Signal — Weak Dim Bulb
phContext: Cars after front fender collision repair
symptoms: One headlight glows dim orange like a candle
diagnosticSteps: 1. Measure voltage drop from headlight (-) pin to battery (-) with high beams ON (>0.5V = bad ground!). 2. Trace ground wire to fender apron.

domainName: Automotive Relay, Fuse, Grounding & Voltage-Drop Troubleshooting
title: Starter Relay Coil Open Only When Engine Bay Hits 85°C
phContext: Thermal copper break inside relay winding
symptoms: Starts fine cold, no-crank after 1 hr drive, starts when cooled
diagnosticSteps: 1. Swap starter relay with identical horn/fog relay when hot no-crank occurs! 2. Replace heat-sensitive relay.

domainName: Automotive Relay, Fuse, Grounding & Voltage-Drop Troubleshooting
title: Fuel Pump Inertia / Crash Cutoff Switch Tripped by Deep Pothole
phContext: Older Ford/European/some Asian cars hitting huge lubak
symptoms: Cranks no start after hitting pothole, zero fuel pressure
diagnosticSteps: 1. Locate red reset button on Inertia Fuel Shutoff Switch (passenger kick panel or trunk side) and press down until it clicks! 2. Verify pump primes.

domainName: Automotive Relay, Fuse, Grounding & Voltage-Drop Troubleshooting
title: 5-Pin Relay Terminal 87a Wired Instead of 87 — Accessory Always ON
phContext: DIYer installing relay using middle 87a pin
symptoms: Fog lights/fan stay ON when switched OFF, turn OFF when switched ON!
diagnosticSteps: 1. Remember: 87a (center) is Normally Closed (connected to 30 at rest); 87 (outer) is Normally Open! 2. Move load wire to Pin 87.

domainName: Automotive Relay, Fuse, Grounding & Voltage-Drop Troubleshooting
title: Multimeter Blown Internal 10A/400mA Fuse — False '0 mA' Parasitic Read!
phContext: Technician getting 0.00 mA on every parasitic draw test!
symptoms: Car still dies overnight despite meter reading 0 mA
diagnosticSteps: 1. Test your own multimeter mA fuse by measuring resistance across the meter's mA/A jacks with another meter (or test on a known 50 mA bulb)! 2. Replace blown ceramic fuse inside DMM.

domainName: Air Conditioning Electrical, Dual-Zone Climate & Compressor Control Faults
title: A/C Compressor Clutch Doesn't Engage — Low Pressure Lockout
phContext: All PH cars; R134a/R1234yf leaked below ~25–30 psi static
symptoms: A/C button lights up, blower blows warm air, clutch stationary
diagnosticSteps: 1. Check manifold gauge static pressure (0–20 psi = empty!). 2. Read A/C Pressure PID in ECM/BCM. 3. Never jump compressor clutch dry — nitrogen/UV leak test & recharge!

domainName: Air Conditioning Electrical, Dual-Zone Climate & Compressor Control Faults
title: A/C Clutch Relay Good, Yet No 12V at Compressor — Thermal Protector
phContext: Honda, Toyota, Mitsubishi; thermal overload switch on compressor body
symptoms: A/C works for 10 min then cuts out when compressor gets hot
diagnosticSteps: 1. Check continuity across 1-pin/2-pin thermal protector switch bolted to compressor top! 2. High head pressure (>350 psi) overheats compressor tripping thermal switch. 3. Fix condenser cooling.

domainName: Air Conditioning Electrical, Dual-Zone Climate & Compressor Control Faults
title: Dual-Aircon Rear Blows Warm While Front Is Ice Cold — Rear TXV/Solenoid
phContext: Innova, Fortuner, Montero, HiAce, Ertiga; clogged rear expansion valve
symptoms: Front vents 6°C, rear ceiling vents 26°C
diagnosticSteps: 1. Check if rear A/C liquid/suction pipes under floor are cold/frosting or warm. 2. Test rear A/C magnetic shutoff solenoid (if equipped) 12V/ground. 3. Replace clogged rear TXV.

domainName: Air Conditioning Electrical, Dual-Zone Climate & Compressor Control Faults
title: A/C Blows Cold Only on Feet or Defrost — Broken Mode Door Actuator
phContext: Auto-climate sedans/SUVs; stripped plastic gear in mode servo
symptoms: No air from center dash vents despite fan roaring
diagnosticSteps: 1. Scan HVAC ECU for Mode Door Actuator DTCs. 2. Watch mode servo arm under driver/passenger dash while cycling Face/Feet/Defrost. 3. Replace mode actuator.

domainName: Air Conditioning Electrical, Dual-Zone Climate & Compressor Control Faults
title: A/C Evaporator Freeze-Up — Skewed Thermistor Reading +15°C
phContext: Cars where A/C stops blowing air after 45 min on expressway
symptoms: Ice chunks blow from vents, airflow drops to zero
diagnosticSteps: 1. Read Evaporator Temp PID when vents are ice-cold (if PID reads >8°C while core is freezing, thermistor is skewed!). 2. Replace evaporator thermistor sensor.

domainName: Air Conditioning Electrical, Dual-Zone Climate & Compressor Control Faults
title: A/C Refrigerant Pressure Sensor Range — Trapped Moisture/Air
phContext: Cars recharged without proper 30-min vacuum pull
symptoms: Erratic A/C cycling, high head pressure >300 psi
diagnosticSteps: 1. Check static pressure vs. ambient temp chart (air/non-condensables spike high-side pressure!). 2. Recover, pull deep vacuum (<500 microns) 30 min, and recharge exact grams.

domainName: Air Conditioning Electrical, Dual-Zone Climate & Compressor Control Faults
title: A/C Compressor Clutch Coil Burned Open — 0 Continuity
phContext: High-mileage cars; clutch coil shorted/open from heat & flood
symptoms: 12V reaches compressor plug, clutch never pulls in
diagnosticSteps: 1. Unplug 1-pin/2-pin clutch wire at compressor and measure coil resistance to compressor ground (spec 3.0–4.2 ohms; infinite = open!). 2. Replace clutch coil.

domainName: Air Conditioning Electrical, Dual-Zone Climate & Compressor Control Faults
title: A/C Cuts Off Repeatedly in Traffic — High-Pressure Cutoff (>420 psi)
phContext: Cars with overcharged R134a or dying condenser fan
symptoms: Cold for 30 sec, warm for 30 sec, loud fan
diagnosticSteps: 1. Watch high-side gauge climb past 380–420 psi in traffic! 2. Verify condenser fan speed and clean condenser fins. 3. Recover & recharge exact weight.

domainName: Air Conditioning Electrical, Dual-Zone Climate & Compressor Control Faults
title: A/C Clutch Engages Momentarily Then Immediately Releases — Lock Sensor
phContext: Toyota/Denso compressors with 3-pin Lock Sensor (speed pickup)
symptoms: A/C button blinks! Clutch engages 2 sec then turns off
diagnosticSteps: 1. Note: Blinking A/C button on Toyota = Compressor Lock Sensor mismatch (belt slipping or seized compressor)! 2. Check belt tension and scope lock sensor AC pulse. 3. Replace compressor/sensor.

domainName: Air Conditioning Electrical, Dual-Zone Climate & Compressor Control Faults
title: A/C Compressor Seized — Belt Snaps Immediately When A/C Turned ON
phContext: Neglected A/C system run dry of PAG oil
symptoms: Engine stalls or loud belt screech the second A/C button pressed
diagnosticSteps: 1. Key off: try turning inner clutch hub plate by hand (must spin smoothly; locked solid = seized compressor!). 2. Flush system & replace compressor + condenser + drier.

domainName: Air Conditioning Electrical, Dual-Zone Climate & Compressor Control Faults
title: Blower Fan Speeds Fluctuate Randomly — Worn Carbon Brushes
phContext: High-mileage taxis/vans; blower motor slows down & speeds up
symptoms: Airflow surges even on fixed fan speed
diagnosticSteps: 1. Tap bottom of blower motor housing under glovebox (speed changes = worn brushes/commutator!). 2. Replace blower motor.

domainName: Air Conditioning Electrical, Dual-Zone Climate & Compressor Control Faults
title: A/C Amplifier / ECM Not Receiving 'A/C Request' — Bad Dash Switch
phContext: Manual A/C cars; worn A/C push-button or blower speed switch
symptoms: Blower works, A/C light on switch dead, clutch never engages
diagnosticSteps: 1. Check 'A/C Switch Request' PID in Engine ECM while pressing A/C button (must toggle OFF->ON only when blower fan is ON!). 2. Test dash A/C switch & blower ground.

domainName: Air Conditioning Electrical, Dual-Zone Climate & Compressor Control Faults
title: Auto Climate Control Blows Full Heat on One Side — Stuck Heater Valve
phContext: Vehicles with electric/vacuum coolant heater control valve
symptoms: AC struggles, hot coolant flowing through heater core
diagnosticSteps: 1. Feel heater hoses at firewall with A/C on MAX COLD (if scorching hot while A/C is on Max Cold and car has shutoff valve, valve is stuck!). 2. Check blend door seal foam too.

domainName: Air Conditioning Electrical, Dual-Zone Climate & Compressor Control Faults
title: Shattered Foam on Blend Door Flaps — Lukewarm A/C & Foam Bits!
phContext: 8–12 year old cars; disintegrating black sponge seals blowing out vents
symptoms: Black sticky foam crumbs blowing out A/C vents, weak cooling
diagnosticSteps: 1. Inspect vents for crumbling black foam! Hot heater-core air bleeds past bare metal blend doors when foam rots off! 2. Re-foam blend doors during evaporator service.

domainName: Air Conditioning Electrical, Dual-Zone Climate & Compressor Control Faults
title: A/C Low-Side Pipe Frosting Over Under Hood — Stuck Closed TXV / Fan
phContext: Low airflow across evaporator (clogged cabin filter or dead blower)
symptoms: White frost coating thick aluminum suction line to compressor
diagnosticSteps: 1. Check cabin filter & blower airflow FIRST! 2. Check low-side pressure (if <15 psi while high-side is normal, TXV is restricted/stuck!). 3. Replace TXV.

domainName: Air Conditioning Electrical, Dual-Zone Climate & Compressor Control Faults
title: Variable ECV Compressor Control Wire Open — 0A Command
phContext: Toyota Vios/Altis/Fortuner, Hyundai, Kia; rat-chewed 2-pin ECV plug
symptoms: A/C never cools, compressor spins silently
diagnosticSteps: 1. Measure resistance of 2-pin ECV valve on compressor rear (spec ~10– 15 ohms). 2. Check 12V/PWM command from A/C Amplifier. 3. Repair wire.

domainName: Air Conditioning Electrical, Dual-Zone Climate & Compressor Control Faults
title: Condenser Fan Spins Backwards or Weakly — High Head Pressure
phContext: Aftermarket fan motor installed with reversed wires
symptoms: A/C warm in traffic, cool on highway
diagnosticSteps: 1. Verify fan pulls air FROM grille THROUGH condenser TOWARD engine! 2. Measure fan amp draw. 3. Fix polarity or replace weak motor.

domainName: Air Conditioning Electrical, Dual-Zone Climate & Compressor Control Faults
title: Dual-Zone A/C Calibration Lost After Battery Disconnect
phContext: Ford, Hyundai, Kia, Mazda, GM; blend doors hitting end-stops
symptoms: Clicking behind dash, wrong vent temps
diagnosticSteps: 1. Run HVAC Actuator Calibration via scan tool (or pull HVAC fuse 1 min, then key ON 60 sec without touching controls so doors learn end-stops!). 2. Verify.

domainName: Air Conditioning Electrical, Dual-Zone Climate & Compressor Control Faults
title: A/C Pressure Switch 3-Wire vs. 2-Wire Binary Switch Fault
phContext: Older vs. modern cars; corroded pressure switch on receiver-drier
symptoms: Compressor won't engage despite 90 psi static pressure
diagnosticSteps: 1. On 2-wire binary switch, check continuity across pins (must be closed at 30–350 psi). 2. On 3-wire transducer, measure 5V, GND, and signal (1.0–4.5V). 3. Replace switch.

domainName: Air Conditioning Electrical, Dual-Zone Climate & Compressor Control Faults
title: Engine Idle Doesn't Step Up When A/C Turns On — Rough Shake
phContext: Older EFI/carb cars or dirty throttle body
symptoms: RPM drops from 750 to 500 and shudders when compressor clicks in
diagnosticSteps: 1. Verify ECM receives 'A/C ON' signal and commands idle air/throttle step-up (+100–150 RPM). 2. Clean throttle body and check idle learn.

domainName: Air Conditioning Electrical, Dual-Zone Climate & Compressor Control Faults
title: Hissing Noise Behind Dash When A/C Runs — Low Refrigerant!
phContext: Slow pinhole leak in evaporator or condenser
symptoms: A/C cools weakly, loud continuous 'shhhhh' sound behind glovebox
diagnosticSteps: 1. Connect gauges: low side drops <20 psi and high side <130 psi! 2. Leak-test evaporator core with electronic sniffer/UV dye. 3. Repair leak & recharge.

domainName: Air Conditioning Electrical, Dual-Zone Climate & Compressor Control Faults
title: A/C Compressor Knocking / Rattling — Wrong Oil Amount or Liquid Slug
phContext: Aftermarket compressor installed without balancing PAG oil
symptoms: Loud metallic knock when compressor engages
diagnosticSteps: 1. Never add extra PAG oil blindly (too much oil slugs compressor valves; too little seizes pistons!). 2. Drain & measure exact OEM PAG oil ml. 3. Replace damaged compressor.

domainName: Air Conditioning Electrical, Dual-Zone Climate & Compressor Control Faults
title: Rear A/C Blower Relay Melted — High Rear Fan Amp Draw
phContext: Innova, HiAce, Urvan, Montero; worn rear blower motor
symptoms: Rear blower cuts out randomly
diagnosticSteps: 1. Inspect rear blower relay in rear quarter/cabin box for melted socket. 2. Check rear blower motor current draw. 3. Replace motor & relay.

domainName: Air Conditioning Electrical, Dual-Zone Climate & Compressor Control Faults
title: Fresh/Recirculation Flap Actuator Broken — Exhaust Smell in Cabin
phContext: Toyota/Mitsubishi/Honda; stripped plastic gear on recirc servo
symptoms: Jeepney smoke enters cabin even with Recirc light ON
diagnosticSteps: 1. Pull cabin filter behind glovebox and watch plastic recirc door move when pressing button! 2. If motor whirs without moving flap, replace recirc servo.

domainName: Air Conditioning Electrical, Dual-Zone Climate & Compressor Control Faults
title: A/C Cuts Out Over 3000 RPM — Over-Shimmed Clutch or Voltage Drop
phContext: High-mileage cars; weak magnetic pull at high RPM vibration
symptoms: A/C blows warm during highway overtaking
diagnosticSteps: 1. Check clutch air gap (<0.6 mm) and charging voltage at 3500 RPM. 2. Verify ECM isn't triggering WOT/ECT cutout.

domainName: Air Conditioning Electrical, Dual-Zone Climate & Compressor Control Faults
title: Water Dripping Onto Passenger Shoes — Cracked Evaporator Case
phContext: Cars after sloppy evaporator cleaning without removing blower
symptoms: Clean cold water drips from bottom of black plastic heater box
diagnosticSteps: 1. Check if rubber drain hose is clogged first. 2. Inspect lower evaporator housing seam for cracked clip or missing foam seal. 3. Reseal housing.

domainName: Air Conditioning Electrical, Dual-Zone Climate & Compressor Control Faults
title: HV Electric A/C Compressor (EV/HEV) Noisy — Normal vs. Bearing
phContext: BYD, Toyota HEV, Nissan e-POWER; 3-phase inverter-driven scroll
symptoms: High-pitched whine when cooling hot cabin
diagnosticSteps: 1. Distinguish normal high-RPM scroll hum (3000–6000 RPM) from dry metallic bearing rattle. 2. Verify ONLY non-conductive POE (ND-11) oil is used!

domainName: Air Conditioning Electrical, Dual-Zone Climate & Compressor Control Faults
title: A/C Low-Pressure Port / Schrader Valve Leaking After Service
phContext: Cars losing Freon 2 weeks after A/C top-up
symptoms: Bubbles/oil inside high/low service port cap!
diagnosticSteps: 1. Spray soapy water into BOTH high and low A/C service ports with caps off! 2. Tighten or replace leaking Schrader valve core with core tool and install O-ringed caps.

domainName: Air Conditioning Electrical, Dual-Zone Climate & Compressor Control Faults
title: Receiver-Drier Bag Burst — Desiccant Beads Plugging TXV!
phContext: Old/cheap A/C drier disintegrating internally
symptoms: Sudden zero cooling, high-side spikes, low-side pulls vacuum
diagnosticSteps: 1. Remove TXV and inspect inlet screen for tiny white/tan silica desiccant beads! 2. Flush all lines/evaporator, replace condenser/drier and TXV.

domainName: Air Conditioning Electrical, Dual-Zone Climate & Compressor Control Faults
title: HVAC Air Mix Damper / Servo Circuit — Feedback Potentiometer
phContext: Toyota/Lexus Auto-A/C; dirty internal position track in servo
symptoms: Temp stuck hot or cold, B1441/B1443
diagnosticSteps: 1. Run HVAC self-diagnostic / scan tool servo test. 2. Open servo, clean carbon wiper track, or replace servo motor.

domainName: Air Conditioning Electrical, Dual-Zone Climate & Compressor Control Faults
title: Blower Motor Wiring Harness Melted at Plug — High Resistance
phContext: Nissan, Ford, Hyundai, Suzuki; loose female spade in blower plug
symptoms: Blower stops until kicked under glovebox!
diagnosticSteps: 1. Unplug 2-pin connector at bottom of blower motor and inspect for brown melted plastic! 2. Cut out burnt plug, crimp heavy terminals or pigtail kit. 3. Check motor amps.

domainName: Air Conditioning Electrical, Dual-Zone Climate & Compressor Control Faults
title: A/C Suction Hose Rubbing Power Steering / Frame — Pinhole Leak
phContext: Pickups/vans after engine mount collapse or sloppy hose routing
symptoms: Oily spot on rubber A/C hose near frame rail
diagnosticSteps: 1. Inspect all A/C hose routing for contact against sharp brackets/pulleys. 2. Replace rubbed hose and secure with insulated P-clips.

domainName: Air Conditioning Electrical, Dual-Zone Climate & Compressor Control Faults
title: Dual-Fan Car: One Fan Spins Slowly — Failing Series/Parallel Relay
phContext: Cars using 3-relay series-parallel fan control (low = series, high = parallel)
symptoms: Both fans run slow on Low, only ONE fan runs on High!
diagnosticSteps: 1. Test all 3 fan relays (Fan 1, Fan 2, Fan Series/Parallel)! 2. Verify each motor runs full speed directly on 12V.

domainName: Air Conditioning Electrical, Dual-Zone Climate & Compressor Control Faults
title: A/C Only Cools When Driving >60 km/h — Missing Foam Baffles
phContext: Cars after front bumper/radiator replacement
symptoms: Hot in traffic, cold on expressway
diagnosticSteps: 1. Check if foam/plastic air-seal baffles around condenser and radiator sides were thrown away during bodywork! (Hot engine air recirculates around condenser!). 2. Seal gaps with foam.

domainName: Air Conditioning Electrical, Dual-Zone Climate & Compressor Control Faults
title: In-Cabin Temp Sensor Aspirator Hose Unplugged — Auto-A/C Erratic
phContext: SUVs/sedans with small grille near driver knee/ignition
symptoms: Auto-A/C blows too cold or too hot randomly
diagnosticSteps: 1. Locate small slatted temp sensor grille on lower dash; check if tiny aspirator fan/vacuum hose behind it is clogged with lint or unplugged! 2. Blow lint clear.

domainName: Air Conditioning Electrical, Dual-Zone Climate & Compressor Control Faults
title: Oily Film Inside Windshield — Pinholed Heater Core (Non-Bypassed)
phContext: Cars where heater core is still connected and weeping coolant
symptoms: Sweet smell + greasy fog on inside of windshield when defrosting
diagnosticSteps: 1. Check passenger carpet for damp coolant and pressure-test cooling system. 2. Replace leaking heater core (or bypass cleanly per OEM flow if owner declines dash pull).

domainName: Air Conditioning Electrical, Dual-Zone Climate & Compressor Control Faults
title: A/C Compressor Pulley Wobbles — Loose Snap Ring / Bearing
phContext: Cars with noisy front pulley even with A/C OFF
symptoms: Metallic rattle from A/C pulley with A/C off, quiet when engaged (or vice versa)
diagnosticSteps: 1. Remove belt and check A/C pulley bearing play & retaining snap-ring groove on compressor snout! 2. Replace pulley bearing.

domainName: Air Conditioning Electrical, Dual-Zone Climate & Compressor Control Faults
title: Aftermarket Tint / Windshield Film Causing Auto-A/C Over-Cooling
phContext: Clear/light solar sensor reads dark, vs. hot cabin
symptoms: Auto-A/C blower runs inconsistently
diagnosticSteps: 1. Check solar sensor PID and in-cabin temp sensor PID against actual thermometer. 2. Adjust temperature offset in HVAC settings if supported.

domainName: Air Conditioning Electrical, Dual-Zone Climate & Compressor Control Faults
title: R1234yf vs. R134a Wrong Refrigerant Mixed — Contamination
phContext: 2020+ newer imports/EVs serviced at shops without R1234yf machine
symptoms: Poor cooling, compressor noise, high head pressure
diagnosticSteps: 1. Check underhood A/C decal for exact refrigerant (R134a vs. R1234yf) and oil (PAG vs. POE)! 2. Never mix R1234yf and R134a.

domainName: Air Conditioning Electrical, Dual-Zone Climate & Compressor Control Faults
title: A/C Shuts Off During Engine Overheat — Normal ECM Protection
phContext: Driver complains 'A/C broke in traffic' while ignoring temp gauge!
symptoms: A/C blows warm right as engine temp hits 110°C+
diagnosticSteps: 1. Check ECT PID FIRST! ECM intentionally cuts A/C clutch above ~108–112°C to save the engine from blowing a head gasket! 2. Fix engine cooling fault.

domainName: Heavy-Duty 24V Bus, Trailer, Dump Truck & Equipment (Hino / Fuso / Volvo / Giga)
title: Heavy-Duty SCR AdBlue Quality / Concentration Fault (Euro-5)
phContext: Isuzu Giga, Hino 500, Volvo/Sinotruk; diluted or tap-water AdBlue
symptoms: Torque derate 25– 40%, AdBlue lamp flashing
diagnosticSteps: 1. Test DEF tank sample with refractometer (must be 32.5% urea). 2. Inspect DEF quality/level sensor in tank for crystal buildup. 3. Drain, flush with distilled water, refill ISO 22241 DEF.

domainName: Heavy-Duty 24V Bus, Trailer, Dump Truck & Equipment (Hino / Fuso / Volvo / Giga)
title: Heavy-Duty Coolant Level Low Sensor — False Alarm / Foam
phContext: Hino 500/700, Isuzu Giga, Fuso; dirty probe in surge tank
symptoms: Stop-Engine red light + buzzer on dash despite full tank
diagnosticSteps: 1. Inspect 2-pin/3-pin coolant level probe in surge tank for scale/oil coating. 2. Check wiring above radiator shroud. 3. Replace sensor & flush cooling system.

domainName: Heavy-Duty 24V Bus, Trailer, Dump Truck & Equipment (Hino / Fuso / Volvo / Giga)
title: 24V Tractor-to-Trailer 7-Pin (ISO 1185) Lights Dead / Blown
phContext: Container haulers (Manila Port / SLEX); crushed trailer coiled cord
symptoms: Trailer brake/tail lights dead, ABS trailer warning on
diagnosticSteps: 1. Inspect coiled green/black suzie cables between tractor and trailer for pulled pins or salt/water corrosion. 2. Check tractor-side 24V trailer fuses & relays. 3. Clean 7-pin brass contacts.

domainName: Heavy-Duty 24V Bus, Trailer, Dump Truck & Equipment (Hino / Fuso / Volvo / Giga)
title: Heavy-Duty Wheel Speed Sensor (WABCO/Knorr ABS) — Air Gap
phContext: 24V buses & trucks; pushed-back sensor from hub vibration
symptoms: ABS warning light on, exhaust brake/retarder disabled
diagnosticSteps: 1. Push ABS sensor firmly inward until it touches exciter ring (self-adjusts gap!). 2. Measure sensor coil resistance (1,100–1,400 ohms) and spin hub to check >0.5V AC output.

domainName: Heavy-Duty 24V Bus, Trailer, Dump Truck & Equipment (Hino / Fuso / Volvo / Giga)
title: Air Dryer Purge Valve Stuck Open — Air Tanks Won't Build Pressure
phContext: Full-air-brake trucks/buses; frozen/sludge-jammed air dryer
symptoms: Continuous loud air leak under chassis, Low Air buzzer stays on
diagnosticSteps: 1. Drain oil/water from wet tank and inspect air dryer desiccant cartridge (change every 12 months!). 2. Clean or rebuild purge valve kit on bottom of air dryer.

domainName: Heavy-Duty 24V Bus, Trailer, Dump Truck & Equipment (Hino / Fuso / Volvo / Giga)
title: Heavy-Duty Boost Pressure Sensor Skew — Soot-Plugged Manifold
phContext: Isuzu 6HK1/6UZ1, Hino J08E/P11C; clogged intake sensor
symptoms: Sluggish hill climb, black smoke, MIL on
diagnosticSteps: 1. Compare Boost PID vs. Baro PID at KOEO. 2. Clean soot from manifold sensor port and verify 5V/GND/signal.

domainName: Heavy-Duty 24V Bus, Trailer, Dump Truck & Equipment (Hino / Fuso / Volvo / Giga)
title: Eddy-Current / Hydraulic Retarder Overheating on Mountain Descent
phContext: Provincial buses & heavy haulers; neglected retarder oil/wiring
symptoms: Retarder drops out halfway down Dalton Pass / Kennon
diagnosticSteps: 1. Check retarder oil level/cooler (if hydraulic) or heavy 24V alternator/battery cables (if Telma eddy-current). 2. Scan retarder ECU for speed/temp codes.

domainName: Heavy-Duty 24V Bus, Trailer, Dump Truck & Equipment (Hino / Fuso / Volvo / Giga)
title: Heavy-Duty Fuel Delivery Pressure Low — Suction Air Leak
phContext: Commercial trucks with frame-mounted Racor + chassis pre-filter
symptoms: Engine surges and dies on long uphill pulls
diagnosticSteps: 1. Install clear temporary test hose at fuel pump inlet to spot air bubbles! 2. Tighten Racor bowl seal, check tank pickup tube crack, and replace hand primer.

domainName: Heavy-Duty 24V Bus, Trailer, Dump Truck & Equipment (Hino / Fuso / Volvo / Giga)
title: 24V Starter Solenoid Magnetic Switch Chattering — Thin Starter Wire
phContext: Long-chassis buses (rear-engine bus!) with long key-switch run
symptoms: Starter clicks weakly from rear engine bay, starts if jumped at rear
diagnosticSteps: 1. Rear-engine buses have 10+ meters of wire from key to starter! 2. Install/check heavy-duty 24V starter pilot relay right inside rear engine bay near starter. 3. Check 24V batteries.

domainName: Heavy-Duty 24V Bus, Trailer, Dump Truck & Equipment (Hino / Fuso / Volvo / Giga)
title: Heavy-Duty VGT Smart Actuator CAN Error (Cummins/Holset)
phContext: Foton/Sinotruk/Yutong/Kin g Long buses; overheated VGT actuator
symptoms: Limp mode, SPN 641, no turbo boost
diagnosticSteps: 1. Check 24V power, ground, and J1939 Private-CAN at 4-pin Holset VGT actuator plug. 2. Inspect turbo coolant lines to actuator (clogged cooling cooks actuator electronics!). 3. Calibrate new actuator.

domainName: Heavy-Duty 24V Bus, Trailer, Dump Truck & Equipment (Hino / Fuso / Volvo / Giga)
title: Slack Adjuster / S-Cam Seized — Uneven Braking on Heavy Axle
phContext: Dump trucks & trailers; neglected grease fittings on brake S-cam
symptoms: One wheel locks/smokes, other wheel barely brakes
diagnosticSteps: 1. Measure pushrod stroke at 90–100 psi brake application (must not exceed legal stroke limit!). 2. Grease S-cam bushings & automatic slack adjuster. 3. Replace broken return spring.

domainName: Heavy-Duty 24V Bus, Trailer, Dump Truck & Equipment (Hino / Fuso / Volvo / Giga)
title: 24V Dual-Alternator Bus — One Alternator Dead, Other Overloaded
phContext: Air-conditioned provincial buses with 2x 110A–150A 24V alternators
symptoms: Batteries drain in night traffic with A/C + headlights
diagnosticSteps: 1. Clamp-test output amperage of BOTH alternators independently at 1200 RPM with loads ON! 2. Inspect isolator/belts and regulator sense fuse on dead unit.

domainName: Heavy-Duty 24V Bus, Trailer, Dump Truck & Equipment (Hino / Fuso / Volvo / Giga)
title: Heavy-Duty Engine Oil Pressure Sensor Fault — Shorted to 5V
phContext: Isuzu 6HK1, Hino J08E, Cummins; leaking oil through sensor diaphragm
symptoms: Red Stop Engine buzzer despite normal mechanical oil pressure
diagnosticSteps: 1. Unplug oil pressure sensor and check for oil inside 3-pin plug! 2. Verify actual oil pressure with mechanical gauge immediately. 3. Replace leaking sensor.

domainName: Heavy-Duty 24V Bus, Trailer, Dump Truck & Equipment (Hino / Fuso / Volvo / Giga)
title: Automated Manual Transmission (AMT) Won't Shift — Low Air Pressure
phContext: Volvo I-Shift, Scania Opticruise, Fuso/Isuzu AMT
symptoms: Gear display flashes 'N', refuses to engage 1st/Reverse
diagnosticSteps: 1. Note: Heavy-duty AMTs use compressed air to shift gears and actuate clutch! 2. Verify air tank pressure >7.5–8.5 bar before diagnosing electronics. 3. Check AMT air supply solenoid.

domainName: Heavy-Duty 24V Bus, Trailer, Dump Truck & Equipment (Hino / Fuso / Volvo / Giga)
title: Dump Truck PTO (Power Take-Off) Won't Engage — Solenoid/Air Valve
phContext: 10-wheeler dump trucks; clogged air solenoid or clutch switch
symptoms: Dump bed won't lift, PTO indicator stays off
diagnosticSteps: 1. Check transmission Neutral & clutch pedal safety interlock switches. 2. Test 24V air solenoid valve feeding PTO shift cylinder. 3. Check hydraulic pump spline.

domainName: Heavy-Duty 24V Bus, Trailer, Dump Truck & Equipment (Hino / Fuso / Volvo / Giga)
title: Engine Overspeed Logged in Heavy Truck — Downhill Coasting
phContext: Drivers coasting downhill in too low a gear without exhaust brake
symptoms: Stored SPN 190 in ECM fleet report
diagnosticSteps: 1. Check freeze-frame RPM (e.g., >2,800 RPM on heavy diesel!). 2. Inspect valvetrain if severe. 3. Coach driver on proper exhaust-brake/retarder gear selection.

domainName: Heavy-Duty 24V Bus, Trailer, Dump Truck & Equipment (Hino / Fuso / Volvo / Giga)
title: Heavy Truck Cab Air Suspension Bags Torn — Rough Ride
phContext: Tractor-heads (Hino 700, Volvo, Fuso); rotted cab air springs
symptoms: Cab leans to one side, air compressor cycles nonstop
diagnosticSteps: 1. Spray soapy water on the 4 small cab-mount air springs and leveling valve linkage. 2. Replace cracked cab air bag.

domainName: Heavy-Duty 24V Bus, Trailer, Dump Truck & Equipment (Hino / Fuso / Volvo / Giga)
title: 24V Windshield Wiper Motor Stripped — Heavy Bus Blades
phContext: Buses/trucks with massive twin wiper arms
symptoms: One wiper stops moving in typhoon rain
diagnosticSteps: 1. Check wiper linkage crank arm nut on motor shaft (splines strip if arm freezes!). 2. Inspect 24V wiper relay & park switch.

domainName: Heavy-Duty 24V Bus, Trailer, Dump Truck & Equipment (Hino / Fuso / Volvo / Giga)
title: SCR AdBlue Tank Level / Temp Sensor Combi-Unit Fault
phContext: Euro-5 trucks/buses; internal level reed switches stuck
symptoms: AdBlue gauge reads 0% despite full tank, derate countdown
diagnosticSteps: 1. Read DEF Level % and Temp PIDs. 2. Inspect 4-pin/6-pin plug on top of DEF tank for corrosion. 3. Replace DEF sender header.

domainName: Heavy-Duty 24V Bus, Trailer, Dump Truck & Equipment (Hino / Fuso / Volvo / Giga)
title: Spring Brake Chamber Diaphragm Ruptured — Loud Air Leak Parked
phContext: Air-brake trucks/trailers; torn service or parking diaphragm
symptoms: Loud air hiss from rear axle when brakes pressed (or released)
diagnosticSteps: 1. Listen at each brake chamber with wheels chocked! 2. Never open spring-brake caging side without caging bolt (deadly coil spring inside!). 3. Replace sealed spring brake chamber.

domainName: Heavy-Duty 24V Bus, Trailer, Dump Truck & Equipment (Hino / Fuso / Volvo / Giga)
title: Heavy-Duty Cam/Crank Sensor Phase Error — Flywheel Housing
phContext: Isuzu 6HK1/6UZ1, Hino; loose flywheel sensor bracket
symptoms: Long cranking, SPN 636
diagnosticSteps: 1. Inspect CKP & CMP sensors for metal filings and bracket tightness. 2. Scope both waveforms simultaneously.

domainName: Heavy-Duty 24V Bus, Trailer, Dump Truck & Equipment (Hino / Fuso / Volvo / Giga)
title: Bus Roof A/C High-Pressure Trip — Dirty Condenser Coils
phContext: Provincial buses; rooftop A/C condensers packed with road dust
symptoms: Bus cabin hot in afternoon traffic, compressor cycles off
diagnosticSteps: 1. Climb roof safely and wash rooftop A/C condenser coils + check all 4–6 condenser fans! 2. Check sub-engine belt & refrigerant sight glass.

domainName: Heavy-Duty 24V Bus, Trailer, Dump Truck & Equipment (Hino / Fuso / Volvo / Giga)
title: 24V Battery Master Solenoid / Kill Switch Heating Up
phContext: Trucks with worn internal contacts on main battery isolator
symptoms: Slow crank, switch handle hot to touch
diagnosticSteps: 1. Measure voltage drop across battery disconnect switch during crank (<0.2V). 2. Replace high-resistance master switch.

domainName: Heavy-Duty 24V Bus, Trailer, Dump Truck & Equipment (Hino / Fuso / Volvo / Giga)
title: SCR Inducement Countdown Active — Forced 20 km/h Derate
phContext: Euro-5/6 trucks ignored after AdBlue warning
symptoms: Truck locked to 20 km/h crawl mode
diagnosticSteps: 1. Fix underlying SCR/NOx/DEF pump fault FIRST! 2. Perform OEM SCR Inducement Reset / Test Drive via diagnostic tool to clear 20 km/h derate.

domainName: Heavy-Duty 24V Bus, Trailer, Dump Truck & Equipment (Hino / Fuso / Volvo / Giga)
