title: Heavy Truck Hub Seal Oil Leak — Overfilled / Plugged Axle Vent
phContext: 10-wheelers; oil-bath wheel hub leaking onto brake shoes
symptoms: Oil streak down inside of rear dual tires
diagnosticSteps: 1. Clean rear axle housing breather vent! 2. Inspect hub bearing preload & spindle seal surface. 3. Replace hub seal & oil-soaked brake linings.

domainName: Heavy-Duty 24V Bus, Trailer, Dump Truck & Equipment (Hino / Fuso / Volvo / Giga)
title: 24V Horn / Air-Horn Solenoid Stuck ON — Frozen Air Valve
phContext: Trucks with 24V electric air-horn solenoid valve
symptoms: Air horn blasts nonstop until air tank empties!
diagnosticSteps: 1. Unplug 24V wire at air-horn solenoid (if horn keeps blowing, valve is mechanically jammed by rust/sludge!). 2. Clean/replace air solenoid.

domainName: Heavy-Duty 24V Bus, Trailer, Dump Truck & Equipment (Hino / Fuso / Volvo / Giga)
title: Heavy Truck Ambient Air Temp Sensor Fault — Derate / DPF
phContext: Hino/Isuzu/Volvo; missing bumper ambient sensor
symptoms: False -40°C outside temp, DPF/SCR logic inhibited
diagnosticSteps: 1. Inspect 2-pin ambient sensor behind front bumper step. 2. Replace sensor so thermal models run accurately.

domainName: Heavy-Duty 24V Bus, Trailer, Dump Truck & Equipment (Hino / Fuso / Volvo / Giga)
title: Leaf Spring U-Bolt Loose — Axle Walk & Broken Center Pin
phContext: Heavy dump trucks on quarry/construction sites
symptoms: Truck dog-tracks sideways, loud bang on braking
diagnosticSteps: 1. Check U-bolt torque with 3/4-inch torque wrench after every loaded break-in! 2. Replace sheared center bolt.

domainName: Heavy-Duty 24V Bus, Trailer, Dump Truck & Equipment (Hino / Fuso / Volvo / Giga)
title: Kingpin Play / Shaking Front Axle — Neglected Grease Fittings
phContext: Solid-axle commercial trucks (Elf, Forward, Hino 300/500)
symptoms: Front tire cupping, steering shimmy
diagnosticSteps: 1. Jack front axle under I-beam and pry tire up/down while watching kingpin gap! 2. Grease kingpins every 5,000 km; rebush if play >spec.

domainName: Heavy-Duty 24V Bus, Trailer, Dump Truck & Equipment (Hino / Fuso / Volvo / Giga)
title: 24V ECM Battery Voltage Low — Loose Starter Terminal Bus
phContext: Heavy trucks where ECM B+ taps off starter solenoid stud
symptoms: ECM resets during crank, SPN 168
diagnosticSteps: 1. Inspect clean-power ECM B+ tap wire & inline fuse at starter/battery box for green corrosion. 2. Clean & seal.

domainName: Heavy-Duty 24V Bus, Trailer, Dump Truck & Equipment (Hino / Fuso / Volvo / Giga)
title: Trailer EBS / ABS Modulator Valve Exhaust Leak
phContext: Modern semi-trailers; dirty air exhausting from modulator
symptoms: Air leaks continuously from trailer axle modulator
diagnosticSteps: 1. Inspect trailer air dryer on tractor (oil/water ruins trailer ABS valves!). 2. Clean/replace trailer modulator valve.

domainName: Heavy-Duty 24V Bus, Trailer, Dump Truck & Equipment (Hino / Fuso / Volvo / Giga)
title: 24V Glow / Intake Grid Heater Relay Welded — Kills Batteries
phContext: Cummins / Hino / Isuzu with 24V intake grid heater (100A+)
symptoms: Batteries dead every morning, grid heater scorching hot
diagnosticSteps: 1. Test intake air heater relay output with key off (must be 0V!). 2. Replace welded 24V grid heater solenoid.

domainName: Heavy-Duty 24V Bus, Trailer, Dump Truck & Equipment (Hino / Fuso / Volvo / Giga)
title: Heavy-Duty DPF Soot Load Critical — Ash-Full Filter
phContext: High-mileage Euro-4/5 fleet trucks >250,000 km
symptoms: Forced regen aborts, backpressure high
diagnosticSteps: 1. Remove DPF canister for professional pneumatic/thermal ash cleaning! 2. Reset DPF ash counter after cleaning.

domainName: Heavy-Duty 24V Bus, Trailer, Dump Truck & Equipment (Hino / Fuso / Volvo / Giga)
title: Bus Pneumatic Passenger Door Slamming Hard — Flow Regulator
phContext: City/provincial buses; unadjusted air door speed screw
symptoms: Door slams violently on passengers
diagnosticSteps: 1. Adjust brass exhaust flow-control muffler screws on door air cylinder! 2. Check door safety edge switch.

domainName: Heavy-Duty 24V Bus, Trailer, Dump Truck & Equipment (Hino / Fuso / Volvo / Giga)
title: Driveshaft Carrier Bearing / Slip Yoke Thump on Shifting
phContext: Long trucks/buses; dry slip-yoke splines
symptoms: Clunk felt through floor on every gear change
diagnosticSteps: 1. Pump chassis grease into driveshaft slip-yoke & all U-joint zerks until fresh grease purges. 2. Check center bearing rubber.

domainName: Heavy-Duty 24V Bus, Trailer, Dump Truck & Equipment (Hino / Fuso / Volvo / Giga)
title: Heavy-Duty Coolant Temp High — Viscous Fan Hub Bimetal Clogged
phContext: Trucks operating in dusty cement/quarry sites
symptoms: Overheats uphill, fan never locks up
diagnosticSteps: 1. Clean thick mud/oil off front spiral bimetal coil on viscous fan clutch! (Caked dirt insulates bimetal so clutch never senses radiator heat!). 2. Replace clutch if silicone leaked.

domainName: Heavy-Duty 24V Bus, Trailer, Dump Truck & Equipment (Hino / Fuso / Volvo / Giga)
title: 24V Alternator Sense Wire Broken — Overcharging 30V+
phContext: Commercial trucks; broken S-wire near alternator harness
symptoms: Batteries boiling, bulbs blowing
diagnosticSteps: 1. Verify 24V at alternator S (Sense) pin key-off/on. 2. Repair broken sense wire.

domainName: Heavy-Duty 24V Bus, Trailer, Dump Truck & Equipment (Hino / Fuso / Volvo / Giga)
title: Fuel-Water Separator Heater Shorted (Cold-Climate Spec Truck)
phContext: Imported/surplus JDM trucks with 24V fuel filter heater
symptoms: Blows 30A fuse in rainy weather
diagnosticSteps: 1. Unplug 24V fuel heater element at bottom/top of filter head (not needed in tropical PH climate if shorted!). 2. Replace fuse.

domainName: Heavy-Duty 24V Bus, Trailer, Dump Truck & Equipment (Hino / Fuso / Volvo / Giga)
title: Heavy-Duty ECM Internal Error — Arc Welding Without Unplugging
phContext: Trucks after dump-bed / chassis welding
symptoms: No-start, dead ECM
diagnosticSteps: 1. Always disconnect BOTH batteries AND ECM connectors before welding! 2. Bench-test ECM 5V rails and CAN.

domainName: Heavy-Duty 24V Bus, Trailer, Dump Truck & Equipment (Hino / Fuso / Volvo / Giga)
title: Air Brake Compressor Pumping Oil Into Air Tanks
phContext: High-mileage heavy diesels; worn compressor piston rings
symptoms: Thick black oil sludge spraying out of air tank drain valves!
diagnosticSteps: 1. Drain air tanks and check for heavy engine oil (destroys rubber brake valves & air dryer!). 2. Overhaul/replace air compressor & air dryer cartridge.

domainName: Aftermarket Accessory Integration, Security, GPS & Audio Interference Faults
title: Aftermarket Push-Start Kit Draining Battery & Failing to Crank
phContext: Older key-start cars converted to aftermarket push-button start
symptoms: Dead battery in 3 days, intermittent no-crank
diagnosticSteps: 1. Measure parasitic draw of aftermarket PKE (Passive Keyless Entry) LF antennas (often 80–150 mA!). 2. Inspect cheap 30A relay box & T-tapped ignition wires. 3. Solder connections.

domainName: Aftermarket Accessory Integration, Security, GPS & Audio Interference Faults
title: GPS Tracker Cut-Off Relay Stranding Vehicle Mid-Drive!
phContext: Financing/fleet cars with remote engine-kill GPS relay on fuel pump
symptoms: Car dies suddenly on expressway despite normal ECU!
diagnosticSteps: 1. Trace fuel pump or ignition wire under driver dash/kick panel for hidden black GPS box with inline 30A relay! 2. Bypass corroded/faulty kill relay to restore power.

domainName: Aftermarket Accessory Integration, Security, GPS & Audio Interference Faults
title: Android Head Unit CANbus Decoder Box Draining Battery Overnight
phContext: Xpander, City, Ranger, Geely with aftermarket Android stereo
symptoms: Battery dead every morning after stereo upgrade
diagnosticSteps: 1. Measure parasitic draw with Android unit plugged vs. unplugged (many cheap Raise/SimpleSoft CAN boxes keep Body CAN awake!). 2. Wire ACC cleanly to switched fuse.

domainName: Aftermarket Accessory Integration, Security, GPS & Audio Interference Faults
title: Aftermarket HID / High-Power LED Ballast Jamming Radio & Sensors
phContext: Older/modern cars with unshielded DC-DC LED/HID ballasts
symptoms: FM radio turns to pure static when headlights turn on, ABS/TPMS glitches!
diagnosticSteps: 1. Turn headlights OFF while listening to FM/watching TPMS/CAN errors! 2. Relocate noisy ballast away from ECM/ABS/radio antenna and add ferrite chokes.

domainName: Aftermarket Accessory Integration, Security, GPS & Audio Interference Faults
title: Aftermarket Alarm Shock Sensor Too Sensitive — False Alarms at Rain
phContext: Cars parked beside busy PH streets; alarm goes off when jeepneys/thunder pass
symptoms: Siren blasts every time loud exhaust or heavy rain hits
diagnosticSteps: 1. Locate small shock-sensor box zip-tied to steering column and turn sensitivity dial counter-clockwise! 2. Mount sensor securely to metal bracket (not loose zip-tie).

domainName: Aftermarket Accessory Integration, Security, GPS & Audio Interference Faults
title: Auto-Folding Mirror Kit Reversed — Mirrors Fold When Driving!
phContext: Aftermarket plug-and-play mirror folder module
symptoms: Mirrors fold inward when unlocking/starting car!
diagnosticSteps: 1. Check if mirror switch inside car was left in manual FOLD position, or if lock/unlock trigger wires were swapped! 2. Sync switch & module.

domainName: Aftermarket Accessory Integration, Security, GPS & Audio Interference Faults
title: OBD-II Auto-Lock / Window-Closer Dongle Corrupting CAN Bus
phContext: Cheap P300 OBD plug-in auto-door-lockers left in DLC port
symptoms: Random ABS/EPS warning lights, scan tool can't talk
diagnosticSteps: 1. Unplug aftermarket OBD-II dongle from diagnostic port immediately! 2. Clear all U-codes and test drive.

domainName: Aftermarket Accessory Integration, Security, GPS & Audio Interference Faults
title: Aftermarket Horn Tapped Into Factory Horn Wire — Blows 10A Fuse
phContext: Dual-tone Bosch Europa / PIAA horns without relay
symptoms: Horn blows 10A HORN/STOP fuse, locks shifter in Park!
diagnosticSteps: 1. Install dedicated 30A relay + 20A fuse directly from battery (+), using factory horn wire only to trigger relay pin 85/86!

domainName: Aftermarket Accessory Integration, Security, GPS & Audio Interference Faults
title: Dashcam Hardwire Kit Set to 11.6V — Car Fails to Crank!
phContext: Parking-mode dashcam draining aging battery below cranking threshold
symptoms: Dashcam records all night, car clicks dead in morning
diagnosticSteps: 1. Set hardwire kit low-voltage cutoff switch to 12.2V or 12.4V (never 11.6V in PH heat!). 2. Or switch dashcam to ACC-only.

domainName: Aftermarket Accessory Integration, Security, GPS & Audio Interference Faults
title: Subwoofer Amplifier 'Remote' Wire Tapped to Constant 12V
phContext: Aftermarket audio install; amp blue REM wire wired to B+
symptoms: Amplifier stays powered ON 24/7, kills battery overnight
diagnosticSteps: 1. Check amplifier blue REM terminal with key OFF (must be 0V!). 2. Move REM wire to head-unit remote-turn-on or switched ACC fuse.

domainName: Aftermarket Accessory Integration, Security, GPS & Audio Interference Faults
title: Aftermarket Fog Lights Wired to Parking Light Wire — Melts Switch
phContext: Budget fog light install without relay
symptoms: Tail lights & dash lights go dead, melted stalk switch
diagnosticSteps: 1. Wire fog lights with dedicated 30A relay directly from battery (+), triggering relay coil only from park-light/switch!

domainName: Aftermarket Accessory Integration, Security, GPS & Audio Interference Faults
title: Aftermarket Throttle Controller ('Pedal Box') Triggering P2135/P2122
phContext: Pickups/SUVs (Hilux, Fortuner, Montero, Ranger) with plug-in pedal booster
symptoms: Sudden limp mode in traffic, no gas pedal response!
diagnosticSteps: 1. Unplug aftermarket throttle controller module between APP pedal and factory harness, plug factory harness straight in! 2. Clear codes & test drive.

domainName: Aftermarket Accessory Integration, Security, GPS & Audio Interference Faults
title: Plug-In OBD 'Chip Tuning / NitroOBD2' Scams Causing Bus Errors
phContext: Drivers using cheap P200 'fuel saver / power chip' OBD plugs
symptoms: MIL or U-codes, parasitic drain
diagnosticSteps: 1. Remove fake OBD tuning dongle (contains only blinking LEDs or noisy resistor!). 2. Clear codes.

domainName: Aftermarket Accessory Integration, Security, GPS & Audio Interference Faults
title: Aftermarket Reverse Camera Ground Loop — Rolling Lines on Screen
phContext: Android head unit + camera powered off noisy reverse LED/PWM wire
symptoms: Wavy horizontal lines or 'No Signal' with engine running
diagnosticSteps: 1. Some modern cars use PWM on reverse bulbs! Power camera from clean ACC/reverse relay instead, and ground camera near head unit.

domainName: Aftermarket Accessory Integration, Security, GPS & Audio Interference Faults
title: Aftermarket DRL / Sequential Turn Signal Draining BCM Output
phContext: Headlights/taillights modified with extra LED strips tapped to BCM
symptoms: BCM shuts down left/right signal or park light
diagnosticSteps: 1. Measure total current draw on BCM lighting pin (smart-FETs trip on >1–2A excess!). 2. Isolate aftermarket LEDs via relays.

domainName: Aftermarket Accessory Integration, Security, GPS & Audio Interference Faults
title: Power Inverter / Camping Fridge Plugged Into 12V Socket — Melted Plug
phContext: 150W+ inverter or air compressor plugged into dash 12V socket
symptoms: 12V socket plastic melted, ACC fuse blown
diagnosticSteps: 1. Never run >120W (10A) through dashboard cigarette sockets! 2. Wire high-draw inverters/compressors directly to battery with alligator clamps or Anderson plug.

domainName: Aftermarket Accessory Integration, Security, GPS & Audio Interference Faults
title: Aftermarket Central Lock Actuator Installed Wrong — Locks Driver Out
phContext: Converted manual-lock base-model cars (Vios J, Hilux J, L300)
symptoms: Doors lock themselves with keys inside, or rod binds latch
diagnosticSteps: 1. Check actuator rod alignment & grease latch. 2. Ensure aftermarket alarm passive-rearm/auto-lock isn't wired without door pin sense!

domainName: Aftermarket Accessory Integration, Security, GPS & Audio Interference Faults
title: Aftermarket Blind-Spot / Rear Radar Drilling Bumper — Hits Factory Wire
phContext: DIY rear sensor install on bumper
symptoms: Factory reverse camera/sonar dead after aftermarket install
diagnosticSteps: 1. Remove rear bumper and inspect factory harness behind drill holes for nicked/cut wires! 2. Repair harness.

domainName: Aftermarket Accessory Integration, Security, GPS & Audio Interference Faults
title: RFID Toll Tag (Autosweep / Easydrive) Interfering With Headlight/Rain
phContext: RFID sticker pasted directly over windshield dash solar/rain sensor
symptoms: Auto headlights stay on at noon
diagnosticSteps: 1. Relocate RFID sticker away from center camera/rain sensor pod & dashboard light dome!

domainName: Aftermarket Accessory Integration, Security, GPS & Audio Interference Faults
title: Aftermarket Remote-Start Bypass Module Unsynced — Cranks & Dies
phContext: Cars with aftermarket remote start failing after battery change
symptoms: Remote start cranks 3x then aborts, key starts fine
diagnosticSteps: 1. Re-learn transponder bypass module (Fortin/iDataLink/ring loop) to OEM key. 2. Check hood safety pin switch.

domainName: Aftermarket Accessory Integration, Security, GPS & Audio Interference Faults
title: Door Sill Illuminated LED Scuff Plates Shorting — Wet Shoes
phContext: Aftermarket LED door sills wired to dome light wire
symptoms: Dome fuse blows, battery drains when wet
diagnosticSteps: 1. Unplug illuminated scuff plate wires at kick panel (water from wet shoes shorts thin ribbon!). 2. Replace dome fuse.

domainName: Aftermarket Accessory Integration, Security, GPS & Audio Interference Faults
title: Aftermarket Ambient Light Strips Causing Door Module LIN Noise
phContext: Door panel RGB LED strips tapped into door switch LIN/power
symptoms: Window auto-up or mirror fold stops working
diagnosticSteps: 1. Disconnect ambient LED controller from door LIN/data wire; power only from clean switched 12V + ground.

domainName: Aftermarket Accessory Integration, Security, GPS & Audio Interference Faults
title: Aftermarket TPMS External Valve-Cap Sensors Snapped/Leaking
phContext: Cheap screw-on external TPMS caps seizing onto brass valve stems
symptoms: Slow tire leak, cap won't unscrew without twisting rubber stem!
diagnosticSteps: 1. Apply anti-seize or switch to internal valve-stem TPMS sensors (external brass/aluminum caps corrode and fuse to valve threads in PH rain!).

domainName: Aftermarket Accessory Integration, Security, GPS & Audio Interference Faults
title: Dual-Tone Siren / PA Megaphone Shorting Under Hood
phContext: Escort/utility vehicles with grille-mounted PA horn
symptoms: Blows main accessory fuse in rain
diagnosticSteps: 1. Unplug waterlogged speaker driver behind grille and check speaker impedance (must be 8/11 ohms, not 0 Ω short!).

domainName: Aftermarket Accessory Integration, Security, GPS & Audio Interference Faults
title: Aftermarket Speedometer / HUD Plugged Into K-Line Causing Scan Fail
phContext: Scan tool won't connect while aftermarket OBD gauge is Y-split
symptoms: Scan tool says 'No Link'
diagnosticSteps: 1. Unplug Y-splitter and aftermarket OBD gauge completely before connecting diagnostic scanner!

domainName: Aftermarket Accessory Integration, Security, GPS & Audio Interference Faults
title: Under-Seat Active Subwoofer Melting Carpet / Tripping Thermal
phContext: Slim under-seat subs in 40°C parked cars + blocked rear A/C duct
symptoms: Bass cuts out after 20 min
diagnosticSteps: 1. Check amplifier gain setting (clipped gain overheats amp!) and verify ground bolt is on bare chassis metal. 2. Keep under-seat vents clear.

domainName: Aftermarket Accessory Integration, Security, GPS & Audio Interference Faults
title: Aftermarket Steering Wheel Controls Adapter (SWC) Drifting
phContext: Resistive SWC interface on Android head unit
symptoms: Volume Up mutes audio when cabin gets hot
diagnosticSteps: 1. Re-program SWC key mapping inside Android settings when cabin is at normal temp; check clock spring ground.

domainName: Aftermarket Accessory Integration, Security, GPS & Audio Interference Faults
title: Aftermarket Electric Fan Conversion on 4x4 — Relay Melted
phContext: Older pickups converted from clutch fan to twin electric fans
symptoms: Overheats in traffic, melted 30A relay
diagnosticSteps: 1. Twin electric fans draw 30–45A startup surge! Use dual 40A–60A relays (or OEM PWM controller) + 10 AWG wire + proper temp switch.

domainName: Aftermarket Accessory Integration, Security, GPS & Audio Interference Faults
title: Aftermarket 'Voltage Stabilizer' Capacitor Pack Shorting Battery
phContext: Cheap engine-bay 'voltage stabilizer' boxes with swollen caps
symptoms: Battery drains overnight, burning smell under hood
diagnosticSteps: 1. Unbolt cheap aftermarket voltage stabilizer box from battery terminals! (Internal electrolytic caps dry out and short in underhood heat!).

domainName: Aftermarket Accessory Integration, Security, GPS & Audio Interference Faults
title: Aftermarket Grounding Kit ('5-Point Purple Wires') Blocking Sensor
phContext: Thick aftermarket ground wires bolted onto painted valve cover/bracket
symptoms: No actual improvement or loose bolt causes oil/vacuum leak
diagnosticSteps: 1. Verify OEM ground straps are clean and torqued rather than bolting decorative wires onto valve cover bolts.

domainName: Aftermarket Accessory Integration, Security, GPS & Audio Interference Faults
title: Dashcam Rear Camera Wire Jamming Side Curtain Airbag!
phContext: Rear dashcam wire tucked loosely across A-pillar/B-pillar curtain bag
symptoms: Safety hazard + SRS rattle
diagnosticSteps: 1. ALWAYS route dashcam rear cable BEHIND the curtain airbag or along lower door sill floor channel — never across airbag deployment path!

domainName: Aftermarket Accessory Integration, Security, GPS & Audio Interference Faults
title: Aftermarket Tailgate LED Bar Causing False 'Trailer Connected' Mode
phContext: Modern pickups (Ranger, Hilux) with trailer-detection BCM
symptoms: Rear parking sensors disabled automatically, BLIS/BSM turns off!
diagnosticSteps: 1. BCM detects extra current on tail/brake wire and thinks a trailer is hooked up! 2. Isolate LED tailgate bar with a powered 3-wire-to-2-wire converter module.

domainName: Aftermarket Accessory Integration, Security, GPS & Audio Interference Faults
title: Aftermarket Ceramic Coating / Wax on Matte Radar Cover
phContext: Detailer applying metallic/ceramic coat thickly on front radar emblem
symptoms: Front radar blind/blocked alerts
diagnosticSteps: 1. Clean front radar emblem with mild isopropyl alcohol (no metallic waxes!).

domainName: Aftermarket Accessory Integration, Security, GPS & Audio Interference Faults
title: Aftermarket Keyless Entry Remote Interference With Garage/Gate
phContext: 433 MHz aftermarket alarm clashing with subdivision gate RF
symptoms: Key fob stops working near condo/mall RF towers
diagnosticSteps: 1. Test fob away from high-RF areas (BGC/Makati/cell towers). 2. Check fob battery.

domainName: Aftermarket Accessory Integration, Security, GPS & Audio Interference Faults
title: Aftermarket Fuel Pressure Regulator (FPR) Diaphragm Ruptured
phContext: Modified cars with cheap knockoff adjustable FPR
symptoms: Raw fuel pouring into intake vacuum hose, hydrolock/fire risk!
diagnosticSteps: 1. Pull vacuum hose off adjustable FPR: any fuel present = ruptured diaphragm! 2. Restore OEM FPR.

domainName: Aftermarket Accessory Integration, Security, GPS & Audio Interference Faults
title: Aftermarket Oil Catch Can Frozen/Clogged With Mayonnaise Sludge
phContext: Short-trip cars with unemptied catch can; winter/rain emulsion
symptoms: Excessive crankcase pressure blowing dipstick/seals out!
diagnosticSteps: 1. Empty catch can every 2,000 km and check internal mesh filter for blockage! 2. Ensure hoses don't kink.

domainName: Aftermarket Accessory Integration, Security, GPS & Audio Interference Faults
title: Aftermarket Headlight Projector Retrofit — Shutter Solenoid Stuck
phContext: Bi-LED / HID projectors; stuck high-beam solenoid flap
symptoms: High beam stuck ON permanently on one side, blinding drivers
diagnosticSteps: 1. Test 12V solenoid wire at projector rear; inspect mechanical flap for heat warp. 2. Replace projector solenoid.

domainName: Aftermarket Accessory Integration, Security, GPS & Audio Interference Faults
title: Aftermarket 'Eco' OBD2 Plug Causing Intermittent Limp Mode
phContext: Fleet/private cars with unknown OBD dongle
symptoms: Sudden limp mode, U0073
diagnosticSteps: 1. Remove dongle, clear CAN codes, test drive.

domainName: Aftermarket Accessory Integration, Security, GPS & Audio Interference Faults
title: Aftermarket Wireless CarPlay Dongle Rebooting Head Unit
phContext: Carlinkit / Ottocast USB dongles drawing >900 mA from weak USB port
symptoms: Factory radio freezes and reboots every 15 minutes
diagnosticSteps: 1. Unplug wireless dongle and test wired USB CarPlay directly! 2. Update dongle firmware or use Y-power splitter.

domainName: Aftermarket Accessory Integration, Security, GPS & Audio Interference Faults
title: Aftermarket Air Horn Compressor Relay Welded — Drains Tank/Batt
phContext: Motorized air horn compressor under hood
symptoms: Compressor runs nonstop until it melts
diagnosticSteps: 1. Disconnect battery, replace welded relay and compressor.

domainName: Pre-Purchase Used Car Inspection & Hidden Defect Scenarios (PH Market)
title: Tampered Odometer ('Pinitik') Detection via ECU/TCM Hours & Mileage
phContext: Used Vios, Fortuner, Montero, Hilux showing '35,000 km' on 8-year-old car
symptoms: Cluster says 35,000 km, yet brake pedal rubber & driver seat bolster are worn flat
diagnosticSteps: 1. Scan Engine ECM, TCM, ABS, and SRS modules for stored 'Distance Since DTC Clear', 'Total Operating Hours', or 'Odometer Backup' PIDs! 2. Note: 35,000 km vs. 4,500 engine hours = tampered!

domainName: Pre-Purchase Used Car Inspection & Hidden Defect Scenarios (PH Market)
title: Check Engine / SRS Airbag Light Wired to Oil Pressure or Battery Light!
phContext: Shady used-car sellers masking dead MIL or deployed airbags!
symptoms: MIL & SRS lights turn ON at KOEO, then turn OFF cleanly right as engine starts!
diagnosticSteps: 1. NEVER trust the dash bulb check alone! 2. Plug in OBD-II scanner: check 'MIL Status' PID, active/pending DTCs, and verify ALL Readiness Monitors aren't freshly cleared! 3. Physically inspect SRS airbags.

domainName: Pre-Purchase Used Car Inspection & Hidden Defect Scenarios (PH Market)
title: Recently Cleared Codes ('Incomplete Monitors') Before Buyer Arrives
phContext: Seller cleared P0420/P0087/P0700 right before test drive!
symptoms: Zero DTCs on scan, yet Readiness Monitors all show 'INC / Not Ready'
diagnosticSteps: 1. Check 'Distance Traveled Since Codes Cleared' (Mode $01 PID $31) & 'Warm-Ups Since Clear'! 2. If <20 km and 5 monitors Incomplete, seller JUST wiped codes! Test drive 30 min.

domainName: Pre-Purchase Used Car Inspection & Hidden Defect Scenarios (PH Market)
title: Hidden Flood Damage — Silt Under Seat Rails & Dashboard Frame
phContext: Typhoon-flooded cars detailed with fresh armor-all & new floor mats
symptoms: Clean carpet, yet rusty seat-bolt brackets & musty 'kulob' smell with A/C off
diagnosticSteps: 1. Shine flashlight under front seats at bare steel seat tracks, steering column shaft, and behind OBD-II port bracket for rust/dried river silt! 2. Pull door weatherstrip slightly to check sill cavity.

domainName: Pre-Purchase Used Car Inspection & Hidden Defect Scenarios (PH Market)
title: Airbag Replaced With 2.2-Ohm Resistor Fraud!
phContext: Accident-repaired used cars with missing passenger/driver airbag
symptoms: SRS light turns off normally at startup, zero SRS DTCs!
diagnosticSteps: 1. Check SRS live data & physically verify airbag module presence (tap horn pad gently or inspect passenger dash seam/pretensioner retractor date tags!). 2. Check seatbelts lock on tug.

domainName: Pre-Purchase Used Car Inspection & Hidden Defect Scenarios (PH Market)
title: Thick 'Honey / Smoke-Stop' Oil Additive Hiding Worn Rings/Knock
phContext: Smoking high-mileage engines doped with thick 20W-50 + STP treatment
symptoms: Runs quiet at hot afternoon viewing, knocks/smokes next cold morning!
diagnosticSteps: 1. Always inspect a used car COLD (feel exhaust manifold/valve cover before starting!). 2. Pull oil filler cap to check for super-thick honey-like sludge or excessive blow-by chuffing.

domainName: Pre-Purchase Used Car Inspection & Hidden Defect Scenarios (PH Market)
title: Stop-Leak Copper/Sodium Silicate Powder Floating in Radiator
phContext: Used cars with cracked head gasket or leaking radiator masked for sale
symptoms: Sparkling metallic flakes in coolant reservoir, rusty brown cap
diagnosticSteps: 1. Open radiator cap COLD and shine flashlight inside neck: look for metallic glitter or chalky paste! 2. Run combustion leak block test on coolant.

domainName: Pre-Purchase Used Car Inspection & Hidden Defect Scenarios (PH Market)
title: Hollowed-Out Catalytic Converter / DPF + ECU DTC Delete
phContext: Diesel pickups/SUVs or gasoline taxis with cat/DPF chopped out
symptoms: No MIL on dash, strong raw exhaust smell, failed emission test
diagnosticSteps: 1. Inspect exhaust pipes/DPF welds for fresh sloppy reweld marks on top side! 2. Check Readiness Monitors (O2/Cat/DPF showing 'Unsupported' or 'Not Ready' permanently = tuned out!).

domainName: Pre-Purchase Used Car Inspection & Hidden Defect Scenarios (PH Market)
title: Flooded Headlight / Taillight Water Line & Moisture Fog
phContext: Submerged used cars cleaned only on exterior
symptoms: Faint dried mud line inside fog lights or trunk taillight seams
diagnosticSteps: 1. Inspect inside of trunk spare-tire well, jack storage pocket, and headlight bottom seams for dried silt lines.

domainName: Pre-Purchase Used Car Inspection & Hidden Defect Scenarios (PH Market)
title: Transmission Slipping Masked by Thick ATF Additive / Cold Test
phContext: Used AT/CVT cars test-driven only 500 meters around block
symptoms: Shifts fine for 5 min, flares/slips once ATF reaches 85°C!
diagnosticSteps: 1. Always test drive used AT/CVT cars for 20+ minutes in stop-and-go + incline until ATF reaches 80–90°C! 2. Check ATF dipstick/drop for burnt smell & metal sparkle.

domainName: Pre-Purchase Used Car Inspection & Hidden Defect Scenarios (PH Market)
title: Missing Thermostat in Used Car — Hiding Overheating Head Gasket!
phContext: Seller removed thermostat so car takes 30 min to overheat
symptoms: Temp gauge stays below 1/4, upper hose warm immediately at cold start
diagnosticSteps: 1. Monitor ECT PID during 15-min idle + 15-min drive: if ECT hovers at 60– 68°C, thermostat was removed! 2. Pressurize cooling system and test for combustion gas.

domainName: Pre-Purchase Used Car Inspection & Hidden Defect Scenarios (PH Market)
title: Repainted / Bondo-Filled Roof & Pillars — Rollover or Severe Crash
phContext: Used cars with shiny new paint hiding structural frame damage
symptoms: Doors close awkwardly, wind noise, uneven panel gaps
diagnosticSteps: 1. Use digital paint-thickness gauge across roof, A/B/C pillars, and quarter panels (factory ~90–140 µm; >300– 1000 µm = heavy body filler!). 2. Pull door seals to check spot-welds.

domainName: Pre-Purchase Used Car Inspection & Hidden Defect Scenarios (PH Market)
title: Swapped / Unmatched VIN Across Chassis, Firewall & ECM
phContext: Stolen/chop-chop ('talon') or cloned vehicles ('kambal plaka')
symptoms: VIN on windshield doesn't match LTO OR/CR or ECM electronic VIN!
diagnosticSteps: 1. Read electronic VIN stored inside Engine ECM, TCM, and BCM via OBD-II scanner! 2. Compare character-for-character against stamped firewall/frame VIN and LTO OR/CR.

domainName: Pre-Purchase Used Car Inspection & Hidden Defect Scenarios (PH Market)
title: Taxi / Grab / Fleet Repaint Disguised as 'Private Lady-Owned'
phContext: White/yellow Vios, Mirage, Innova repainted silver/red
symptoms: High wear on rear door hinges, trunk, and passenger seat, 30k on dash
diagnosticSteps: 1. Peel back door weatherstrip or inspect inside trunk/spare-tire well/under hood hinges for original white/yellow taxi paint! 2. Check rear-seat grab handles and roof for antenna/top-light holes.

domainName: Pre-Purchase Used Car Inspection & Hidden Defect Scenarios (PH Market)
title: A/C Compressor Noise Masked by Overcharged/Thick Oil
phContext: Cars with noisy A/C dying 1 week after purchase
symptoms: A/C cold at viewing, compressor seizes next week
diagnosticSteps: 1. Listen carefully with hood open while cycling A/C ON/OFF 5 times; check if cooling fans run properly and vent temp drops below 8–10°C at idle.

domainName: Pre-Purchase Used Car Inspection & Hidden Defect Scenarios (PH Market)
title: ABS / VSC Bulb Taped Over Inside Cluster!
phContext: Cluster disassembled and black electrical tape put behind ABS/MIL LED
symptoms: ABS/MIL never lights up at all even during 2-second Key-ON bulb check!
diagnosticSteps: 1. Turn key to ON (engine OFF) and verify EVERY warning icon (Check Engine, ABS, Airbag, Oil, Battery) illuminates for bulb check! 2. Missing light = taped/unsoldered LED!

domainName: Pre-Purchase Used Car Inspection & Hidden Defect Scenarios (PH Market)
title: 4x4 Transfer Case Stuck in 2H — Seller Never Tested 4H/4L
phContext: Used Hilux, Fortuner, Montero, Ranger 4x4
symptoms: 4WD light blinks or refuses to engage on test drive
diagnosticSteps: 1. On loose gravel/straight dirt, ALWAYS shift into 4H and 4L (Neutral) during pre-purchase inspection to verify actuators & front axle actually pull!

domainName: Pre-Purchase Used Car Inspection & Hidden Defect Scenarios (PH Market)
title: EV / Hybrid Used Car With Degraded Pack (P0A80 Cleared)
phContext: Used Prius, Corolla Cross HEV, BYD, Nissan Kicks
symptoms: Battery bars look full, drops to 1 bar in 2 min driving
diagnosticSteps: 1. Scan HV Battery Block Voltages & Internal Resistance PIDs under gentle acceleration/regen! 2. Check delta >0.3V and State of Health (SOH %).

domainName: Pre-Purchase Used Car Inspection & Hidden Defect Scenarios (PH Market)
title: Brittle / Swollen Brake Hoses & Rusted Underbody (Coastal Car)
phContext: Cars from coastal towns or parked on wet grass
symptoms: Severe flaking rust on frame rails, control arms, and brake lines
diagnosticSteps: 1. Put used car on lift or crawl underneath with flashlight to inspect frame rails, rear axle, and brake line flares for deep flaky rust (not just light surface dust).

domainName: Pre-Purchase Used Car Inspection & Hidden Defect Scenarios (PH Market)
title: Mismatched Tire Dates & Dry-Rot Cracks — 'Makapal Pa!'
phContext: Used car with deep tread yet 8-year-old hardened rubber!
symptoms: Tire blows out on expressway despite 80% tread left
diagnosticSteps: 1. Read 4-digit DOT date code on every tire sidewall (e.g., '3821' = Week 38 of 2021; >5–6 years old = replace regardless of tread!). 2. Check inner sidewalls for bulges.

domainName: Pre-Purchase Used Car Inspection & Hidden Defect Scenarios (PH Market)
title: Used Diesel Pickups With Blow-By ('Usok sa Dipstick')
phContext: Worn piston rings or leaking D-4D injector copper washers
symptoms: Heavy rhythmic smoke/oil splatter pulsing out of dipstick tube hot
diagnosticSteps: 1. With engine hot at idle, pull oil filler cap and dipstick slightly: steady white vapor + pulsing oil spray = severe blow-by / injector seal leak!

domainName: Pre-Purchase Used Car Inspection & Hidden Defect Scenarios (PH Market)
title: Power Window / Lock Switches Only Tested From Driver Door
phContext: Broken passenger window switches or child-lock issues
symptoms: Seller demonstrates driver window only
diagnosticSteps: 1. Test EVERY window switch from BOTH driver master and each individual door, plus central lock, mirrors, wipers, washers, horn, and high beams!

domainName: Pre-Purchase Used Car Inspection & Hidden Defect Scenarios (PH Market)
title: Replaced Engine Block ('Change Engine') Not Reflected in LTO Papers
phContext: Older vehicles with swapped surplus engine without LTO clearance
symptoms: Engine serial number doesn't match LTO CR!
diagnosticSteps: 1. Physically locate stamped engine block serial number and match it to LTO Certificate of Registration (CR) before paying!

domainName: Pre-Purchase Used Car Inspection & Hidden Defect Scenarios (PH Market)
title: Hidden Rear-End Frame Pull Marks — Dog-Tracking on Road
phContext: Used cars after rear collision
symptoms: Car steers crooked, tire wear uneven, trunk floor wrinkled
diagnosticSteps: 1. Lift trunk carpet & spare tire to inspect rear floorpan and frame rails for wavy hammer marks, fresh black undercoat overspray, or torn seam sealer!

domainName: Pre-Purchase Used Car Inspection & Hidden Defect Scenarios (PH Market)
title: 2-Pin / 4-Pin Seatbelt Pretensioner Fired & Locked/Bypassed
phContext: Collision-repaired cars; seatbelt hangs loose and won't retract
symptoms: Driver/passenger belt slack, frayed stitching
diagnosticSteps: 1. Pull every seatbelt all the way out and yank sharply to verify inertia lock AND check bottom retractor date tag/plastic housing for melt/deployment!

domainName: Pre-Purchase Used Car Inspection & Hidden Defect Scenarios (PH Market)
title: Aftermarket Key Fob Only (No Original Spare Key) — Immobilizer Risk
phContext: Used push-start car sold with 1 cloned/aftermarket key
symptoms: Previous owner might still hold working spare key!
diagnosticSteps: 1. Check 'Number of Registered Keys' PID in BCM/Immo! 2. If 3+ keys registered and buyer only gets 1, erase all lost keys and re-register only buyer's keys!

domainName: Pre-Purchase Used Car Inspection & Hidden Defect Scenarios (PH Market)
title: Water-Damaged Audio / Amplifier / Under-Seat Electronics
phContext: Used SUVs/sedans with dead rear speakers or static
symptoms: Radio works only on 2 front speakers
diagnosticSteps: 1. Fade/balance audio to all 4 corners + subwoofer; check under front seats for water stains on amp/ECU housings.

domainName: Pre-Purchase Used Car Inspection & Hidden Defect Scenarios (PH Market)
title: Used Motorcycle / Scooter With Cut/Spliced Wiring & Bypassed Sensors
phContext: Used EFI bikes with bypassed sidestand/O2/tip-over switches
symptoms: Hard start, poor mileage, electrical fire risk
diagnosticSteps: 1. Remove scooter under-seat bucket/front cowl to inspect wiring loom for electrical-tape splices and missing sensors! 2. Scan ECM for stored codes.

domainName: Pre-Purchase Used Car Inspection & Hidden Defect Scenarios (PH Market)
title: Weak Battery Temporarily Boosted Right Before Buyer Arrives
phContext: Car battery charger disconnected 5 min before buyer shows up
symptoms: Starts fast during viewing, dead next morning!
diagnosticSteps: 1. Check battery terminal voltage & CCA with digital conductance tester (and touch battery/engine to verify if warm/freshly charged!).

domainName: Pre-Purchase Used Car Inspection & Hidden Defect Scenarios (PH Market)
title: Dual-Clutch (Ford DPS6 / Geely 7DCT) Tested Only on Flat Ground
phContext: Worn DCT clutches hide on flat streets, shudder on ramps!
symptoms: Smooth at 40 km/h flat, violent shudder on parking-garage ramp
diagnosticSteps: 1. Always test DCT/CVT vehicles on a slow uphill incline or mall ramp from dead stop! 2. Monitor clutch slip/temp PIDs.

domainName: Pre-Purchase Used Car Inspection & Hidden Defect Scenarios (PH Market)
title: Alternator Overcharging Masked by Disconnected Battery Light
phContext: Used car with dead alternator bulb
symptoms: Battery dies 2 days after buying car
diagnosticSteps: 1. Verify battery light illuminates at KOEO AND measure 13.8–14.4V at battery running with headlights + A/C ON!

domainName: Pre-Purchase Used Car Inspection & Hidden Defect Scenarios (PH Market)
title: Leaking Steering Rack Masked by Thick Stop-Leak Fluid
phContext: Used hydraulic-PS cars with torn rack boots packed with grease/stop-leak
symptoms: Dry floor at viewing, leaks ATF 1 week later
diagnosticSteps: 1. Squeeze rubber steering rack bellows boots on both sides (if squishy/full of fluid, rack seals are blown!).

domainName: Pre-Purchase Used Car Inspection & Hidden Defect Scenarios (PH Market)
title: Used Car With 'Cold-Air Intake' Cone Filter Sucking Hot Engine Air
phContext: Modified compact cars; missing factory airbox
symptoms: Sluggish in traffic, MAF codes
diagnosticSteps: 1. Inspect engine bay for missing OEM airbox, unplugged vacuum hoses, or unshielded hot-air cone filters.

domainName: Pre-Purchase Used Car Inspection & Hidden Defect Scenarios (PH Market)
title: Unbalanced / Bent Alloy Rim Hidden on Rear Axle
phContext: Used car seller moved bent front rim to rear so steering doesn't shake
symptoms: Humming/vibration felt in seat at 90 km/h
diagnosticSteps: 1. Inspect inner lips of all 4 alloy wheels on lift for flat spots, weld repairs, or cracks!

domainName: Pre-Purchase Used Car Inspection & Hidden Defect Scenarios (PH Market)
title: Missing Spare Tire, Jack, or Wheel Lock Key!
phContext: Used car missing factory lug-nut lock key socket
symptoms: Buyer stranded with flat tire and anti-theft lug nuts!
diagnosticSteps: 1. Check trunk for spare tire, jack, wrench, AND anti-theft wheel lock key socket before closing sale!

domainName: Pre-Purchase Used Car Inspection & Hidden Defect Scenarios (PH Market)
title: Used PUV / Van With Repaired / Welded Chassis Frame Crack
phContext: Overloaded commercial vans/trucks; cracked frame behind cab
symptoms: Alignment never stays straight
diagnosticSteps: 1. Inspect both main C-channel chassis rails from front bumper to rear shackles for fish-plate welds or cracks.

domainName: Pre-Purchase Used Car Inspection & Hidden Defect Scenarios (PH Market)
title: Headlight Aiming Screws Stripped — Broken Adjusters from Accident
phContext: Cars with cheap aftermarket replacement headlights
symptoms: Beams point into trees or 2 meters ahead of bumper
diagnosticSteps: 1. Test headlights against wall at night/shade and check adjuster screws actually move beam.

domainName: Pre-Purchase Used Car Inspection & Hidden Defect Scenarios (PH Market)
title: Used EV / PHEV Missing Portable Charger (EVSE) or V2L Cable
phContext: Second-hand BYD/MG/Hyundai EVs sold without OEM charger
symptoms: Buyer discovers no home charger included
diagnosticSteps: 1. Verify OEM portable 220V EVSE charger, Type-2 cable, and V2L adapter are present and test-charge car for 5 min!

domainName: Pre-Purchase Used Car Inspection & Hidden Defect Scenarios (PH Market)
title: Aircon Evaporator Leak Masked by Freshly Topped-Up Freon
phContext: Seller recharged A/C the morning of sale!
symptoms: Ice-cold at viewing, blows warm 10 days later
diagnosticSteps: 1. Shine UV flashlight around A/C line fittings, condenser face, and evaporator drain tube for bright green/yellow UV dye stains!

domainName: Pre-Purchase Used Car Inspection & Hidden Defect Scenarios (PH Market)
title: Complete Pre-Purchase OBD-II + Physical Checklist Sign-Off
phContext: Standardized AutoElectric Lab PRO Pre-Purchase Diagnostic Protocol
symptoms: Buyer needs objective pass/fail report
diagnosticSteps: 1. Save full-system health scan PDF (VIN, mileage, monitors, freeze frames), battery/alt test, fluid checks, and road-test PID log before finalizing purchase.
